plugins.description: Lightweight reverse-proxy bridge for DSH web GUI - fixes WS 403 through nginx
plugins.readme_text:
# @painclown/dsh-proxy-bridge

轻量级 DSH 反向代理桥，专为 nginx 等 TLS 终结反代后面的 WebSocket 转发设计。

> 理念参考 [@riceawa/dsh-lan-gateway](https://github.com/rice-awa/dsh-lan-gateway)，感谢 riceawa 的启发。

## 解决什么问题

DSH Web GUI 的 WebSocket 连接在通过 nginx → 网关 → DSH 链路时会因 Origin/Host 不匹配返回 403。本插件跳过 same-site 检查，信任上游终结器（nginx）做访问控制，直接转发 HTTP + WebSocket 到 DSH。

## 架构

```
浏览器 ──HTTPS──> nginx (TLS 终结) ──HTTP──> Bridge (0.0.0.0:3083) ──HTTP──> DSH (127.0.0.1:3080)
                                              │
                                              ├── 密码门 (可选)
                                              ├── DSH Cookie 自动注入
                                              ├── WebSocket 透传 (raw TCP splice)
                                              └── 速率限制 / 会话撤销
```

- **HTTP**: 转发时重写 Host/Origin 到 `127.0.0.1:3080`
- **WebSocket**: socket 直接 splice 到上游，无 same-site 检查
- **密码门**: 可选的第二层认证（在 nginx 之上）
- **DSH Cookie 注入**: 自动为请求注入 DSH 认证 Cookie，无需手动处理 DSH 登录

## 安装

```bash
# 通过 DSH 插件命令安装
dsh plugin --profile web add @painclown/dsh-proxy-bridge

# 或手动安装
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
npm install @painclown/dsh-proxy-bridge
```

## 快速开始

```
# 1. 启用桥（默认 3083 → 3080）
proxy_bridge enable

# 2. 设置密码
proxy_bridge config password=dsh2026

# 3. 配置 DSH Secret（从 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml 读取）
proxy_bridge config dshSecret=<your-secret>

# 4. 检查状态
proxy_bridge status
```

## 命令

| 命令 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| `proxy_bridge status` | 查看桥状态 |
| `proxy_bridge enable` | 启动桥 |
| `proxy_bridge disable` | 停止桥 |
| `proxy_bridge restart` | 重启桥 |
| `proxy_bridge config` | 更新配置 |

### 配置示例

```
# 设置密码（至少 8 位）
proxy_bridge config password=dsh2026

# 配置 DSH Secret（自动注入 DSH 认证 Cookie）
proxy_bridge config dshSecret=vGIxivMEJblP1teRqVymk6sefy7wHMzxds9T0Unv6rE

# 启用自签名 TLS
proxy_bridge config tlsEnabled=true tlsHosts=["dsh.poxx.top","192.168.123.254"]

# 允许 LAN 免登录
proxy_bridge config lanPasswordless=true lanCidrs=["192.168.123.0/24"]

# 清除密码
proxy_bridge config password=
```

## 配置字段

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|------|------|--------|------|
| `enabled` | boolean | `false` | 是否启动监听 |
| `port` | number | `3083` | 监听端口 (0.0.0.0) |
| `dshPort` | number | `3080` | DSH 上游端口 |
| `password` | string | `''` | 密码门（空 = 无密码） |
| `cookieName` | string | `dsh_bridge_auth` | 会话 Cookie 名 |
| `cookieMaxAgeDays` | number | `30` | Cookie 有效期（天） |
| `dshSecret` | string | `''` | DSH browser-session secret |
| `secureCookies` | boolean | `false` | Cookie 加 Secure 标志 |
| `tlsEnabled` | boolean | `false` | 启用自签名 TLS (HTTPS) |
| `tlsDays` | number | `365` | 自签名证书有效期（天） |
| `tlsHosts` | string[] | `[]` | 证书 SAN 主机列表 |
| `lanCidrs` | string[] | `[]` | 信任的 LAN CIDR |
| `lanPasswordless` | boolean | `false` | LAN/loopback 源免登录 |

## 安全特性

### 密码门

- 设置密码后，所有请求必须携带有效会话 Cookie
- 登录页：`/__bridge_login`（GET 显示表单，POST 验证密码）
- 登出：`/__bridge_logout`（POST 撤销当前会话）
- 速率限制：每 IP 每 60 秒最多 5 次登录尝试
- 密码使用 scrypt 哈希存储，明文不保存

### 会话管理

- 每个会话有唯一 ID（16 字节随机数）
- 会话 Cookie 使用 HMAC-SHA256 签名
- 登出只撤销当前会话，不影响其他
- 修改密码递增 epoch，撤销所有会话
- 状态持久化到 `~/.dsh/proxy-bridge/state.json`（0600 权限）

### DSH Cookie 注入

当客户端请求不携带 `dsh-auth-*` Cookie 时，Bridge 使用配置的 secret 自动生成并注入，使 DSH 认证透明化。

## 文件结构

```
~/.dsh/proxy-bridge/
├── state.json          # 持久化状态（Cookie secret、密码哈希、会话 epoch、已撤销会话）
└── tls/
    ├── selfsigned.crt  # 自签名证书（tlsEnabled=true 时生成）
    └── selfsigned.key  # 私钥
```

## nginx 配置示例

```nginx
server {
    listen 11007 ssl;
    server_name dsh.poxx.top;

    ssl_certificate     /path/to/cert.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /path/to/key.pem;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3083;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;

        # WebSocket 支持
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";

        proxy_read_timeout 86400;
    }
}
```

## 开发

```bash
# 构建
npx tsdown

# 部署到 DSH profile
rm -rf ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@riceawa/dsh-proxy-bridge/lib/
cp -r lib/ ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@riceawa/dsh-proxy-bridge/lib/
```

### 源码结构

```
src/
├── index.ts            # 插件入口，工具注册，生命周期管理
├── proxy.ts            # 核心代理逻辑（HTTP 转发 + WS 透传 + 认证）
├── auth.ts             # 源分类、会话签名、速率限制
├── state.ts            # 持久化状态（scrypt 密码、Cookie secret、会话管理）
├── tls.ts              # 自签名证书生成和加载
├── login.ts            # 登录页渲染、登出路径、速率限制处理
├── config-fields.ts    # 配置 schema
└── client/
    ├── index.ts        # 客户端入口
    └── bridge-card.tsx # React 配置卡片
```

## 与 dsh-lan-gateway 的区别

| 特性 | dsh-lan-gateway | dsh-proxy-bridge |
|------|----------------|-----------------|
| Same-site 检查 | 严格（Origin/Host 必须匹配） | 跳过（信任 nginx） |
| 适用场景 | 直接暴露到 LAN | 放在 nginx 后面 |
| WS 403 问题 | 需要配置 Origin 白名单 | 自动解决 |
| DSH Cookie 注入 | 无 | 有 |
| 复杂度 | 较高（request policy、upstream session） | 较低 |

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Deterministic network egress gate for DeepSeek Harness — web fetches checked against a destination allowlist before they run
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-egress-gate

Deterministic network egress gate for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh).

Content scanning (dsh-read-guard) guards what **enters** the model; this
guards where data may **leave** to. `web_fetch` / `web_search` calls are
checked against a destination allowlist in `tools/pre-execute` and denied
before they run. Shell commands are scanned for fetch-verb URLs —
observation by default, enforcement opt-in, honest about precision. Zero LLM
calls in the trust path.

Family: read · write · do · call · leave-behind · **egress (where data may
flow)**.

## Why now (checked 2026-10-12)

Empty lane. Five keyword searches (`network allowlist`, `egress firewall`,
`url filter`, `web fetch restrict`, …) return nothing on GitHub; the awesome
list has no entry gating destinations. Neighbours are all different axes:
content-pattern secret rules (dsh-defend), LLM-judged commands
(dsh-jev-guard), proxy *configuration* (official network-proxy docs). For
teams, "which hosts may the agent reach" is the first compliance question —
and the deterministic answer was unowned.

## Policy

- Deny always wins; a non-empty `allow` list means "only these hosts"
  (`example.com` covers `api.example.com`; `*.example.com` is the explicit
  form).
- Web tools are enforced at full precision — the URL is in the arguments.
- Shell: URLs following `curl` / `wget` / `Invoke-WebRequest` /
  `Invoke-RestMethod` / `fetch` / `http` on the same command segment. This
  cannot see through scripts, variables, or proxies — so it warns by
  default and denies only when you opt into `shellMode: 'enforce'`.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile default add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-egress-gate
```

Prebuilt `lib/` ships in the repo — git installs need no build step and no
`allowBuilds` authorization.

## Configure

```yaml
- id: dsh-egress-gate
  name: dsh-egress-gate
  config:
    webTools: [web_fetch, web_search]
    shellTool: bash            # '' disables the shell scan
    allow: [docs.deepseek.com, github.com]
    deny: [pastebin.example]
    shellMode: observe         # observe | enforce
```

## Compatibility

- **DSH**: verified against the 0.2.x line (source snapshot 0.2.1-alpha.2); installs on any profile via `dsh plugin add` (prebuilt `lib/`, no build approval).
- **Node**: >= 20 (CI matrix: Node 20/22/24 on Ubuntu and Windows).
- **Disposable-profile evidence (2026-10-19)**: `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-egress-gate` → installed in 30s; boot shows `[dsh-egress-gate] active: …`; `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> remove dsh-egress-gate` → dependencies cleared, bundles restored.

## Develop

```sh
npm install && npm test
```

## Kill criteria

If dsh ships first-party destination policy, or proxy-layer plugins add
per-host rules, this freezes at its last working version with a postmortem
here.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：万事通强尼 —— /johnny 出摊，没收到钱就装傻；敲钱喂给 dsh-pet 大肥鱼，才会说真话 | Pay the fish, get the truth
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-johnny

> DeepSeek Harness 插件：**万事通强尼 —— 没收到钱就装傻，钱到位全说。**

给你喜欢的桌宠（dsh-pet 大肥鱼）配一个"付费问答"小剧场：`/johnny` 出摊后，你说什么他都打太极（「有可能知道，有可能不知道。」）；想要真话，得**敲钱**、再把钱**喂给肥鱼**——鱼啃一口，真答案落进对话。

致敬《白头神探》前身剧《Police Squad!》里的擦鞋线人 Johnny——那位"什么都知道、但钱到位才肯说"的万事通。

## 三步玩起来

1. **出摊**：对话里输入 `/johnny`（再敲一次收摊；屏幕角落会出现「强尼模式」徽标 + 红色 ×，**点 × 秒退**）
2. **敲钱**（三通道任选）：
   - 桌面：鼠标 **左左·右右**
   - 手机：**摇一摇**
   - 或输入框打「**发钱**」发送（被拦下，不发给模型、不花 token）
3. **喂鱼**：把钱拖到肥鱼身上 → 鱼播动画 + 气泡「TOKEN 的味道……不错……」→ **真答案出现在对话里**

模式里你发的每句话都会被"扣下"：问题记进会话，强尼只回那一句招牌搪塞（鱼会同步动一下、冒泡帮腔）。**装傻环节零模型调用、零 token。**

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'https://codeload.github.com/wobenshiwomu/dsh-johnny/tar.gz/v0.1.0'
```

或在图形界面：侧栏「插件」→ 添加插件 → 填上面这条 URL。装完重启 DSH 生效。
URL 末段的 `v0.1.0` 是版本标签；升级时换成本仓库的新版本标签重装即可。

**建议搭配 [dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet)（大肥鱼桌宠）**——"喂鱼"环节靠它的 `/dsh-pet-7340` 接口。没有鱼也能玩：出摊 / 装傻 / 敲钱 / 红叉都好使，只有最后喂鱼那步会提示"鱼没反应"。

## 配置项（全部可选）

在 profile 用户层 `cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖：

```yaml
- id: dsh-johnny
  config:
    bubbleText: 'TOKEN 的味道……不错……'   # 喂钱后鱼气泡文案
    bubbleMeme: ''                          # 可选气泡配图（dsh-pet 表情包名，如 吃饱饱摸肚子）
    eatAnim: '余额-钱袋满溢'                 # 喂钱时鱼播的动画
    askBubbleText: '有可能知道，有可能不知道。'  # 扣下时鱼气泡文案（留空=不冒泡）
    askAnim: '工作状态-思考冒泡'              # 扣下时鱼播的动画（留空=不动）
    # petId: main                           # 联动的宠物 id
    # petBase: /dsh-pet-7340                # dsh-pet 接口前缀
    # moneyWords: [发钱, 给钱, 付钱, 交钱, 小费]  # 输入框召钱词表
    # storageDir: ''                        # 状态存储目录（默认 $DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-johnny）
```

## 原理（一段话）

模式里客户端在捕获层拦下你的发送；「点单」经 HTTP 进宿主后，用 `session.append(…, { surfaceOp: 'append' })` 把问题与搪塞台词写进会话（**不惊动模型、零 token**）；喂钱触发 `resolveAgent → agent.followup`，把被扣的问题包进「鱼已收钱」消息——只有这一轮"真回答"过一次模型。鱼的反应（动画 + 气泡）由客户端同源调用 dsh-pet 接口完成。

> 小注：最初想让模型亲自"演"强尼，真机实测模型会把"装傻要钱"判为操纵性/注入而拒绝出演；改成"拦截式台词池"后反而更稳、更省、更好笑——他每次都说同一句，就是笑点。

## 测试

- `node test/sim.mjs`：**66 项断言**（模式开关与持久化 / 点单扣话 / 解锁载荷 / HTTP 路由 / 配置透传）
- 真机 E2E：扣下时零模型调用（assistant 计数不变）→ 喂钱 → 模型答出暗号（TOKEN-99），全链路贯通

## 已知问题

- Android/Termux 上使用 dsh-pet 需要先让它能正常加载：其静态 import 的 `@electron-internal/extract-zip` 没有安卓预编译，会在插件加载期抛错；可用 `pnpm patch` 换成懒桩绕过（该模块只在桌面模式用到）。修复建议（改成使用时动态 import）已同步给 dsh-pet 仓库。
- dsh-pet 的"桌面模式"（Electron 透明窗）在安卓不可用，属上游限制；Web 模式不受影响。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH 防呆插件：safe_kill 工具（自动排除自身与祖先进程链）+ bash 命令预检 + 可扩展规则库。Zero-dependency safety guard for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-whale-guard 🛡️

鲸鱼娘**防呆插件**：把「一天犯四次的低级错误」变成工具层面的硬拦截。

> 起因：2026-10-09 一天里，鲸鱼娘因为同一个坑反复翻车 —— `pkill -f "FurMark_GUI"` 把自己的命令行也匹配上了，于是**杀掉自己**。主人提议：「不如写个插件专门拦这些智障操作。」

## 它做三件事

| # | 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ① | **`safe_kill` 工具** | 按模式杀进程，**自动排除自身 + 全部祖先进程链**。以后杀进程不用再手写 `pkill`。 |
| ② | **bash 命令预检** | 调 bash 工具前扫描命令文本：命中危险模式就**拒绝执行**并给出安全替代写法；命中风险模式就放行但插一条醒目告警。 |
| ③ | **可扩展规则库** | 内置 9 条真实教训（见下），可随时往 `~/.dsh-home/whale-guard-rules.json` 加自己的坑，**改完存盘立即生效，不用重启**。 |
| ④ | **设置页** | **设置 → 防呆**：状态 / 处置方式（拦截⇄只提醒，点击即生效）/ 受保护进程链 / 规则清单（勾选即停用）/ 最近拦截日志 / 文件位置。 |

## 内置规则

| 规则 id | 触发场景 | 处置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pkill-self-match` | `pkill -f <模式>` 而命令自身命令行含该模式 | **拦** + 给 safe_kill 写法 |
| `grep-xargs-kill-self-match` | `ps \| grep "<模式>" \| xargs kill` 会连自己一起杀 | **拦** |
| `sudo-heredoc-stdin` | `sudo -S` 与 heredoc 抢 stdin，密码喂不进去 | **拦** + 给「先落盘再提权」写法 |
| `sudo-needs-tty` | 非交互 shell 里 sudo 拿不到终端 | 提示（用 `-S` 或 `pkexec`） |
| `rm-rf-root` | `rm -rf /`、`rm -rf /etc` 等 | **拦** |
| `kill-pid1` | `kill 1` / `kill -9 1` | **拦** |
| `chmod-r777-root` | `chmod -R 777 /`（或系统目录） | **拦** |
| `local-bin-not-in-path` | 命令存在于 `~/.local/bin` 但不在当前 PATH 里 | 告警 + 给绝对路径写法 |
| `pip-no-mirror` | pip 命令没走国内镜像 | 提示（慢几十到几百倍） |

**防误伤设计**：预检会先剥掉注释、把引号内容换成位置标记。所以 `echo "文档里写的 rm -rf / 是反面教材"`、`grep "kill 1" /var/log/syslog`、`rm -rf ./build` 都**正常放行**——只有真会伤到自己的才拦。

## 设置页

**设置 → 防呆**：

![设置页](assets/settings-page.png)


## 自研插件图标

三个自研插件的设置页与设置导航图标是一套手绘矢量（24×24、描边 1.7、`stroke=currentColor`
跟随主题明暗），设计稿来自千问 `qwen-image-3.0`，再由我描成精确路径：

| 插件 | 图标 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| dsh-memory-lite | 摊开的书 + 便签卡 | 记忆库 |
| **dsh-whale-guard** | 盾牌 + 鲸鱼尾巴 | 守卫（盾）+ 本尊（鲸鱼） |
| dsh-multi-tts | 喇叭 + 声波 + 气泡 | 朗读出声 |

**为什么要动 DOM**：DSH 的 `navIcon(id)`（`dsh-client-ui-settings-general/lib/client.js`）是一张
**写死的表**，未登记的 section 一律回退系统齿轮，而 `settings.section` 的注册选项只有
`id/order/label`，没有图标位。所以每个插件的 `client.js` 在 `apply()` 里做一件事：
在 MutationObserver 里找到「自己那一行」的 `svg.navIcon` 并替换掉，命中范围仅此一个节点，
幂等、不动他人 DOM。React 重渲染会把它换回来，所以观察器持续纠偏（未命中时极廉价）。

**升级注意**：若 DSH 将来给 `settings.section` 加了图标字段，应改回声明式写法、删掉这段 DOM 逻辑。

## 用法

装好之后，直接在对话里用工具：

```
safe_kill({ pattern: "FurMark_GUI" })            # 默认 SIGTERM
safe_kill({ pattern: "comfy", signal: "SIGKILL" })
guard_status()                                   # 看保护链 / 规则数 / 最近命中
```

命令行等价物（顺手保留）：

```bash
/usr/local/bin/safepkill "FurMark_GUI"
```

## 配置（`cordis.patch.yml`）

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: whale-guard
      name: 'dsh-whale-guard'
      config:
        enabled: true              # 总开关
        mode: block                # block=真拦；warn=只告警放行
        precheckTools: [bash]      # 参与预检的工具
        rulesFile: ~/dsh-home/whale-guard-rules.json
        stateDir: ~/dsh-home/whale-guard   # 审计日志 audit.jsonl
        auditLog: true
        rules:
          disable: [pip-no-mirror]  # 关掉某条内置规则
          custom:                   # 或直接在配置里写规则
            - id: no-prod-restart
              title: 别直接重启生产实例
              severity: warn
              pattern: 'systemctl\\s+--user\\s+restart\\s+dsh-web'
              message: 生产实例重启前先确认回档点。
              fix: 先起隔离实例验证。
```

## 加自己的规则

编辑 `~/.dsh-home/whale-guard-rules.json`（插件首次运行会自动生成带示例的模板）：

```json
{
  "custom": [
    {
      "id": "任意唯一名",
      "title": "一句话说清这个坑",
      "severity": "block",
      "pattern": "正则表达式（对整条命令匹配，也可以给数组）",
      "message": "为什么错",
      "fix": "正确写法"
    }
  ]
}
```

- `severity`：`block`（拒绝执行）/ `warn`（告警放行）/ `hint`（轻声提示）
- 规则的 `pattern` 是对**整条原始命令**做正则匹配（大小写敏感，需要忽略大小写就加 `"flags": "i"`）
- 也可以写 `"builtin": "pkill-self-match"` 表示「复用某条内置规则的判定逻辑」

## 为什么 `safe_kill` 不会自杀

`pkill -f` 之所以自杀，是因为它匹配的是**完整命令行**，而执行这条 pkill 的 shell 命令行里就含该模式，于是「自己匹配自己」。

`safe_kill` 的链路：

1. 用 `pgrep -f` 拿候选 PID（只读，不杀）
2. 读 `/proc/<pid>/stat` 逐级上溯，算出**自身 + 全部祖先进程**的排除名单
3. 逐个 `process.kill()`，命中排除名单的直接跳过并在结果里说明原因

全程不拼 shell 字符串（无注入面），也不依赖 `~/.local/bin` 在 PATH 里（非交互 shell 的 PATH 坑绕开了）。

## 自检

```bash
node tools/selftest.mjs      # 78 项：规则命中/防误伤/heredoc 攻防/safe_kill 实战/设置页路由
```

## 上生产 / 更新

```bash
# 装进 profile（会把插件写进 profile 的 bundles，下次启动即加载）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:WYR-233/dsh-whale-guard
systemctl --user restart dsh-web        # 让当前实例加载新插件
```

- **安装方式是 `link:`**（符号链接到本目录），所以**本目录就是生产代码**：
  - 改 `lib/*.js` → 重启 DSH 后生效；
  - ⚠️ **别删/别移走本目录**，否则生产 profile 的链接会断（插件加载失败）。
- 规则文件 `~/.dsh-home/whale-guard-rules.json` 不随插件走，是**本机数据**，升级插件不影响它。
- 回档点（装之前的三件套备份）：`~/dsh-home/backups/pre-whale-guard-20261009-135612/`
- 审计日志：`~/.dsh-home/whale-guard/audit.jsonl`（每条命中的规则、命令、是否拦截）

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: Per-session todo lists for DeepSeek Harness: user-defined columns, completion, batch actions, undo and CSV export, plus agent access through a tool.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-todos

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：**每个会话独立的待办清单**，列由用户自定义，默认只有「序号｜事项」。

界面与 AI 共用同一份数据：你在面板上勾选，模型能读到；模型写进去的事项，面板也会显示。

## 特性

- **会话隔离**：每个会话有自己的事项与列配置，互不影响。
- **自定义列**：文本 / 数字 / 日期三种类型，可新增、重命名、左右移动、删除；事项列可改名但不可删除。
- **事项操作**：新增、编辑、删除（带确认）、勾选完成、再次勾选恢复未完成、上移 / 下移。
- **搜索与筛选**：搜索所有列，筛选全部 / 未完成 / 已完成。
- **批量操作**：批量完成、恢复、删除（作用于当前筛选结果）。
- **撤销**：最近 20 次操作可回退，包含删除列及其数据；没有重做。
- **导出 CSV**：导出全量清单（不是当前筛选），带完成标记，兼容中文 Excel，并对公式注入做了转义。
- **按需展示**：不创建就不显示、不占空间；展开后的宽度、内边距、折叠摘要对齐原生任务框。
- **AI 可用**：模型通过 `session_todos` 工具读写同一份清单，与界面共用同一个宿主方法。

## 安装

安装一个 DSH 插件是**两步**，缺一不可：

1. **装依赖** —— 让包在 profile 里可解析；
2. **启用 bundle** —— 把包名写进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。

`dsh plugin --profile <name> <args...>` 只是 **pnpm 的转发**（在 profile 目录里执行），所以它只完成第 1 步：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Tpihis/dsh-session-todos.git
cd dsh-session-todos
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD"        # ① 装依赖
```

第 2 步没有对应的 CLI 命令，用插件管理器完成：

- GUI：侧边栏「插件」面板里把 `dsh-session-todos` 打开；
- 或让 agent 调 `plugin_manager`：`set_bundle`，`target = dsh-session-todos`，`enabled = true`；
- 或一步到位：`plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，`target` 指向本目录（安装 + 启用）。

**只做第 1 步插件不会加载。** 这不是猜测：`dsh` 只提供 `dsh plugin`（pnpm 转发）和 `--patch` 两个入口，没有 `dsh bundle` 之类的命令；而且本机 profile 里就有一个实例——`@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skill-explorer` 在 `dependencies` 里但不在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里，因此始终 `enabled: false`。

验证是否启用成功：

```sh
node -e 'console.log(require(process.env.HOME+"/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json").dsh.profile.bundles)'
```

名字出现在这个列表里，并且插件面板显示已启用，才算装好。

安装完成后：

- 宿主半即时生效；
- **客户端半需要刷新一次页面（F5）**才会出现新代码；
- 没有 `pnpm run dev:web` 时，客户端插件不会自动热更新。

## 使用

打开任意会话，输入框上方会出现一行「会话待办」摘要（**未创建清单时不显示**）。点开即可编辑。

也可以直接对模型说：

> 把这些需求加入当前会话待办，并增加分类、优先级和截止日期列。

模型侧的 `todo_write` 是它自己的执行计划，与本清单无关。

## 数据与边界

- 数据存在宿主存储域 `session_custom_todos`（本机位于 `~/.dsh/storages/session_custom_todos/`），**不在插件目录内**，卸载插件不会删除数据。
- 每个会话最多 2000 条事项、20 个数据列；列名最多 80 字符，单元格最多 10000 字符。
- 并发写使用 revision 检查：拿旧版本号提交会被拒绝，提示刷新后重试。
- 会话分支（fork）默认是空白清单，不继承父会话。
- 会话删除后，其域记录不会自动清理。

## 已知限制

- **写操作会在对话里留下一条命令卡片**。界面的写操作通过斜杠命令 `/session-todos` 落到宿主，而 DSH 一定会把命令生命周期（`command/run` + `command/done`）渲染成卡片，无法避免。为让它可读，每次写操作返回一句中文摘要（如「已完成 1 条（2/3 已完成）」），卡片摘要行显示该文本，而不是默认的「已完成」。摘要生成在 `src/model.js` 的 `summarize()`。
- 想做到**完全不产生这类卡片**，需要改用插件自建的 typert RPC（宿主 `ctx.typert.register` + 客户端 `ctx.remote.$mount`）。曾实现过一版，但桥接调用挂起会让面板写入锁卡死，未收敛，故采用当前折中方案。
- 未做第二台机器、其他 DSH 版本、其他操作系统的验证。

## 开发

```
src/host.js        宿主半（apply / inject，命令、工具、会话投影、存储域）
src/model.js       纯业务逻辑（校验、变更、撤销、视图、摘要）+ 单元测试
src/model.test.js  测试：node --test src/model.test.js
client.js          浏览器半（React，通过 __ModuleLoader__ 注册）
cordis.patch.yml   bundle 补丁，插入一行 session-todos
```

### 改完代码为什么不生效

运行中的 DSH 进程按 URL 缓存已导入的模块，而 profile 安装的 bundle **不会**因为自身文件变化而热重载。原地改文件，跑的还是旧模块。

```sh
npm run refresh     # 给入口的相对导入写入内容哈希 ./model.js?v=<hash>
```

然后重新启用 bundle（或重启 DSH）。哈希必须是**字面量**——Loader 要静态读取入口的 `export const inject`，所以不能用 `Date.now()` / `Math.random()` 在运行时拼。

注意：`refresh` 只能让入口**的依赖**换 URL；如果入口文件本身（`src/host.js`）的缓存需要失效，仍然要重启 DSH 或更换入口文件名。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness ⇄ JetBrains integration: DSH chat inside your IDE, and your IDE workspace — project, attached modules, active file and caret — in front of the model.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH ⇄ JetBrains

Small packages that connect a local [DeepSeek Harness](../../) (DSH) to a JetBrains IDE, so the IDE and
the agent share one workspace instead of two islands.

Each one works on its own: the IDE plugin and the DSH bundle are the two halves of the same workflow, and
the session-link plugin only lets a page be asked for a session by address. The DSH bundle carries both a
Host half and a web-client half, so installing it covers the tool, the context line, and the clicks.

| Package | Platform | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`jetbrains-companion/`](jetbrains-companion) | IntelliJ Platform plugin (Java, no Gradle) | **DSH Chat** tool window embedding DSH's own web client, one DSH session per IDE window, live workspace publication, a loopback bridge so DSH can put a file in front of you, and a `DSH Changes` tool window that shows a published turn as a native side-by-side IntelliJ diff. |
| [`jetbrains-workspace/`](jetbrains-workspace) | DSH profile bundle (host half + web-client half, plain JavaScript) | Reads the IDE's workspace — including a module's multiple content roots from its `.iml` — into DSH as a tool, a runtime context line, and a registered workspace. Works with the companion running or from the IDE's own state files after it closed. Sends opened and clicked files to the IDE: the Host half replaces DSH's default desktop opener, and the client half redirects the Sidebar file viewer. |
| [`jetbrains-session-link/`](jetbrains-session-link) | DSH client plugin (plain JavaScript) | Lets `#dsh-session=<id>` — or a hash change on an open page — select that session without a reload. Optional: the chat panel falls back to the client's stored selection when it is absent. |

> **Unofficial.** Neither package is made by, endorsed by, or affiliated with JetBrains or DeepSeek.
> IntelliJ, IDEA and JetBrains are trademarks of JetBrains s.r.o.

## What you get

- **Chat inside the IDE.** The `DSH Chat` tool window renders DSH's web client, authenticated with the
  same browser-session cookie DSH gives a browser, and opens the session for the window you are in.
- **One workspace, seen from both sides.** The window's root project and every attached module/VCS
  directory reach the model as a runtime context line and as a `jetbrains_workspace` tool result, with
  each directory labelled by the source that reported it.
- **Round trip.** DSH can read the active file, caret and selection, and open a file in the IDE at a
  line — with the companion's bridge, or with the IDE state files when the IDE is closed.

- **Review a turn as a diff.** `DSH Changes` lists every turn `dsh-jetbrains-workspace` publishes and
  opens any changed file as a native side-by-side IntelliJ diff. A turn's diff also opens by itself, with a
  **Keep** / **Revert** notification, the chat panel's toolbar has a **Changes** toggle, and reverting works
  per file or per hunk — refusing rather than half-reverting a file that changed since the turn.
- **Nothing is lost while the IDE is closed.** The review document outlives the IDE: on the next start the
  companion mentions the turns it missed, with one click to the panel.

## Why one DSH, not one per project

Because the value is in seeing everything at once. One Host process holds every session, so a reader can keep
an agent running in one project under watch while working on something else in another session that has
nothing to do with the IDE. It is also why this bundle publishes one review document for the whole Host
rather than one per workspace: the changes panel lists the turns of every session that changed files, so an
agent left running in another project still reports where the reader already is.

The IDE side leans the same way. One companion serves the whole IDE: the chat panel keeps one session per
project, the window junction can be told to register the shared parent so a multi-module checkout is one
workspace (`junctionRoot: common-parent`), and `jetbrains_workspace` answers for every attached directory.

What that costs, measured rather than assumed: the companion descriptor is *one file per user*, and the
companion starts **one bridge per IDE run**. Opening a second IDE window produced no second `bridge on` line,
and the one descriptor already named both windows' projects. So a Host reaches every window through one
bridge, DSH's workspace tool sees all of them, and the companion decides which window shows a diff or opens a
file by matching the path against each project's base path. The Host also accepts a *set* of descriptors (the
single one plus any `jetbrains-companion/*.json` beside it) and chooses by workspace, so a future build that
publishes one descriptor per window needs no Host change.

## What each half gives you

Each half is useful alone, and they do not depend on each other to install. What you get changes:

| Capability | IDE plugin only | DSH bundle only | Both |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DSH Chat` tool window in the IDE (embedded DSH client, cookie auth) | yes | — | yes |
| One DSH session per IDE window, grouped in the DSH sidebar | yes — the panel registers the workspace and creates or attaches the session itself | — | yes |
| The model knows which IDE window is open (runtime context line) | — | yes, from the IDE's state files, or live when the companion runs | yes |
| `jetbrains_workspace` tool: root project, module content roots, active file, caret, selection | — | yes | yes |
| `jetbrains_open_in_ide`: the model opens a file in the IDE | — | no — it needs the companion's bridge | yes |
| Session selected without reloading the page | no — it seeds the client's stored selection and reloads once | — | yes, with `jetbrains-session-link` |
| Change review of a turn (which files, and their diffs) | — | yes — publishes `<DSH home>/jetbrains-changes.json` with the coordinates DSH's own `/api/changes.*` routes need | yes |
| A presented artifact opens in the IDE (`present` → editor tab) | — | opt-in — `autoOpenDeliverables: true`, and only for the window's own session | yes (needs the companion bridge) |
| A turn's changes as a native side-by-side IntelliJ diff | yes — the `DSH Changes` tool window | yes — publishes the document it reads | yes |
| A turn's diff opens by itself, with Keep / Revert | yes — `POST /changed` on the companion bridge | yes — posts the notice (`autoOpenDiffs`) | yes |
| Revert a file, or one hunk of it | yes — the panel and the notification action | — | yes |
| Turns published while the IDE was closed | yes — mentioned on the next start | yes — the document outlives the IDE | yes |
| Clicking a deliverable or changed file opens it in the IDE | — | the wrap is on by default (`openInIde`), but the IDE itself needs the companion's bridge — without one the desktop opener still runs | yes |
| Clicking a file in the DSH UI opens it in the IDE, not the DSH sidebar viewer | — | yes, on by default (`openSidebarFilesInIde`) — falls back to the sidebar | yes (needs the companion bridge) |

So: install the **IDE plugin** to chat with DSH inside your IDE (it needs a DSH running locally, and
reads DSH's credential document to sign the browser cookie — see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)). Install
the **DSH bundle** to put your IDE workspace in front of the model. Install **both** for the round
trip, where the model can name the file you are editing and open another one for you.

The two halves talk through DSH's own HTTP API and the companion's descriptor
(`<DSH home>/jetbrains-companion.json`, carrying a `version` and a `source` marker), so either half can
be updated on its own: a bundle that finds no live descriptor falls back to the IDE's state files, and a
companion never requires the bundle to be installed.

## Install

```sh
git clone https://github.com/abadiegie/dsh-jetbrains.git
```

**1. The IDE plugin** (needs IntelliJ Platform build 243 or newer, with JCEF):

```sh
cd jetbrains-companion
./build.sh                 # compiles against the installed IDE and copies the jar into it
IDE_HOME=/path/to/idea ./build.sh
```

Then restart the IDE. Settings live under `Settings ▸ Tools ▸ DSH Companion`. Step 1 needs no DSH-side
plugin; installing it alone gives you the chat panel (se

plugins.description: One-install ZadLoop toolkit: Context Surgery, Undo, mode switching, full session transfer, and 70 modern themes.
plugins.readme_text:
# ZadLoop Ultimate Toolkit **One tarball. Eight integrated tools. No plugin hunting.** ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-2.0.2-7c8cff?style=flat-square) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-45c992?style=flat-square) ![ZadLoop](https://img.shields.io/badge/ZadLoop-0.5.1-ff7a90?style=flat-square) ![Offline bundle](https://img.shields.io/badge/install-offline_bundle-f4c45e?style=flat-square) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/Lucifer-xD/zadloop-ultimate-toolkit/ci.yml?style=flat-square&label=tests)](https://github.com/Lucifer-xD/zadloop-ultimate-toolkit/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
ZadLoop Ultimate Toolkit packages subscription OAuth, live remaining plan quota, authenticated Remote Control, Computer Use, Context Surgery, same-session Undo, live session mode switching, full chat transfer, and Theme Studio into **one self-contained plugin file**. Its dependencies are bundled inside the release, so your friends install a single `.tgz` rather than finding separate packages. > Community project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek or ZadLoop. ## What is included | Feature | What it does | Included version | |---|---|---:| | OAuth Subscriptions | The unmodified `dsh-plugin-oauth-subs` workbench for Codex/ChatGPT, Grok, GLM, Kiro, Antigravity, Cursor, Ollama Cloud, Kimi, Devin, Cline, Command Code, and OpenCode Go, with accounts, quota, models, and usage | 0.0.121 | | Toolkit UI | Shows the connected plan's 5-hour and weekly quota remaining beside the composer controls, opens a quick inline summary on click, modernizes the subscription workbench, and repairs the Transfer and Delegate icons | 1.0.3 | | Remote Control | Create a secure internet link in one click, with a responsive Liquid Glass control panel and login, or use local-only, LAN/IP, and custom Cloudflare domain modes | 2.2.4 | | Computer Use | Let a vision-capable agent manage its own access and operate the visible Windows desktop with screenshots, mouse, keyboard, scrolling, and an expiring timer | 1.1.1 | | Context Surgery | Edit reply text, edit reasoning separately, remove messages from future model context, and use `/context` commands | 0.1.2 fixed-v4 | | Same-session Undo | Remove one user/assistant exchange from the transcript and future context without creating a new session | 1.5.1 | | Mode Switcher | Change the **current session** between Standard and Delegate mode | 2.0.3 | | Session Transfer | Export/import, fast-forward-sync, or safely preserve both branches of a forked chat | 1.2.0 | | Theme Studio | 51 dark + 21 light mode-exclusive themes, including Apple-inspired functional Liquid Glass layers, detailed controls, and a live preview | 5.3.0 | | Offline dependencies | Bundled runtime packages, including `fflate`; no npm lookup is required during tarball installation | bundled | ![Compact toolbar with Themes, Mode, and Transfer](docs/images/toolbar.svg) ## Install ### ZadLoop interface 1. Download [`dsh-zadloop-ultimate-toolkit-2.0.2.tgz`](https://github.com/Lucifer-xD/zadloop-ultimate-toolkit/releases/latest/download/dsh-zadloop-ultimate-toolkit-2.0.2.tgz) from the latest GitHub release. 2. If standalone copies are installed, disable or uninstall these first to avoid duplicate buttons: - `@wasd258/dsh-context-surgery` - `dsh-zadloop-undo` - `dsh-zadloop-mode-switcher` - `dsh-zadloop-computer-use` - `dsh-plugin-oauth-subs` - `dsh-zadloop-remote-control` - `dsh-zadloop-theme-studio` - `dsh-zadloop-session-transfer` 3. Open **Plugins → Add plugin → Tarball**. 4. Select the downloaded toolkit `.tgz`. 5. Let ZadLoop hot-load it. Restart only if your ZadLoop build explicitly asks you to. ### Command line ```powershell cd "$env:APPDATA\ZadLoop\harness\profiles\web" pnpm add "C:\path\to\dsh-zadloop-ultimate-toolkit-2.0.2.tgz" ``` Add `dsh-zadloop-ultimate-toolkit` once to `dsh.profile.bundles` if your package manager does not do that automatically. ## Feature guide ### OAuth Subscriptions and live plan quota Open **Subscriptions** in the sidebar to manage accounts, quotas, models, usage, and provider settings through the bundled `dsh-plugin-oauth-subs` workbench. The toolkit keeps the upstream plugin's authentication and token handling unchanged. A compact plan control now sits with Themes, Transfer, and the session-mode control under the composer. It automatically finds the connected subscription provider exposing rolling limits and shows its **5-hour** and **weekly** percentages remaining directly in the dock. Clicking it opens a small glass summary with two progress lines without leaving the chat. Low remaining quota is highlighted without changing any authentication or provider behavior. The workbench has toolkit-scoped visual improvements for clearer cards, provider navigation, active states, spacing, and small-screen behavior. The same presentation layer replaces the malformed Transfer and Delegate graphics with fixed 14px outline icons without touching other ZadLoop icons. ### Remote Control Open **Remote** in the bottom dock and click **Create secure remote link**. The plugin automatically: 1. Detects Cloudflare Tunnel or installs it silently through Windows Package Manager. 2. Generates a strong access code and stores only its salted hash. 3. Starts a temporary encrypted Quick Tunnel. 4. Shows one **Copy link + code** button for sharing the invite. No domain, Cloudflare account, router configuration, port forwarding, or manual password creation is needed. Advanced setup remains available for these connection modes: - **Local browser** listens only on `127.0.0.1`; a password is optional. - **LAN / IP** makes ZadLoop available to devices on the same network and requires a passphrase. - **Quick Tunnel** creates a temporary `trycloudflare.com` address and requires a passphrase. - **Custom domain** runs an existing Cloudflare named tunnel using its UUID, hostname, and credentials file. Click **Save & start**, then copy the live URL. A signed-in remote browser receives the complete ZadLoop interface: chats, settings, plugins, Theme Studio, transfer, mode switching, and agent tools. The toolbar shows active sessions; **Revoke sessions** disconnects them immediately and **Stop remote access** closes the listener and tunnel. Remote access is off after first installation. Passphrases are stored only as salted scrypt hashes. Network modes cannot be started without one, login attempts are rate-limited, and the private local ZadLoop browser credential is never sent to a visitor. Quick/custom tunnel modes bind only to loopback; LAN mode does not create a firewall rule automatically. ![Remote Control setup panel](docs/images/remote-control.svg) ### Computer Use Ask for a desktop task naturally. The agent uses `computer_access` to enable control when needed, operates through screenshots, then can pause access when finished. **Computer** in the bottom dock still provides live status, manual 15–120 minute controls, and **Pause now** for terminating an in-flight action. Then ask naturally, for example: - “Open Settings and enable Night light.” - “Use the browser to download my latest invoice.” - “Open this spreadsheet and sort the table by date.” The model receives a new screenshot after every action and can move, click, double-click, right-click, drag, scroll, type Unicode text, and press shortcuts such as `CTRL+L` or `ALT+TAB`. Coordinates remain accurate on scaled and multi-monitor desktops. ![Computer Use control center](docs/images/computer-use.svg) Use a vision-capable model. Supervise consequential work and pause before passwords, payments, account changes, or other sensitive actions. ### Context Surgery Use the actions under an assistant message: - **Edit reply** changes visible reply text while preserving reasoning and tool calls. - **Edit reasoning** changes only the reasoning stream. - **Remove** shadows that message from the model-visible context through an append-only surface replacement. - `/context list`, `/context edit`, `/context thin

plugins.description: DSH plugin that lets the model drive the right-Sidebar browser: read pages, click, type, navigate, switch phone/tablet/desktop viewport sizes, and screenshot. Desktop only; never touches app.asar.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-browser

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Let the model actually **use** the DSH right-Sidebar browser: read a page's text,
click and type in it, navigate, size the viewport, and take screenshots — from
ordinary tool calls in the conversation.

It also adds a **phone / tablet / desktop / custom viewport switcher**, so you can
see how a site renders at another size without leaving the app.

```
browser_navigate { url: "https://example.com" }
browser_read     { mode: "elements" }     -> refs e1, e2, …
browser_act      { action: "type", ref: "e1", text: "hello" }
browser_act      { action: "click", ref: "e2" }
browser_screenshot {}                     -> see the layout
browser_viewport { preset: "phone" }      -> re-render at 390×844
```

> **Desktop only.** The tools drive an Electron `<webview>` guest. In Web
> profiles the Sidebar browser is a sandboxed cross-origin `<iframe>`, whose DOM
> cannot be read at all, so the tools answer with an explicit reason naming the
> Web profile instead of pretending to work. `browser_tabs` still lists those
> tabs — as `mounted: true` with `carrier: "iframe"` — so you can see that the
> tab exists and why it cannot be driven.

> **Third-party, non-invasive plugin.** It mounts from your DSH profile, never
> touches `app.asar`, and leaves the built-in browser exactly as shipped.

- [Install](#install) — one command, or the Plugins page
- [Tools](#tools) — what the model can call
- [Which size to use](#which-size-to-use) — pick desktop or phone, not the default
- [Viewport sizes](#viewport-sizes-phone--desktop--custom) — the UI side
- [Compatibility](#compatibility) — verified against DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`
- [Known limitations](#known-limitations) — read before filing an issue

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `browser_tabs` | List this Session's browser tabs: id, title, url, loading state, **whether the load failed** (`failed`), whether the identity was inferred (`unverified`), whether each is mounted and drivable, which is `active`, and its `carrier` (`webview` on Desktop, `iframe` on Web). |
| `browser_read` | Read a tab: `mode: 'text'` (default) for visible text, `'elements'` for the interactive elements you can act on, `'html'` for page HTML. Check `failed` first — a failed load reads as empty. `truncated` means the element cap was reached — hidden elements are filtered out silently and never counted as truncation. |
| `browser_act` | `click`, `type`, `press`, `scroll`, `select`, `reload`, or `wait`. Target an element by the `ref` from a `'elements'` read, or by a CSS `selector`. `reload` takes `ignoreCache: true` to bypass the cache. `wait` with a `selector` becomes a real wait — see *Waiting for the page* below. |
| `browser_screenshot` | Capture the visible viewport as an image block the model can see. Pass a `preset` to size and capture in one call; the result reports the size it actually used and whether the page was confirmed to have reflowed (`confirmed`). A failed page is refused rather than captured. |
| `browser_navigate` | Open a URL in a new tab, or navigate an existing one. |
| `browser_viewport` | Read or change the tab's viewport size: `auto`, `phone` (390×844), `tablet` (834×1112), `desktop` (1280×800) or `custom`. The page reflows for real, so its own responsive breakpoints apply. Omit `tabId` to target the only mounted tab; the read always reports the tab it resolved. `custom` appears only for the `custom` preset. |
| `browser_close` | Close one tab of this Session, so tabs opened while investigating something can be cleaned up. Closure is confirmed before the call reports success. |
| `browser_eval` | Run JavaScript in the page — the only way to read layout geometry (`getBoundingClientRect`, `scrollHeight`, `getComputedStyle`). **Always listed; refuses until `enableEval: true`** (see configuration), so the capability is discoverable instead of unguessable. An expression returns its value; a statement body returns what it explicitly `return`s. |

A typical loop:

```
browser_navigate { url: "https://example.com" }
browser_read     { mode: "elements" }          -> refs e1, e2, …
browser_act      { action: "type", ref: "e1", text: "hello" }
browser_act      { action: "click", ref: "e2" }
browser_read     { mode: "text" }              -> confirm what changed
browser_screenshot { preset: "desktop" }       -> see the real desktop layout
browser_screenshot { preset: "phone" }         -> and the 390px-wide one
browser_close    { tabId: "tab4" }             -> tidy up when finished
```

`tabId` may be omitted whenever the Session has exactly one mounted browser tab.
With several, call `browser_tabs` first and name the one you mean.

### Reading a failed page

Three fields describe three different things, and none of them can be inferred
from the others:

| Field | Means |
|---|---|
| `mounted` | The tab is in the DOM and could be driven — **not** that it loaded. |
| `loading` | Electron says a navigation is in flight. A *failed* load is not loading. |
| `failed` | The tab is on Chrome's network-error page, so there is no site content. |

So `mounted: true, loading: false, failed: true` is a completely ordinary
combination: a tab that is open and finished failing. Before `failed` existed, a
page that never loaded looked identical to a healthy one, and the only way to
tell was to read it and notice the text was empty.

`unverified: true` is the other half: the page could not be asked anything (its
renderer is wedged, or the document is unreachable), so `url` and `title` are the
last navigation's, not the current document's. Treat them as a hint, not a fact.

Both matter for screenshots, which is where the confusion cost the most: a
capture is **refused** when either is set. A failed load paints Chrome's error
page, and a wedged renderer paints a blank surface — either way the image is not
the site, and returning it as a successful capture is how a page that never
loaded gets mistaken for a page that "did not render". Note that `failed` cannot
even be evaluated when the page is unscriptable, so `unverified` is doing real
work rather than restating it.

So `unverified` is deliberately *not* just a warning label: it is the condition
that makes a capture unverifiable. Inside a capture the identity probe is given
more patience than elsewhere (up to 4 s) precisely so a genuinely heavy page —
the several-iframes case a 15 s budget exists for — is not refused merely for
being briefly busy.

Note that this is about *transport* failures only. An HTTP error the site itself
rendered — a 404 page — is a real document and stays fully readable and
screenshotable.

## Waiting for the page

`browser_act { action: "wait" }` has two forms, and the difference matters on any
page a framework renders.

**A fixed sleep** — `{ action: "wait", timeoutMs: 2500 }` — sleeps and returns.
Rarely what you want, for a reason worth stating: the plugin's own notion of "the
page has loaded" is Electron's **navigation** state, which a single-page app
clears as soon as its HTML and scripts arrive, long before React (or anything
else) has mounted and painted. So the page reports itself loaded while the screen
is still empty, and a sleep is a guess that is too short on a slow machine and
wasted on a fast one. A report measured exactly that: a 2500 ms guess in a loop
that ran ten times.

**A named condition** waits for something observable instead:

```
browser_act { action: "wait", selector: ".todo-list", state: "visible" }
```

- `state: "visible"` (the default) — the element is **drawn**. This is what "the
  app has rendered" usually means.
- `state: "attached"` — the element merely **exists**. Weaker, and worth knowing
  about: an element can exist while `display: none`. A report counted hidden rows
  as present and concluded a layout had no overflow, so the two are kept distinct.
- `state: "hidden"` — satisfied by **absent as well as invisible**, so it works for
  waiting out a spinner that gets removed rather than hidden.

Omit `timeoutMs` and the wait uses the rest of the call's own budget (still
bounded, never longer than the call).

The condition is polled **inside the page**, so one tool call watches for

plugins.description: DSH 微信通道增强插件 — 集成 iLink 消息双向桥接、单实例锁、大文件智能投递与 Web 设置管理界面
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-weixin-plus

> DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 微信通道全功能增强插件。

集成了手机微信与 DSH 之间的实时双向消息桥接、单实例选举守护锁、大文件本地智能投递与 Web 端原生设置管理面板。

---

## 核心特性

1. **双向消息与媒体桥接**：手机微信发消息直通 DSH 会话，支持文本与双向多媒体传输。
2. **Web 设置与管理面板**：
   - 嵌入 DSH 设置中心「微信通道」标签页。
   - 实时探测微信服务端连通性与 Token 有效期（过期即时预警）。
   - 内置一键重新扫码登录，动态渲染 Base64 二维码与直链。
   - 支持一键断开连接并安全清理本地凭证。
3. **免 403 健壮通讯**：
   - 首创基于 Cordis `connection.rpc` 通道双向通信，天然免疫 Electron 与常规浏览器模式下的安全拦截与 403 鉴权错误。
   - 优雅兼容 HTTP RESTful 路由回退。
4. **单实例选举锁 (ilink-owner.lock)**：
   - 防止多宿主（如 GUI 与后台无头服务）同时消费消息导致的游标竞争与丢消息问题。
5. **大文件智能转接 (filepush17)**：
   - 智能识别超过微信体积限制的本地文件并安全暂存。
6. **大图无损智能分流防 500 (filepush18 / v1.0.5)**：
   - 智能识别出站图片大小：≤2MB 走图片气泡直显，>2MB 自动无损升维走微信 25MB 原图文件通道，彻底杜绝微信官方 CDN 500 报错并 100% 保留原始像素。
   - 内置自愈热补丁，加载时自动增强底层 SDK，跨机器安装零配置生效。

---

## 安装与配置

在 DSH `cordis.patch.yml` 中启用：

```yaml
- id: weixin-plus
  plugin: ./node_modules/dsh-weixin-plus/index.js
```

并在 `package.json` 中引入依赖：

```json
"dependencies": {
  "dsh-weixin-plus": "github:liushQAQ/dsh-weixin-plus"
}
```

---

## 架构

- `index.js`: 宿主端逻辑，包括 iLink 轮询、会话挂载、单实例选举、Cordis RPC 与 WebServer 路由。
- `client.js`: 客户端 React 前端，挂载在 `settings.section`（id: `weixin`）。
- `cordis.patch.yml`: 插件装配声明。

plugins.description: Signed chain-of-custody for DeepSeek Harness sessions — hash-chained, ed25519-signed records of what the agent actually did, commits bound into the chain
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-attest-chain

Signed chain-of-custody for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) sessions.

Headless agents bypass PR gates entirely; chat UIs show what the agent *said*
it did. This plugin records what the agent actually **did**: every watched
tool result (`bash`, `write`, `edit`, `web_fetch`, …) appends a hash-chained,
ed25519-signed custody record to a durable JSONL ledger. Tamper with any line
and the chain breaks; delete the tail and it no longer matches the published
head. Zero LLM calls in the trust path.

Family: **dsh-read-guard** guards what the agent reads, **dsh-pr-gate** gates
what it writes, **dsh-attest-chain** proves what it did.

## Why now (checked 2026-10-12)

Nothing in the dsh plugin ecosystem produces tamper-evident records of agent
activity. The nearest neighbours inventory plugins (`dsh-harbor`, 24★ — a
read-only list of what's *installed*) or add LLM-based reviewing. The
in-toto-shaped lane — signed, verifiable, CI-consumable evidence of what an
agent session did — is empty. The signing core is vendored from
[agent-attest](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/agent-attest), whose CI gate
can consume this ledger as session-side evidence.

## How it works

```
tool result ──> custody record {time, tool, callId, isError, sha256(content)}
            ──> chained: digest = sha256(canonicalJSON({seq, prevDigest, record}))
            ──> signed: ed25519 over the digest (keypair in .dsh-attest-chain/keys/)
            ──> appended: .dsh-attest-chain/session.jsonl (one line, strict order)
```

Verification is pure and offline: replay the ledger, recompute every digest,
check every link and signature. Publish the head digest (or the public key)
anywhere durable — a PR description, a CI variable — and any later comparison
detects tampering or truncation deterministically.

A keypair is generated on first run; the private half never leaves the
machine running the agent. `sign: false` runs a digest-only chain if you only
need tamper-evidence against a published head.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-attest-chain
```

From npm — no build step, no `allowBuilds` authorization; git installs are equally prebuilt (`lib/` ships in the repo).



## Configure

```yaml
- id: dsh-attest-chain
  name: dsh-attest-chain
  config:
    tools: [bash, write, edit, str_replace_editor, web_fetch]
    ledgerPath: .dsh-attest-chain/session.jsonl
    keysDir: .dsh-attest-chain/keys
    sign: true
```

Add `.dsh-attest-chain/` to your repository's `.gitignore` — the private key must
never be committed; the public key is what a verifier checks.

## Compatibility

- **DSH**: verified against the 0.2.x line (source snapshot 0.2.1-alpha.2); installs on any profile via `dsh plugin add` (prebuilt `lib/`, no build approval).
- **Node**: >= 20 (CI matrix: Node 20/22/24 on Ubuntu and Windows).
- **Disposable-profile evidence (2026-10-19)**: `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-attest-chain` → installed in 30s; boot shows `[dsh-attest-chain] active: …`; `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> remove dsh-attest-chain` → dependencies cleared, bundles restored.

## Develop

```sh
npm install
npm test   # syncs the vendored agent-attest core, builds, runs unit tests
```

The canonical-JSON serializer and ed25519 PEM helpers are vendored from the
sibling `agent-attest` checkout (`npm run sync`; CI runs `sync --check`).

## Roadmap

- Session-end in-toto statement envelope (full interop with agent-attest CI)
- Per-session ledgers keyed by session id
- A `verify` tool card: replay + verdict inside the Web UI
- GitHub check-run bridge: head digest posted to the PR

## Kill criteria

If dsh ships first-party signed session records, or a major plugin-adds
attestation natively, this freezes at its last working version with a
postmortem here. The signing core stays owned by agent-attest either way.

plugins.description: The Coreness kit for DeepSeek Harness — a plugin bundle for a profile.
plugins.readme_text:
# Coreness for DeepSeek Harness **A page, a journal and a brake for a DeepSeek Harness profile.** Coreness is the product for one DeepSeek Harness profile: a page with the profile's MCP servers, its Qoder provider and its rate limits and usage; the journal of what the profile and its sessions do; and the rules of the tree in force. It installs as it is: the halves the browser loads are plain files, served where they lie — nothing is built, nothing is compiled, and what is installed is what runs. ## ⚡ Install **The application installs its own plugins.** *Plugins* → *Add plugin* takes a package name, a tarball, a git address or a local path, and the package goes into the profile the application is running — one door for the desktop application and for the web one, and no profile to name: ``` github:Vensus137/Coreness-DSH ``` The same page switches the package off without removing it, and takes it off again. That address follows the newest release, and what stands published is a release — so the address and the newest release are one thing here. A fixed release is named by its own tag — `…Coreness-DSH#v0.6.0` — and a released tag is never moved: that line gives the same code whenever it is run.
By command line — for a terminal; nothing above needs it The line is ready to run as it stands, because the desktop application's own profile carries that name: ``` dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Vensus137/Coreness-DSH ``` Another profile is named by its own name instead — the web surface's is `web` — and naming a profile that does not stand yet creates it. `dsh` is the application's own command and is not one Windows or macOS comes with, so until the application puts it on the path a terminal answers *not recognized*. The application does that from its own menu: in the window's title bar beside the app icon, **Application** → **Manage dsh Command…** — the dialog shows the location it manages, and the same dialog takes the command off the path again. A terminal opened before that act keeps the path it started with, so open a new one afterwards.
The profile's composition is read when the application starts, so the package becomes live at the next start, and the platform says itself when a change it made needs a restart. Nothing is built on the way in and no permission for install scripts is asked: the package is plain files, and the address is fetched over the network the application already uses rather than by a git client — a machine without git installs it. ## ✨ What a profile gets - 🗂 **A page of its own** — the profile's MCP servers as cards, its Qoder provider and its rate limits and usage; the sections stand in the rail, and the version stands beside the name. - 🔌 **The MCP servers, seen and edited** — one card per server: its kind, its address, the environment it needs, and switches whose effect lands in the profile rather than in a copy. - 📓 **The journal** — the environment's memory: what changed in the profile and what a participant did, kept as records that carry a kind, an area, a name and an author. - 🚦 **A limiter that waits instead of refusing** — a call over the limit takes its turn in a queue; nothing is limited as the package ships. - 🧠 **A route to the Qoder models** — the account's own models, each with the reasoning levels it accepts and the output budget it allows. The account's token is entered once, in the Qoder section, and kept by the platform's own store; no value of it stands in the package. The credits foot reads the balance while the account is reachable. - 📜 **The rules of its own tree, in force** — one prompt section, registered through the platform's own prompt registry, so a session of the profile carries them in every request and no compaction can take them out of the model's sight. ## 🧩 What it needs - **DeepSeek Harness.** The version this package was built against is declared in the manifest, and the application compares that declaration with its own before a profile imports a plugin: a mismatch leaves the plugin out and says so, instead of failing quietly later. - **A Qoder account,** for the Qoder route and the credits foot; the token is entered in the Qoder section and kept by the platform's own store. ## 📦 What lands Exactly the list the package's manifest names — the bundle and the seven packages, each with its own README beside its code. No part of the workshop they are built in: the contracts, the checks and the notes of this project stay where the work is done. ## 🧭 What it deliberately does not do - It is not a second door to the platform's own acts: enabling, disabling, installing and removing belong to the application's Plugins page, and this package reports what stands rather than competing with it. - It does not own the MCP side: the platform owns the servers, the connection and the registry, while this package owns the picture and the form. - It limits nothing until a limit is declared. ## 📄 License MIT.

plugins.description: Trae CN as a native DeepSeek Harness LLM provider: browser OAuth login by default, an opt-in local-install credential source, and an OpenAI-compatible surface on the host web server.
plugins.readme_text:
# trae-cn-provider 把 **Trae CN** 作为一个**原生 LLM provider** 接入 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）。 安装后 Trae 的模型会直接出现在 DSH 的模型选择器里，也可以额外开出一个 OpenAI 兼容接口给 Cline / Claude Code 之类的客户端用。 macOS 优先、源码可审计、**凭据不出本机**。 --- ## ⚠️ 先读这一段：风险声明 1. **本项目违反 Trae（字节跳动）的使用条款。** 它把 Trae 客户端内部的接口当作通用 LLM API 使用，这不是官方支持的用法。 2. **你的 Trae 账号有被封禁的风险。** 请自行判断是否接受。 3. 消耗的是**你自己账号的额度/积分**。本项目不提供、不转让、不代充任何额度。 4. 本项目与 Trae、字节跳动**没有任何关系**，未获其授权或背书。 5. 请**不要**把本插件连同你的凭据一起分发。凭据只应存在于你自己的机器上。 6. 作者不对因使用本项目产生的任何后果负责（包括但不限于账号封禁、额度损失、数据问题）。**如果你不接受以上任何一条，请不要安装。** --- ## 它做什么 - 以 DSH **原生 `LlmAdapter`** 的形式注册一个 provider route：`trae-cn` - 模型自动出现在模型选择器（从 Trae 的模型目录实时拉取） - 支持流式正文、思考链（reasoning）、原生 function calling、上下文窗口、思考档位 - 支持**图片输入**（多模态模型）：DSH 的图片块经 attachments 缝内联为 data URL；OpenAI 层也接受 `image_url` - 可选：在宿主已有的 web server 上挂一个 OpenAI 兼容面（`/v1/models`、`/v1/chat/completions`），**不自己占用端口** - 同时提供一个独立 CLI，可脱离 DSH 单独当本地代理跑 ## 它不做什么 - 不代理、不中转、不上传任何凭据到第三方。**代码里出网的域名只有 Trae 官方域名**（见「出网清单」）。 - 不共享额度给别人，不做多账号池，不做额度转卖。 - 不修改 Trae 客户端，不 hook 它的进程。 --- ## 安装 ```bash # 从 npm 安装到 web profile（安装即激活：会自动追加进 dsh.profile.bundles） dsh plugin --profile web add trae-cn-provider # 桌面版：需要先完全退出 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用 dsh plugin --profile desktop add trae-cn-provider ``` > **桌面 profile 的坑**：`dsh plugin --profile desktop` 要求桌面应用完全退出后再执行 > （否则报 `Open DeepSeek Harness Desktop once to initialize its profile, then fully quit it`）。 > 卸载：`dsh plugin --profile

remove trae-cn-provider`。 安装后重启对应 profile 即可。模型选择器里会出现 **Trae CN** 分组。 --- ## 登录与凭据来源 插件有三档凭据来源，通过 `credentialSource` 配置： | 值 | 行为 | 需要浏览器 | 包内是否存在解密凭据的代码路径 | |---|---|---|---| | `oauth`（**默认**） | 只在 DSH 里走一次浏览器登录，凭据存本机 | 是（一次） | **否** | | `local` | 直接读本机已登录的 Trae 客户端凭据 | 否 | **是（显式开启才生效）** | | `auto` | 先看已保存的 OAuth 凭据，没有再看本机客户端 | 视情况 | 是（同上） | ### `oauth`（默认，推荐） 在 DSH 里执行登录命令（默认 `/trae-login`），会打开浏览器到 Trae 官方授权页： ``` https://www.trae.cn/authorization?...&auth_callback_url=http://127.0.0.1:/authorize ``` **实测发现：Trae 的回调不是下发授权码，而是直接把凭据塞进回调参数**（`userJwt` 是 URL 编码的 JSON，含 `Token` / `RefreshToken` / `TokenExpireAt`；`userInfo` 含 `UserID` / `Name`）。所以不存在「换码」这一步。回调只在 `127.0.0.1` 上临时监听，拿完即关。 凭据默认落在 `~/.trae-proxy/credentials.json`（权限 `0600`）。若 DSH 的 `credentials` 服务可用，会优先存进那里。 目录可以用环境变量 `TRAE_PROXY_CRED_DIR` 覆盖（测试用它做隔离；也可以在你想把凭据放到别处时用）。 ### `local`（可选，零摩擦） 直接读本机 Trae 客户端的登录态，**不需要浏览器**。支持两种存储格式，运行时自动嗅探： | edition | 存储格式 | 上游 | |---|---|---| | `cn` Trae CN | `tc` 加密 | `trae-api-cn.mchost.guru` | | `solo` TRAE SOLO CN | `tc` 加密 | `trae-api-cn.mchost.guru` | | `sg` Trae 国际版 | 明文 JSON | `a0ai-api-sg.byteintlapi.com` | | `solo-sg` TRAE SOLO | `tc` 加密 | `a0ai-api-sg.byteintlapi.com` | 路径：macOS `~/Library/Application Support//User/globalStorage/storage.json`，Windows `%APPDATA%\\User\globalStorage\storage.json`。 > **必须知道的取舍**：`tc` 格式的密钥材料**完全内嵌在密文自身**（第 6–38 字节派生），不需要 macOS Keychain，也不受它保护 —— 这意味着**本机任何能读到那个 `storage.json` 的进程都能解出你的 Trae token**。这是 Trae 自身格式的性质，不是本插件引入的。 > > 选择 `local` 会让包内存在这条解密路径。如果你关心「发布包里有没有解密凭据的代码」，请保持默认的 `oauth`。 > **`local` 随时可能失效，这是正常现象。** `storage.json` 归 Trae 客户端所有，它会自己改写这个文件 —— 退出登录、重置登录态、原地迁移都会把 `iCubeAuthInfo://icube.cloudide` 这个键删掉（本机实测发生过：该键在客户端运行期间被移除，只留下设备密钥和 usertag）。 > > 所以不要把 `local` 当成长期可靠的来源： > > - 想省事又要稳，用 `auto`（已保存的浏览器登录优先，本机凭据兜底）。 > - 键消失时插件会返回 502 并说明是哪个 edition 缺什么，**不会崩溃**；按提示在客户端重新登录，或换回 `oauth`。 > - `edition: auto` 会按 `cn → solo → sg → solo-sg` 顺序挑第一个能读的，但**不校验它的过期时间**，可能选中一个很久以前就过期的凭据（本机 `sg` 就是 2 月的）。这种时候上游会返回认证错误，看错误里的 edition 就知道换哪个了。 --- ## 配置 通过 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖： ```yaml - id: trae-cn config: credentialSource: oauth # oauth | local | auto edition: cn # local/auto 时读哪个 edition requestStyle: chat_v3 # chat_v3（实测可用）| inline_chat（实验，实测失败） appVersionCode: 20260901 # 必须是纯整数，见下方说明 ideVersion: '' # 留空 = 从本机 Trae 安装读取 displayName: Trae CN loginCommand: trae-login mountOpenAIEndpoint: true openAIPath: /trae-cn # 挂载前缀（不是 base URL）：对外接口为 /trae-cn/v1/... ``` `appVersionCode` 会作为 `x-app-version-code` / `x-ide-version-code` 发送。**它必须是纯整数**：带点的值（例如 `2.3.90452`）会被上游以 `bad request: binding: expr_path=app_version_code, cause=parameter type does not match binding data` 拒绝。 而且**网关按该值的数值大小做灰度**，值越小返回的 function 配置越少。实测阈值： | 取值 | 目录条目 | 过滤后可聊天模型 | |---|---|---| | `20260401` | 42 | 7 | | `20260701` | 46 | — | | **`>= 20260901`** | **57** | **20（完整目录）** | 默认值已取 `20260901`，无需手工配置即可看到全部模型。本机 `product.json` 的 `traeVersionCode`（`20250325`）偏旧，`detectEnv()` 只会取「不比基准旧」的值。 --- ## OpenAI 兼容接口 `mountOpenAIEndpoint: true`（默认）时，挂在宿主 web server 的 `openAIPath` 下： | 方法 | 路径 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | GET | `/trae-cn/v1/models` | 模型列表 | | POST | `/trae-cn/v1/chat/completions` | 对话（流式 / 非流式，含 `reasoning_content` 与 tool calls） | | GET | `/trae-cn/health` | 健康检查 | 独立 CLI 也可以把同样的接口跑在自有端口上： ```bash node src/cli.js login # 浏览器登录 node src/cli.js models # 列出模型 node src/cli.js serve --port 8317 [--api-key ] node src/cli.js chat "你好" ``` --- ## 可用模型 模型目录是从上游实时拉取的，不在代码里硬编码。本机实测（2026-10）过滤后 **20 个**用户可选模型： | config_name | 显示名 | 思考档位 | |---|---|---| | `Doubao-Seed-Evolving` | Seed-Evolving | yes | | `Doubao-Seed-2.1-Pro` | Seed-2.1-Pro-0915 | `light` / `high` | | `Doubao-Seed-2.1-Turbo` | Seed-2.1-Turbo | `light` / `high` | | `Doubao-Seed-Code` | Seed-Code | `light` / `high` | | `mimo-v2.6-flash` | MiMo-V2.6-Flash | yes | | `mimo-v2.6-pro` | MiMo-V2.6-Pro | yes | | `step-5-preview` | Step-5-Preview | `light` / `high` | | `glm-5.3-flashx` | GLM-5.3-FlashX | `light` / `high` / `extra_high` | | `glm-5.3-flash` | GLM-5.3-Flash | `light` / `high` / `extra_high` | | `glm-5.3` | GLM-5.3 | `light` / `high` / `extra_high` | | `glm-5.2` | GLM-5.2 | `high` / `extra_high` | | `deepseek-v4.1-flash` | DeepSeek-V4-Flash 正式版 | `light` / `high` / `extra_high` | | `DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Official` | DeepSeek-V4-Flash | `light` / `high` / `extra_high` | | `DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Official` | DeepSeek-V4-Pro | `light` / `high` / `extra_high` | | `kimi-k3` | Kimi-K3 | `light` / `high` / `extra_high` | | `kimi-k2.8-preview` | Kimi-K2.8-Preview | `light` / `high` / `extra_high` | | `minimax-m3` | MiniMax-M3 | — | | `qwen3.8-flash` | Qwen3.8-Flash | `light` / `high` / `extra_high` | | `qwen3.8-max` | Qwen3.8-Max | `light` / `high` / `extra_high` | | `qwen-3.7-plus` | Qwen3.7-Plus | — | 目录共 57 条，其余条目（`custom_model_*` 占位、内部工具模型、`is_invisible_to_user` 的旧条目）不是可用的聊天模型，已按上游标记过滤掉 —— 放宽过滤**不会**多出可用模型，只会多出噪音。 > **两个决定目录大小的独立维度**（缺一不可，只改一个会静默停在旧目录）： > 1. `appVersionCode` 的**数值大小**（灰度阈值，见上文）。 > 2. 登录设备的 `DeviceName` —— 留成 `TraeProxy` 会被上游识别为非真客户端，只回 2 条 trial 兜底目录。现已默认取本机短主机名，可用 `TRAE_PROXY_DEVICE_NAME` 覆盖。 --- ## 与同类项目的差异 生态里已有几个同类项目，写清楚差异免得你重复踩坑： | 项目 | 形态 | 与我们不同的地方 | |---|---|---| | [`dsh-trae-api`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-trae-api) | DSH 插件 + 独立 HTTP 服务 | 它的目录路径写死 `%APPDATA%`，**正主在 macOS 上 100% 不可用**；且把 token **明文写进包目录下的 `.env`**；默认 API Key 硬编码；1.0.0/1.0.1 曾绑 `0.0.0.0` 且无鉴权（1.0.2 才修） | | `@casually/dsh-trae-api` | 同上（fork） | 修了 macOS 路径，**只做 HTTP 服务**，不是 DSH 原生 provider | | `@hajilongshi/dsh-trae-api` | 同上（fork） | 功能最全，但**声明的 GitHub 仓库 404**、维护者 GitHub 账号不存在，溯源无法核验 | | [Trae-Relay](https://github.com/sdn205/Trae-Relay) | Windows 单 exe（C++） | 仅 Windows；用它做协议参考（本项目的协议事实来源之一） | | [Trae-Proxy](https://github.com/arch3rPro/Trae-Proxy) | 反方向 | 是「把自己的 key 塞进 Trae」，与本项目方向相反 | 本项目的做法不同： - **DSH 原生 `LlmAdapter`**，不是外部 HTTP 服务的壳 —— 工具调用、思考档位、usage 走 DSH 原生类型，不经过有损的 OpenAI 转换 - **不自己 listen 端口**，OpenAI 兼容面挂在宿主 web server 上 - 企业版账号的刷新按账号自身的 host 走（见下），这是同类项目普遍没处理的 - 凭据落在用户目录的 `0600` 文件，不落在包目录 - 全部出网域名可枚举、有完整性校验、凭据不进日志 --- ## 实测验证状态 下面这些是**在真机上用真实账号跑过**的，不是推断： | 能力 | 结果 | |---|---| | 模型目录 `get_detail_param` | 200，57 条 config → 过滤后 20 个用户模型（`appVersionCode >= 20260901`） | | 流式对话 `llm_utils_chat` | 正文 + `reasoning_content` 增量正常 | | usage | 平铺字段正常，**prompt cache 生效**（实测 `cached_tokens: 128`） | | 原生 function calling | 完整 `tool_calls`：`get_weather {"city":"北京"}` | | `finish` 语义 | 上游在带工具调用时也回 `finish_reason: "stop"`，已按实测改成 `{kind:'tool-calls'}` | | OpenAI 兼容层 | `/v1/models`、`/v1/chat/completions`（流式 + 非流式） | | 多模态图片输入 | 96×96 纯红 PNG 走**两条路径**都实测通过：DSH `{type:'image'}` 块 + attachments 缝，以及 OpenAI 层的

plugins.description: Interview users one frontier at a time: a grill-me skill plugin for DeepSeek Harness (MIT, independent implementation of mattpocock/skills grill-me)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-grill-me

DSH 插件：把 `mattpocock/skills` 里的 **grill-me / grilling** 技能做成能装、能跑、而且**确定性生效**的 DSH 插件，并把同一份上游里的 **grill-with-docs / domain-modeling** 一起移植进来 —— 后两个额外加了一条**文档通道**：访谈过程中答应的 ADR / 术语表只要没落盘，就不算谈完。

上游 grill-me 是一段提示词：它要求模型把计划当成一棵**设计树**来审问，一轮把整个 **frontier**（前提已落定、现在就能问的决策）一次问完，每题给出推荐答案，然后**等用户回答**；只有 frontier 为空、并且用户确认达成共识之后，才允许动手。

提示词会被模型忘记。这个插件在提示词之外加了一层**确定性的状态机**：它从会话记录（transcript）里推导当前处于第几轮、哪些问题还没答、frontier 是否为空，然后

- 在模型每一步之前注入当前 frontier 的状态指令（并且每一步只保留一份，不重复堆叠）；
- 在模型违反协议时（比如刚问完一轮就跑去调工具、装依赖、动手改文件）用一次纠偏消息把它拉回来；
- `grill-with-docs` 模式下另记一本**文档账**：模型用 `📄 ADR: <标题>` / `📄 术语: <词>` 承诺要写的文件，没写就不给「访谈完成」；
- 提供 `/grill-me`、`/grill-with-docs` 两条命令和 `grill_status` 工具，让你随时查看面试进度。

状态机是纯函数、只读转录、无副作用；所有判断都能用会话记录复现。

## 安装（从 GitHub）

插件本体零依赖，装的是一个真正的 bundle 包（`package.json` 里声明了 `dsh.bundle`，挂载行写在自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，**不需要手改 profile 任何文件**）。

```powershell
# 把 <profile> 换成你的 profile 名（桌面版通常就是 desktop）
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/huang2005-hj/dsh-plugin-grill-me/releases/download/v0.4.0/dsh-plugin-grill-me-0.4.0.tgz
```

装完**重启 DSH**，然后在插件管理里确认 `dsh-plugin-grill-me` 处于启用状态。装好后 `skills` 目录里会出现 `grill-me`、`grilling`、`grill-with-docs`、`domain-modeling` 四个技能，`/grill-me`、`/grill-with-docs` 两条命令与 `grill_status` 工具随即可用。

- 想核对拿到的东西没被改过：同一页 release 里的 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 列出了两个资产的 SHA256，装之前对一下即可。
- 想连源码一起拿：同一页 release 里的 `grill-me-dsh-src-0.4.0.zip`（13 个文件，解压后 `node test/state.test.mjs` 即可复跑测试，零依赖、不需要 `npm install`）。
- 也可直接从仓库安装（拉源码）：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:huang2005-hj/dsh-plugin-grill-me`。

## 装法（本机开发用）

```powershell
# 1) 打包（插件本体零依赖，直接就是可安装目录）
cd <仓库根目录>

# 2) 用 DSH 的 plugin_manager 装进当前 profile（本地目录）
#    在 DSH 会话里让模型调用 plugin_manager：
#      action=install_bundle, target=<本地目录或 npm 包名>
```

装好后 `desktop` profile 的 `patchReload: "live"` 会让它立即生效；`skills` 目录里出现 `grill-me`、`grilling`、`grill-with-docs`、`domain-modeling` 四个技能。

## 用法

| 入口 | 谁触发 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/grill-me` | 用户 | 上游的 wrapper：只负责加载 `grilling`。**模型不会自己调用它**（`modelInvocable: false`，等价于上游的 `disable-model-invocation: true`）。 |
| `/grill-with-docs` | 用户 | 上游的 wrapper：先 `grilling` 再 `domain-modeling`，也就是「拷问 + 把定下来的东西当场写成 ADR / 术语表」。同样 `modelInvocable: false`。 |
| `/grilling`、`/domain-modeling`、`skill` 工具、触发词 | 用户 / 模型 | 两个协议本体：`grilling` 是访谈，`domain-modeling` 是文档纪律（术语表 + ADR）。 |
| `grill_status` | 模型 | 只读工具：返回当前轮次、未答问题、文档欠账、已记录到的违规。 |
| `/grill-me`、`/grill-with-docs` 命令 | 用户 | 打印当前面试状态（后者多一行文档通道）。 |

典型过程：

```
你: /grill-me 帮我审一下「把本地缓存换成 SQLite」这个计划

模型: ❓ **Q1** - **<问题标题>**：<正文>
      ➡️ <推荐答案>
      ---
      ❓ **Q2** - **<问题标题>**：<正文>
      ➡️ <推荐答案>
      （一轮问完，停下等你回答）

你: 1 是，2 选 B，3 你看着办
（插件记为：这一轮已回答）
模型: ❓ **Q3** ...（下一轮 frontier）
...
frontier 为空 → 你说一句「确认」（`可以了`/`没问题`/`开始吧`/`确认理解，开始吧` 之类都行，光秃秃一个 `确认` 也算）→ 此时才允许动手；这句确认**认下就不会被撤回**，之后你再说别的话也不会把它顶掉
```

## 文档通道（grill-with-docs）

上游把这条链拆成两个技能：`grill-with-docs` 只是「先 `grilling`、再 `domain-modeling`」，`domain-modeling` 才是文档纪律本身。上游自己的长文里记着一个已知故障：**文件写入静默不发生** —— 访谈谈完了，答应要写的 ADR 和术语表一个字都没落盘。这个插件把那一半也变成确定性的：

- 模型在正文里用 `📄 ADR: <标题>` / `📄 术语: <词>` 声明要写的东西。**引用不算承诺**：代码块和引用块里的标记不记账。
- 声明即欠账。只有真的调了写文件类工具、且目标路径命中 `docs/adr/**` 或 `**/GLOSSARY.md`，这笔账才算还清。`GLOSSARY-MAP.md`（多上下文索引）算文档、写它不会被纠偏，但它不是术语表，顶不了任何一笔账。连「哪个标题对应哪个文件」都按**文件自己的名字**（去掉目录和 `NNNN-` 前缀）做 slug 匹配：标题完全一致优先，否则取最长的那个能被文件名包含的标题 —— 所以「Use JSON」抢不走「Use JSON for storage」的那次写入。写得对不对、值不值得写，插件**不**判断：那是 `domain-modeling` 三条判据（难回退 / 没上下文会让人困惑 / 是真实取舍）的事，机器只保证「你说要写的，最后必须写出来」。
- 欠账未清时，就算 frontier 空了、你也确认了，模型也拿不到「访谈完成、可以动手」：指令改成列出这些欠账，模型跑去做别的（纯文档写之外的动作）会被纠偏一次。同一步里既写了文档又写了代码算这笔账还清（文件在步骤结束时确实存在），不纠偏；读不出目标路径的写操作既不算还账也不判违规 —— 拿不准时宁可不纠，也不要冤枉一个已经把文档写出来的模型。
- 只有 `grill-with-docs` 模式有这本账；`/grill-me` 与 `grilling` 完全不谈文档，与上游一致。
- 上游 ADR 模板本体只有「标题 + 1–3 句」，`Status` / `Considered Options` / `Consequences` 都是可选段 —— 它也明说多数决策不配 ADR，一次访谈零 ADR 也是正常结果。

## 它到底“确定性”在哪里

- **轮次记账**：`src/state.js` 解析助手消息里的 `❓ **Qn**` 与 `➡️`，得出每一轮的问题清单。**只有带上协议自己的题头**（`❓` 或 `Qn - **标题**`）才算是「问了一轮」：普通行文里写 `Q1: … Q5: …`（季度、清单、复述刚才的问题）不算，否则模型会把自己的正文当真问题、再被指令喂回来，变成没有用户输入也会无限自转的假面试。
- **逐题记账**：一轮之后的第一条真实用户消息按题号逐题结算 —— `1 是` 记成「接受推荐」、`3 选 B` 记成「改选」、回答复述了该题自己的推荐答案（`3 no auth` 对 `➡️ No auth yet`）也算接受、**没提到的题仍然开放**，所以一轮里 Q2 没答不会被 Q1/Q3 带走。题号识别有三条通路：`Q2: …` 这种显式标签、`1 a 2 b 3 c` 这种严格递增 run，以及 `1是2两边都发3同意` 这种数字直接粘在答案上的写法（每个数字都必须真的是本轮还在开放的问题）。不做语义猜测：题号对不上本轮问题就整轮不动；而**只有**「纯肯定」（`都可以` / `yes to all three`）或本轮只剩 1 题还开放时，才会整轮一次性结清，其他没有题号的回复保持本轮开放、绝不替用户做决定。
- **确认要认账**：frontier 清空之后，`CONFIRM_RE`（`确认理解`/`全部确认`/`没问题`/`开始吧`…）算确认；**整条消息就是一个接受词**（`确认`/`同意`/`好的`/`ok`…）也算，不需要模型先写出「共享理解」那种仪式措辞（`GRILL-28`：用户打了一句光秃秃的 `确认`，插件却继续让模型等着）。更关键的是这句确认**属于说出它的那条消息**：0.3.2 每步都按「最新一条人话」重算，于是你确认完随手说一句无关的话（哪怕只是「重启了」），状态就退回 `awaiting-confirmation`，插件又开始劝模型「别动手，等确认」——正好和你的意思相反（`GRILL-30`）。0.3.3 把确认闩在它自己的 seq 上，只有在它之后**又有新一轮问题被回答**（或你给了更新的确认）时才失效；`grill_status` 会额外报出 `confirmedAtSeq`，你能看到这条确认是哪句话给的。
- **注入**：`agent/pre-step` 里若面试处于活动状态，插件追加一条 `source.kind = 'grill-me'` 的指令消息；同一步里已存在则原地替换，绝不重复堆叠。
- **纠偏**：`agent/turn-stopping` 里若检测到「问完一轮却去执行动作」，插件 `agent.steer(...)` 一条纠偏消息，强制同一轮内再走一步。纠偏预算按**违规本身**记账（`violationKey`：同一次动作、同一轮缺推荐都只纠 1 次）—— 0.2.0 按 `(agent, turn)` 记账，而每次 steer 都会开出新的 turn，于是同一条旧违规会不停把自己再喂一遍，没有用户输入也会无限自转；0.3.0 修掉了这个自转。**0.3.1 修掉了让纠偏形同虚设的那一步**（`GRILL-27`）：纠偏消息本身也是 `source.kind = 'grill-me'`，会被 `agent/pre-step` 的「原地替换」逻辑当成旧指令吞掉、换成一条全新的指令 —— 模型因此永远读不到自己刚违反了哪条规则，转录里连一条 `form = 'correction'` 的消息都不存在。现在只有 `form = 'directive'` 的插件消息会被替换，纠偏消息原样送进模型，旁边仍只有一条新指令。
- **不误伤**：普通英文里出现的 “grill / grilling” 不会激活面试，插件自己的名字也**不再**算激活词（光是提到 `grill-me` 这个插件、队友复述它的指令、转录里引用一段文档，都不该把人拖进面试）。只有**人自己写的** `/grill-me`、`/grilling`、`/grill-with-docs`、中文触发词（拷问/盘问/质询/逼问/压力测试/grill 我），或者宿主明确标记的技能调用（`skill` 工具加载 `grilling` / `grill-with-docs`）才会激活；`domain-modeling` 单独加载**不**激活访谈（它只是文档纪律，不是访谈模式）。激活后一直有效，直到 `/grill-stop`、`stop grilling`、`不用问了` 之类的收尾词。

## 文件

| 路径 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `src/state.js` | 纯状态机：`projectEvents` / `analyze` / `renderDirective` / `renderStatus` / `describeViolation`，以及文档账（`parseDocDeclarations` / `classifyDocPath` / `isWriteTool`）。零依赖。 |
| `src/skill.js` | 四个技能的正文与描述（两个 wrapper + `grilling`、`domain-modeling` 两个协议本体）。 |
| `lib/index.js` | Cordis 插件入口：注册四个技能、`grill_status` 工具、两条命令，挂 `agent/pre-step` 与 `agent/turn-stopping`。 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle patch：把这个包挂进 loader 树。 |
| `test/` | 状态机对抗测试 + 冒烟测试。 |

## 设计约束（踩过的坑）

- 插件**不能** `import '@deepseek-ai/*'`：profile 的 `node_modules` 里没有这个 scope，宿主包都打包在 app.asar 内。所以消息构造用 `src/state.js` 里自带的 `makeUserMessage`（形状与宿主 `createUserMessage` 一致）。
- `agent/pre-step` 的 `{kind:'reject'}` 会让整个 turn 以 `blocked` 结束，可能把已经产生的工具结果悬空 —— 插件因此**只用 `enter` 注入，从不 reject**，纠偏交给 `turn-stopping` + `steer`。
- 技能名必须匹配 `/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/`，所以中文只出现在 `description` / 正文里。

## 卸载

`plugin_manager` 里 disable/remove 这个 bundle 即可；插件在 `apply` 里注册的 disposer 会随 Cordis 卸载自动回收。
