plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-photocraft

让 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）通过 MCP 使用 **PhotoCraft**：编辑图片、管理图层、调色、添加文字与形状、运行滤镜、保存工程、导出图片，以及操作原生桌面画布和截图。

独立社区集成，非 PhotoCraft 或 DeepSeek 官方插件。不包含编辑器二进制，不包含生成式 AI 模型。

## 支持范围

| 项目 | 本版范围 |
| --- | --- |
| 系统 | Windows x64；macOS Intel / Apple Silicon，带可用的桌面会话 |
| DSH | 实测 `0.2.0-rc.2`，声明兼容 `^0.2.0-rc.2` |
| PowerShell | **PowerShell 7**，`pwsh` 可在终端运行；不是 Windows PowerShell 5.1 |
| PhotoCraft | 官方 **0.7.0** Windows 便携版 / macOS Universal 应用及 CLI，固定版本和 SHA-256 |
| 桌面渲染 | 默认 `--safe-gpu`，CPU 安全模式 |

Linux、Windows ARM64 和无桌面会话的服务器不在本版支持范围。PhotoCraft 当前源码的 0.8.0 功能不在本版验证范围内。

## 安装

先确认 `dsh --version` 和 `pwsh --version` 能运行。以下命令均在 **PowerShell 7** 中执行。安装方式使用 DSH 官方的 `dsh.bundle` 包机制，与其他 `dsh plugin add` 插件一致。

### 1. 安装插件包

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:DASHAN-0079/dsh-photocraft#v0.2.0
```

### 2. 安装原生 PhotoCraft 运行时

```powershell
$dshRoot = if ($env:DSH_HOME) { $env:DSH_HOME } else { Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('UserProfile')) '.dsh' }
& "$dshRoot/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-photocraft/scripts/Install-PhotoCraft.ps1"
```

Windows 安装器从 PhotoCraft 官方 GitHub 下载约 77 MB 的便携包，校验固定 SHA-256，再安装到 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-photocraft`。macOS 下载 Universal DMG 和 CLI ZIP（共约 150 MB），校验两个 SHA-256，并验证应用与 CLI 代码签名，安装到 `~/Library/Application Support/dsh-photocraft`。不需要 Rust、不需要管理员权限，不修改系统 PATH，也不使用 npm 的安装钩子执行下载。安装器会保留已有图片、工程和状态；重复运行会核对运行时文件校验值。

安装完成后重启 dsh，并创建新会话。使用其他 profile 时，将命令里的 `web` 换成相应名称。多个 profile 可以共用一次运行时安装。

**已使用旧版手工配置的用户：** 安装此包前，删除旧配置中 `mcp-photocraft` 与 `mcp-photocraft-ui` 两个条目，保留其他条目，避免重复注册。不需要手工配置的新用户可忽略此项。

### 从源码安装

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/DASHAN-0079/dsh-photocraft.git
cd dsh-photocraft
./scripts/Install-PhotoCraft.ps1
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

官方安装方式参考：[DSH 插件打包与安装](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md)。

### macOS 安装（系统终端 zsh / bash）

先安装 PowerShell 7（已安装可跳过；Homebrew 需自行安装）：

```sh
brew install --cask powershell
```

确认 `dsh --version` 和 `pwsh --version` 可运行，然后：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:DASHAN-0079/dsh-photocraft#v0.2.0
pwsh -NoProfile -File "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-photocraft/scripts/Install-PhotoCraft.ps1"
```

安装器按系统自动选择原生程序，Intel 和 Apple Silicon 使用同一个官方 Universal 包。不会清除 macOS quarantine 属性或绕过 Gatekeeper；如系统阻止启动，请先检查官方应用的签名与系统提示。完成后重启 dsh。通过 Finder 的“前往文件夹”打开 `~/Library/Application Support/dsh-photocraft/workspace` 放入图片。

### 从 0.1.0 升级

再次执行安装插件命令（使用 `#v0.2.0`），然后重新运行安装脚本，更新启动器和平台脚本。运行时版本不变，已有图片和工程不会删除。关闭旧 PhotoCraft 窗口再重启 dsh，确保使用新启动器。

## 使用

把待处理图片放进 Windows 的 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-photocraft\workspace`，或 macOS 的 `~/Library/Application Support/dsh-photocraft/workspace`。插件中的相对路径从该目录开始，输出也保存在这里。

对 dsh 说：

> 使用 PhotoCraft 创建一张 1200×800 的宣传图，背景深蓝，白色标题“周末摄影展”，加入黄色圆形装饰。生成预览，保存 poster.pcraft 和 poster.png。先通过 command_list 确认命令及参数。

或者：

> 用 PhotoCraft 打开 workspace 中的 input.jpg，提高亮度和对比度，缩放到宽度 1600 像素，保持比例，导出 output.jpg，不覆盖原图。

| 工具前缀 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `mcp__photocraft__*` | 无界面编辑、保存、批处理、预览、切换和关闭文档 |
| `mcp__photocraft_ui__*` | 桌面编辑、界面检查、画笔鼠标事件、菜单、截图 |

两个后端拥有**独立文档会话**。要交换文档，先保存，再在另一端打开。桌面入口自动启动本机 PhotoCraft，不会将编辑界面嵌入 dsh 网页。多个客户端共享桌面窗口，请避免同时修改同一文档。断开 MCP 不会关闭桌面，防止丢失未保存的工作。

上游 MCP 在两个模式下都会列出全部工具，但 `ui_*` 和 `control_call` 只能用桌面入口；`doc_select` 和 `doc_close` 只能用无界面入口。桌面标签页操作走 `control_call`。

## 验证

**v0.2.0 跨平台实测（2026-10-12）：** [同一次 GitHub Actions 运行](https://github.com/DASHAN-0079/dsh-photocraft/actions/runs/38253618887)中，Windows x64、macOS 15 Intel、macOS 15 Apple Silicon 均通过完整的 **105 项检查 / 21 个 MCP 工具**，包括桌面启动、画布绘制和截图；两个 Mac 的截图已人工查看。其他 macOS 版本尚未逐一验证。

运行完整集成检查（会创建合成测试图片并打开一个桌面测试文档）：

```powershell
$install = if ($env:PHOTOCRAFT_DSH_HOME) { $env:PHOTOCRAFT_DSH_HOME } elseif ($IsWindows) { Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'dsh-photocraft' } else { Join-Path $env:HOME 'Library/Application Support/dsh-photocraft' }
& "$install/scripts/Test-PhotoCraftMcp.ps1" -InstallDir $install
```

初始本机验证：**21 个 MCP 工具、105 项检查通过，发现 858 条引擎命令**。覆盖图层、填充、调色、模糊、文字、形状、撤销/重做、批量命令、PNG 预览、原生工程、8 种格式导出重开（PNG/JPEG/WebP/TIFF/PSD/PSB/OpenRaster/OpenEXR）、RGB/Gray/CMYK/Lab 的 8/16/32 位保存、后台任务接口、桌面绘制和截图、资源读取、错误命令和越界路径拒绝。实际 dsh 模型会话也已完成新建、填色、保存和桌面状态读取。

报告保存到安装目录的 `validation.json`，预览在 `workspace/headless-preview.png` 和 `workspace/desktop-preview.png`。仓库 CI 在 Windows、Intel macOS 和 Apple Silicon macOS 上执行安装、重复安装和完整 MCP/桌面检查；具体通过情况见 GitHub Actions，不以平台分支存在代替实测。

这不是 858 条命令的穷举测试，也不保证复杂 PSD 与 Photoshop 完全一致。生成式填充、AI 扩图等 PhotoCraft 尚未实现的功能不会由本插件补齐。

## 配置与排错

以下环境变量需要在启动 dsh **之前**设置：

| 变量 | 默认值 / 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `PHOTOCRAFT_DSH_HOME` | Windows：`%LOCALAPPDATA%/dsh-photocraft`；Mac：`~/Library/Application Support/dsh-photocraft`；安装器和插件必须使用同一路径 |
| `PHOTOCRAFT_DSH_PWSH` | `pwsh`；可指定 PowerShell 7 可执行文件绝对路径 |
| `PHOTOCRAFT_DSH_PORT` | `17878`；桌面本机控制端口 |

读写权限限定在安装目录的 `workspace` 下。令牌和日志保存在 `state`，不会提交到 GitHub。自定义安装位置时，设置 `PHOTOCRAFT_DSH_HOME` 后再运行安装器，并让启动 dsh 的终端使用同一变量。

- 找不到运行时：先完成安装第 2 步；检查上述变量。
- 找不到 `pwsh`：安装 PowerShell 7，重新打开终端；或设置 `PHOTOCRAFT_DSH_PWSH`。
- 端口被占用：关闭旧 PhotoCraft 桥接进程，或设置另一个 `PHOTOCRAFT_DSH_PORT`。测试脚本另提供 `-Port` 参数。
- 桌面启动失败：查看 `state/app.stderr.log`。本版已使用安全渲染模式，但仍需要可用的桌面会话。
- Mac 首次启动可能出现“Switched to CPU rendering”提示，选择 **Keep Using CPU** 即可继续。两个 Mac CI 的截图中均出现此提示，编辑、保存与截图调用仍通过；本版不声称验证 GPU 加速。
- 路径拒绝：将图片放入 `workspace`；不要使用 `..` 越界访问。
- 安装包校验失败：不要跳过校验；删除下载缓存里的损坏 ZIP 后重新下载。

## 卸载

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-photocraft
```

重启 dsh，正常关闭 PhotoCraft。运行时和工作图片会保留；确认不再需要后可手工移除安装目录。插件不会自动删除用户图片。

## 开发与授权

```powershell
npm test
npm pack --dry-run
```

包由 YAML 配置和 PowerShell 脚本组成，不新增 JavaScript/TypeScript 界面。插件采用 MIT 许可证；PhotoCraft 原始便携包的许可证和资源声明随运行时保留。项目不重新分发上游二进制或品牌资产。

[PhotoCraft](https://github.com/storytold/photocraft) · [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

plugins.description: Activity view for the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar: a bell swaps the sessions list for Needs attention, Working and Today.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-activity-view An activity view for the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar. A bell sits in the sessions header, between the view options and the add-project button. Click it to swap the session list for three groups: | Group | A session shows here when | |---|---| | **Needs attention** | it finished while you looked elsewhere (unread), or it waits for an approval, a plan review or an answer | | **Working** | it is running | | **Today** | its last activity was today (local calendar day) |

  

Left: the default sessions list. Right: the activity view, bell on.

Blank, subagent and archived sessions stay out. Unread rows get the green dot, waiting rows the orange one, working rows the native spinner. The bell itself shows a dot when anything needs attention, also while the view is off. The bell is the only switch. The choice is stored in the browser under the `dsh-activity-view.v2` localStorage key. ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:vec715/dsh-activity-view ``` Restart the server, then reload the page. Remove it with: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-activity-view ``` For development, add your local checkout instead: ```sh git clone https://github.com/vec715/dsh-activity-view dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-activity-view ``` ## How it works The shipped session browser owns `sidebar.workspaces` as one `single` slot, header and list together. Replacing it would also replace search, view options and add-project. So the plugin does two small DOM moves instead: * the bell is appended to the shipped `headerActions` row and copies the class of the neighbouring icon button, so it looks and behaves like the others * the shipped `listArea` is hidden while the view is on, and a React root with the activity list mounts beside it Both anchors are CSS-module local names, which survive build hashes. A MutationObserver puts the nodes back when the shell re-renders. Row metrics are copied from the shipped session rows and use the same theme tokens. ## Develop No build step. `client/client.js` is a hand-written loader bundle that the host serves as a classic script. Edit it, then reload the page. Types come from JSDoc, checked by `tsc` against `types.d.ts` (the few host modules the plugin touches) and `@types/react`. Nothing is emitted. ```sh npm install npm run check # tsc type-check, then the client self-check in node ``` ## Known limits * Unread state is process-local in DSH. A reload, a second tab, or a session that finished while the page was closed carries no unread mark. * The DOM seam depends on the shipped `headerActions` and `listArea` class names. A DSH release that renames them will break the bell or the list. * Row sizes are copied by hand from the shipped CSS. Check them after a DSH release that restyles the session list. * English only.

plugins.description: DSH 插件社区的讨论与反馈入口：插件展示 / 求助 / 想法与需求 / 已知问题。本仓库不含任何可执行代码（见 SECURITY.md）。 / Discussion and feedback hub for the DSH plugin community. Contains no executable code.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH 插件社区

> DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件的**社区**——讨论、求助、展示、找方案。
> 市场负责「有什么插件」，这里负责「这个插件怎么样、怎么用、出问题找谁」。

**本仓库不是一个插件市场。** 它不托管插件、不提供安装器，只提供一个**人和插件作者能对话的地方**。

---

## 这里能做什么

| 我想… | 去哪 |
|---|---|
| 看看别人做了什么插件 | [🧩 插件展示](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/plugin-showcase) |
| 用某个插件卡住了 | [🙋 求助](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/ask-for-help) |
| 想要一个还不存在的插件 | [💡 想法与需求](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/ideas) |
| 汇报插件的 bug | **优先去插件自己的仓库开 Issue**；找不到仓库、Issue 关着、或提了没人管 → [本仓库 Issues](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/issues) |
| 查某个插件已知的问题 | [🐞 已知问题](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/known-issues) |
| 随便聊聊 | [🗣️ 闲聊](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/general) |

**为什么 bug 走 Issues 而不是 Discussions**：Issues 能关、能指派、能被作者订阅通知，是「待办」；Discussions 是「话题」，发完不一定要有人处理。**能用 Issue 追踪的事不要开讨论帖。**

---

## 怎么参与

**浏览不需要登录。** GitHub 的公开 Discussions 对所有人可见——直接看就行。

**发言需要一个 GitHub 账号。** 这是唯一的门槛，也是本项目的刻意选择：把身份、反滥用、通知全都交给 GitHub，社区自己不做账号体系。

- 第一次来 → 先读 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- 想推荐自己的插件 → 读 [投稿指南](CONTRIBUTING.md#我想推荐自己的插件)
- 想汇报安全问题 → 读 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)（**不要开公开 Issue**）

---

## 讨论分类

| 分类 | 用途 | 能标「答案」 |
|---|---|---|
| 📣 公告 | 索引更新、社区规则变更 | — |
| 🧩 插件展示 | 作者自荐，或推荐你用过的插件 | 否 |
| 🙋 求助 | 使用中遇到问题 | **是** |
| 💡 想法与需求 | 「我想要一个能做 X 的插件」 | 否 |
| 🐞 已知问题 | bug 的汇总与绕行方案 | 否 |
| 🗣️ 闲聊 | 兜底 | 否 |

> **求助帖能标答案**这件事很重要：一个被解决了的问题会留在搜索结果里，下一个人搜到就能直接用。**解决了就请回来把答案标上。**

---

## 行为准则

参与即表示同意 [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)。一句话版本：**对插件苛刻，对人客气。**

---

## 与市场的关系

DSH 的插件市场已经不止一个，而且都做得不错。**社区不是第 N+1 个市场**，也不会去重复它们的索引工作。

社区做的是市场做不了的事：

- **对话**——市场能告诉你插件存在，不能告诉你它在你这种情况下会不会崩
- **沉淀**——一个被回答过的问题，比一次性的 star 数有用得多
- **作者与用户的直接接触**——插件作者能在这里看到真实反馈

如果你在维护一个市场或索引目录，欢迎来[闲聊区](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/general)打个招呼——**我们更愿意合作而不是竞争**。

---

## English summary

**DSH Plugin Community** — a place for discussing DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins: showcasing them, getting help, asking for new ones, and recording known issues.

**This repository is not a plugin marketplace.** It hosts no plugins and ships no installer. It exists so that people and plugin authors have somewhere to talk.

### Where to go

| I want to… | Go to |
|---|---|
| See what plugins other people built | [🧩 Plugin showcase](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/plugin-showcase) |
| Get unstuck on a plugin | [🙋 Ask for help](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/ask-for-help) |
| Ask for a plugin that does not exist yet | [💡 Ideas & requests](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/ideas) |
| Report a plugin bug | **Open an issue in the plugin's own repository first.** No repo, issues closed, or nobody responding → [this repository's Issues](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/issues) |
| Look up a known problem | [🐞 Known issues](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/known-issues) |
| Just chat | [🗣️ General](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/general) |

**Why bugs go to Issues and not Discussions**: issues can be closed, assigned, and subscribed to by the author — they are a to-do list. Discussions are topics; nobody is obliged to act on one. **Anything you want tracked should be an issue, not a discussion thread.**

### Taking part

**Browsing needs no account.** Public GitHub Discussions are visible to everyone — just read.

**Posting needs a GitHub account.** That is the only barrier, and it is deliberate: identity, abuse prevention, and notifications are all delegated to GitHub. The community runs no account system of its own.

- First time here → read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- Want to submit your own plugin → read the [submission guide](CONTRIBUTING.md#我想推荐自己的插件)
- Reporting a security problem → read [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) (**never open a public issue for it**)

### Discussion categories

| Category | Purpose | Can accept an "answer" |
|---|---|---|
| 📣 Announcements | Index updates, rule changes | — |
| 🧩 Plugin showcase | Authors self-promoting, or recommending a plugin you use | no |
| 🙋 Ask for help | Trouble using something | **yes** |
| 💡 Ideas & requests | "I wish a plugin could do X" | no |
| 🐞 Known issues | Bug round-ups and workarounds | no |
| 🗣️ General | Everything else | no |

> **That help threads can accept an answer matters**: a solved question stays in search results, and the next person finds it immediately. **Once yours is solved, come back and mark the answer.**

### Forms are bilingual

Every issue form and discussion form in this repository carries Chinese and English in the same field (`中文 / English`), so you can fill them in either language. GitHub has no per-language form support, and shipping duplicate English forms would double the "new issue" list and let the two versions drift apart — so both languages live in one form.

### Code of conduct

Participating means agreeing to [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). The one-line version: **be exacting about plugins, be kind to people.**

### Relationship to marketplaces

DSH already has more than one plugin marketplace, and they are good. **This community is not marketplace number N+1** and will not duplicate their indexing work. What it does is what a marketplace cannot:

- **Conversation** — a marketplace tells you a plugin exists; it cannot tell you whether it will break in your situation
- **Accumulation** — a question that got answered is worth far more than a one-off star count
- **Direct contact between authors and users** — plugin authors can see real feedback here

If you maintain a marketplace or index, come say hello in [General](https://github.com/moyuqing-man/dsh-plugin-community/discussions/categories/general) — **we would rather cooperate than compete.**

### Licence

The repository itself (README, contribution guide, issue and discussion forms) is [MIT](LICENSE), © 2026 moyuqing-man. **It contains no executable code** — see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) — and every plugin discussed here carries its own author's licence.

---

*Discussions in this repository carry the community content; each plugin's code and licence are its own author's responsibility.*

plugins.description: Durable subagent execution for DeepSeek Harness: a `durable` provider and a model-facing tool that drive pi-durable-subagents, so a crashed delegation converges on its first outcome instead of running twice.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-durable-subagent

Durable subagent execution for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It registers a `durable` provider on `ctx.subagents` and a model-facing `durable_subagent` tool, both driving [`pi-durable-subagents`](https://github.com/purboo/pi-durable-subagents).

The point of the pairing is one guarantee: **a delegation the harness accepted before a crash is read back, not run again.**

## Where the guarantee comes from

DeepSeek Harness durably records execution intent and does not promise exactly-once effects. Its session checkpoint policy states the convention this plugin implements:

> "The policy durably records execution intent, not generic exactly-once effects. Side-effecting tools should forward `exec.callId` as an idempotency key when their provider supports one."
> — `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-checkpoint-policy`

`pi-durable-subagents` accepts exactly that key as `--request <id>`: the first submission under an id is decided once, and every later retry carrying the same content gets that first outcome. So the harness supplies durable intent plus the key, and the durable orchestrator supplies the single decision.

The join is a read-before-write state machine. Every attempt reads `describe --key <id>` first and only submits when the id is undecided, so a process that died between deciding a submission and reporting it leaves a durable decision that the next attempt reads instead of executing. The keyless test suite pins that path; the traced CLI invocation sequence is `describe → run → describe` with one execution recorded.

## Install

Two prerequisites. `pi-durable-subagents` must be on `PATH` (`npm i -g pi-durable-subagents`), or named by the `command` option. Without it every start fails with a message saying so rather than retrying.

The plugin is not on npm yet, so install it from the repository:

```sh
npm i -g pi-durable-subagents
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Tim-ReJet/dsh-plugin-durable-subagent
```

`lib/` is checked in. pnpm blocks build scripts for git-hosted packages, so a `prepare` step would fail the install rather than run it. Run `npm run build` after editing the TypeScript to refresh it.

Once the package is published the shorter form works:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-durable-subagent
```

The bundle patch inserts one row, `durable-subagent`.

## Config

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | `durable` | Registry name on `ctx.subagents`. |
| `command` | `pi-durable-subagents` | Executable, argv[0] only. |
| `commandArgs` | `[]` | Arguments before the subcommand, for a launcher rather than a bare executable. |
| `home` | — | `DSA_HOME` for every invocation. |
| `agent` | `worker` | The pi agent definition a delegation runs as unless the call names another. |
| `cwd` | the harness process's working directory | Working directory of every invocation. A run's cwd is part of the content the CLI hashes. |
| `idempotency` | `unique` | How the **provider** mints request ids: `unique` (one per start) or `content` (one per identical delegation). The tool always uses the call identity. |
| `attempts` | `3` | Submission attempts before a start fails. |
| `settleTimeoutMs` | `600000` | How long a run handle waits for the durable verdict. |
| `pollIntervalMs` | `1000` | Poll interval while waiting. |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | Per-invocation deadline for the CLI. |
| `enableTool` | `true` | Register the model-facing tool. |
| `tool` | `durable_subagent` | Model-facing tool name. |

## How a call becomes a durable request

1. The harness checks the call's intent durably, then runs the tool body with `exec.callId`.
2. The tool derives a request id from the calling session id and `exec.callId`, so a replay of the same call re-derives the same id.
3. The plugin reads the id's durable state. Only `absent` and `pending` proceed to `run`; `running` and `asking` return as they are, and `sealed`, `rejected`, and `pruned` are terminal.
4. `run --request <id> --spec - --cwd <cwd> --json` either decides the request, returns the first outcome, or reports `75` (not decided yet), in which case the next attempt reads the durable state again before resubmitting.

The provider path reaches `ctx.subagents` instead, where no call identity is available (`ResolvedSubagentStartRequest` carries none). It therefore mints ids from configuration: `unique` never conflicts but is not replay-stable, `content` is replay-stable but two identical delegations from one session collide as `request-conflict`. Pick `content` only when the delegations are content-distinct.

## Model Experience

### The tool

`durable_subagent` takes `action` (`run`, `status`, `answer`, `steer`, `notify`, `stop`), plus `task`, `agent`, `to`, `message`, `qid`, and `rev` as each action needs.

`run` returns as soon as the delegation is decided, not when its work finishes, and reports `sealed`, `running`, `pending`, or `asking` with the `request` address. `status` reads that address again; an `asking` state carries the question id and revision that `answer` needs. Nothing is polled on the model's behalf, so a long delegation costs no tokens while it runs.

### Token effect

A `run` reply is one short line. Reading a finished delegation returns its output; reading a running one returns a state name. No child transcript enters the parent's history.

### KV cache effect

Tool calls append after the reusable history prefix. Nothing here rewrites earlier messages.

## Known Limitations and Deferred Work

- **A linked plugin resolves its imports from its own repository.** `dsh plugin add <path>` records a `link:`, and Node follows the symlink to the plugin's real path, so `@deepseek-ai/*` is resolved from the plugin directory and never from the profile. The local install must therefore carry a complete closure: `npm install` resolves this package's harness peers, while `npm install --legacy-peer-deps` leaves `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` without the nine packages it declares as peers, and the profile then fails to boot with `failed to import loader entry durable-subagent (dsh-plugin-durable-subagent): Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope'`. A published install from npm does not have this problem.
- **`cwd` is part of the submission digest.** A retry from a different working directory is a `request-conflict` rather than the first outcome. The default is stable for the life of the harness process; a per-session `cwd` is not yet wired.
- **The provider cannot be replay-stable.** `ResolvedSubagentStartRequest` carries no call identity, so only the tool path gets one execution per call. Making the provider path exact needs a durable run identity on the request; that is a harness change.
- **`dispose()` stops a run but does not await quiescence.** The orchestrator is a separate process and owns its own teardown, so the run handle cannot observe the child's exit.
- **No continuable children and no Agent Teams membership.** `prepareContinuable` is deliberately not implemented: `spawn_teammate` and cold resume need a durable child session this provider does not create.
- **No tool filtering, persona, or delegation depth.** The provider reports `outputSchema` only; a request needing another capability is rejected loudly by the subagent service rather than silently ignored.
- **`outputSchema` validation is delegated.** `pi-durable-subagents` validates a `report` against the schema it was handed before sealing, so a sealed `data` payload is schema-valid; the plugin does not re-validate it.
- **The orchestrator is not supervised.** The plugin neither starts nor restarts `pi-durable-subagents`; it relies on the orchestrator's own lazy start, lock, and idle exit. Running it under `ctx.subprocess` would make harness disposal kill it.
- **A failure is per call.** A workflow reports `status: "done"` even when every call inside it failed, and `output`/`error` live on the calls. `summarize()` reads them there; the read-only `status` view alone would call a failed delegation completed.

## Verification

Phase 0 exercised the real `pi-durable-subagents` 1.0.39 CLI against a real orchestrator, and mounted the

plugins.description: DSH settings page for the Hindsight coding-agents plugin: edit ~/.hindsight/coding-agent.json from the DeepSeek Harness GUI
plugins.readme_text:
# @Echo-Note/dsh-hindsight-settings

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

![The Hindsight settings page in DeepSeek Harness](assets/screenshot-1-settings.png)
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) companion plugin that adds a **Hindsight 记忆设置** page to Settings, so
`~/.hindsight/coding-agent.json` can be edited from the GUI instead of by hand.

It is a companion on purpose. `@vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents` mounts as a **subpath row**
(`…/coding-agents/dsh`), and DSH's client module system only attaches a browser half to the row whose
specifier is the bare package name — so that package cannot carry a settings page without changing how
every existing user mounts it. Nor does it declare any `Config`: it imports nothing from dsh and
resolves its settings from its own file, which the shipped settings form (schema-derived, persisted
into the profile patch) cannot reach. This package therefore ships its own page and its own host
service, and leaves the plugin untouched.

## Install

**From GitHub** — the package is consumed straight from this repository, and its
`@vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents` dependency is installed with it, so one install gets both:

```bash
# Any profile except a packaged Desktop one, whose profile the CLI refuses to write:
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Echo-Note/dsh-hindsight-settings
```

In the **desktop app** (the profile the Electron shell owns) the CLI refuses by design; install from
the GUI instead — **Settings → Plugins → install**, and paste the same spec:

```
github:Echo-Note/dsh-hindsight-settings
```

The 40-character commit this resolves to is pinned by the package manager's lockfile, so a later
`git push` does not silently change what you run: re-install (or update) to move it. Git installs
build nothing — the compiled `lib/` is committed — so the install is a checkout, not a build.

Naming it with the scope is optional. `github:Echo-Note/dsh-hindsight-settings` installs it under the
name in this package's `package.json`; to force a different key, use the npm alias form, which is what
this repository's own dry-run used:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add '@Echo-Note/dsh-hindsight-settings@github:Echo-Note/dsh-hindsight-settings'
```

**From a local checkout** (while editing this package):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Echo-Note/dsh-hindsight-settings.git
cd dsh-hindsight-settings
npm install          # dev dependencies only; nothing is needed at runtime but the peer packages
npm run build        # optional: refreshes lib/ from src/
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:"$PWD"
```

`link:` (not `file:`) is the right spec for a package you may edit: `file:` copies a snapshot into the
profile, `link:` symlinks it, so a rebuilt browser half is picked up on the next page load.

### The one manual step

A package's bundle is mounted only when the profile selects it in `dsh.profile.bundles`, and dsh's own
plugin-manager README states that "an unselected plain dependency is left out" — the manager lists
bundles a dependency supplies but does NOT select them. So after installing this package, enable
**Hindsight** once in **Settings → Plugins** (installing the bundle by name,
`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents`, does the same thing).

`dsh` has no bundle-depends-on-bundle field to express this (`DshManifest` carries only
`manifestVersion`, `bundle.patch`, `client`, `engines.dsh`), and the alternative — our patch inserting
Hindsight's row directly — would compose the same row twice when its own bundle is also enabled,
because patch `insert` appends without deduplicating entry ids.

The host half, the `./typert` manifest and the browser bundle are all read at startup, and dsh's
plugin manager notes that "package replacements require restarting the process to load a fresh
JavaScript module generation" — so **restart once** after installing.

## How it works

```
~/.hindsight/coding-agent.json          ← the one file every Hindsight harness reads
        ▲            │
        │ apply()    │ describe()                     (host, src/service.ts + src/typert.host.ts)
        │            ▼
   ctx.provide('hindsightSettings')  ──Remote──▶  POST /api/hindsightSettings/<method>
        ▲                                                  │
        └──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                    browser (src/client/index.tsx)
                       page in Settings, mounted via ctx.remote.$mount(contribution)
```

- The host publishes one Cordis service; its `./typert` manifest exposes `describe` and `apply` to the
  page (`docs/api-gateway.md`).
- The page renders every field from `src/fields.ts` — the single declaration of the config surface —
  and writes back only what changed. A field the user clears is sent as `null`, which removes the key
  so the setting falls back to the environment variable, then to the plugin's own default.
- Fields are grouped into one tab per section, plus a **按项目（banks）** tab. A bank tab edits
  `banks.<id>`, which is how upstream lets one repository differ from the shared top level; opening a
  bank calls `describe({ kind: "bank", id })` and saving calls `applyScoped(...)`. `paths.<dir>` is
  listed read-only.
- A field the file does not set is still shown with its **effective** value — the plugin default —
  labelled as such, while a cleared cell still means "remove the key". Nothing is written until a cell
  actually changes.
- Secrets are never sent to the page: `apiToken` shows as set-but-blank ("已设置（不显示明文）"), typing
  replaces it, and only the explicit 清空 button removes it. This mirrors dsh's own settings service,
  where a `role('secret')` value is kept out of form responses.
- Nothing goes through the DSH settings form or the profile patch. An earlier revision tried to mirror
  the file into this plugin's own `Config` so the shipped form would show it; a real install refused
  that write with _"HMR transactions cannot be nested"_ (the row is mounted inside the loader's
  transaction, an `AsyncLocalStorage` scope that even timers inherit), and the form never served the
  namespace. Talking to the file directly is both simpler and the documented path for host state.

## Safety

- Managed keys only: keys this package does not know, and the nested `banks` / `paths` / `harnesses`
  sections, are preserved verbatim.
- `null` removes a key; there is no other way to delete, and a field the page never sends is untouched.
- Writes go through a temp file + rename, at mode `0600` — the file can hold `apiToken`.
- A file that cannot be parsed is **never** overwritten: the page reports it and disables saving.
- An invalid value (wrong type, unknown key, a file-only nested map) is refused before the disk is
  touched.

## Interface fields

`mapPathToBank`, `pages`, `customPages`, `recallOptions`, `retainMetadata`, `defaultBankConfig`,
`harnesses` and the deprecated `autoReflect` are shown **read-only** in a group tab: they are nested
maps a single form field cannot express, and upstream documents them as file-only. The page says so
per field rather than hiding them. `banks` and `paths` are not read-only: the bank tab edits
`banks.<id>` through a scoped write, and the file's `paths` sections are listed read-only.

## Precedence and when an edit takes effect

Upstream resolves `defaults → HINDSIGHT_* → the file's top level → harnesses.<name> → banks.<id> /
paths.<dir>`, later winning. The page writes the top level, so a `harnesses.dsh` entry for the same key
still wins — the page badges those fields. Upstream reads the file once per workspace, at plugin load,
so an edit reaches a running session after a dsh restart; `apiToken` is the exception (its client
re-reads the credential on the next call after a server rejection, so rotating it needs no restart).

## Troubleshooting

The host half appends what it did to `~/.hindsight/dsh-settings-status.json`:

```jsonc
{
  "events": [
    {
      "at": "…",
      "step": "apply",
      "provided": "hindsightSettings",
      "entryId": "hindsight-settings",
    },
    { "at": "…", "step": "describe", "path": "…/coding-agent.json", "error": null, "fields": 52 },

plugins.description: Bridge QQ official-bot private chats into DeepSeek Harness agent sessions - same session, same memory, same permissions. No second QQ gateway, no copy-pasted system prompt.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-qqbot-bridge

**English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.19-339933.svg)](package.json)
[![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-139%20passing-brightgreen.svg)](TEST-REPORT.md)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-ff69b4.svg)](#contributing)

> Route QQ private messages into the AI team sessions you **already** have in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — same session id, same memory, same permissions. No second QQ gateway, no copy-pasted system prompt.

![Asking the 程序员 Bot for a quicksort on QQ, and getting the real session's answer back](assets/demo.gif)

*Real run: a private message on QQ, answered by the Bot's actual DSH session — code, files and all. The same conversation is waiting in the DSH Web UI.*

```
        QQ app                          ┌─ DSH Web UI ─┐
           │                            │  程序员 chat  │
    private message                     └──────▲───────┘
           ▼                                   │  the same session
   ┌───────────────────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────┐
   │  dsh-qqbot-bridge  →  the Bot's REAL session (history + memory + ...) │
   └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## The problem

You already run a **team of agents** inside DSH: several Bots, each with its own long-lived
session, its own role instructions, its own long-term memory, its own tools and workspace.
You want to talk to them **from QQ**.

The obvious approach — *"write a QQ bot that calls the model with the same system prompt"* —
silently throws away everything that made the team worth building: the conversation history,
the memory files, the permissions, the workspace, the resume-after-restart behaviour.
You end up with a stranger wearing the same name.

This project does not do that. It **delivers a QQ message into the session that Bot already
has**, and relays the Bot's answer back to QQ.

## What makes it different

| | Typical QQ ⇄ LLM bridge | **dsh-qqbot-bridge** |
|---|---|---|
| Identity | Copies the system prompt | **Reuses the real session** — `sessionController.resolveAgent(sessionId)` then `agent.followup(createUserMessage({ source }))` |
| Context | Starts from scratch | The Bot's actual history, memory, tools and workspace |
| Web ⇄ QQ | Two disconnected worlds | **One session**: start on QQ, continue in the Web UI, same context |
| QQ gateway | Opens its own connection | **Borrows** the one the official plugin already runs — no second login, no credential race |
| Allowlist | `[]` often means *everyone* | `[]` means **nobody** (fail-closed); refused peers are only *recorded*, never auto-granted |
| Observability | Silence when it breaks | Console lines **and** `bridge-status.json` — "did it load?" always has an answer |
| Official commands | Frequently swallowed | `/bot-ping`, `/bot-status`, … keep working |
| Long conversations | Pins one session id | Re-reads `state.json` before every send, so a session that rolls over to a new part keeps working |
| Group chats | Often on by default | Off, and group traffic is handed back to the stock chain untouched |

Every row above is backed by a test or a real run log — see [`TEST-REPORT.md`](TEST-REPORT.md).

## How it works

```
QQ private message
      │
      ▼
@tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot   (stock plugin + a tiny local fork, patch 0001)
      │   owns the only QQ websocket, holds the credentials
      │   publishes: ctx.provide('qqbot', { setMessagePreHandler, sender, replyTargetFor, … })
      ▼
dsh-qqbot-bridge   (this project — consumes the service, never opens a socket)
      │   1. allowlist gate      (empty ⇒ refuse everyone, record the OpenID only)
      │   2. command router      /管家 /设计师 /程序员 /聊天 /团队 /当前   → routing.json
      │   3. per-OpenID FIFO queue + message-id de-duplication
      │   4. read state.json (READ-ONLY) for that Bot's CURRENT session id
      │   5. sessionController.resolveAgent(sessionId) → agent.followup(msg)
      ▼
the Bot's real DSH session          ← the very same one the Web UI shows
      │   msg.source.kind = 'qqbot-bridge'   (so QQ and Web turns are distinguishable)
      ▼
ctx.on('session/event') collects the answer, turn/end closes it
      │
      ▼
back to QQ (chunked, with honest failure and timeout messages)
```

The bridge registers **one** Cordis service of its own (`qqbotBridge`) so an operator can ask
a live host what it is doing.

### Why a fork of the QQ plugin is required

The stock `@tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot` keeps its `QQBot` instance, `SessionManager` and
outbound sender inside local variables and **registers no Cordis service at all**, so an
external plugin cannot send on the same connection, cannot intercept the middleware chain,
and cannot learn which OpenID a message came from. Starting a second gateway with the same
AppID would race the first one for the event stream.

So the only clean option is a **minimal local fork**, and patch 0001 adds exactly two things:

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `dist/gateway/middleware-setup.js` | one optional `preHandlers` argument, inserted at the **front** of the middleware chain |
| `dist/gateway/bootstrap.js` | `ctx.provide('qqbot', { setMessagePreHandler, sender, replyTargetFor, manager })` |

No existing statement is modified, and a host that never calls the extension point behaves
exactly as before. Rollback is one dependency range in the profile manifest.
Full evidence in [`patches/0001-qqbot-extension-point.md`](patches/0001-qqbot-extension-point.md).

## Quick start

Prerequisites: DSH with the Web profile, the stock QQ plugin installed and already bound to
your AppID, and DS Bot with your team created.

```bash
# 1. self-check (zero runtime dependencies — no install needed)
node scripts/run-tests.mjs
node scripts/audit-constraints.mjs
node scripts/verify-host-resolution.mjs

# 2. generate the local fork (finds the installed stock package automatically,
#    or pass --from <dir>)
node scripts/make-bridged-qqbot.mjs --out ../dsh-bridged-qqbot
(cd ../dsh-bridged-qqbot && pnpm install --prefer-offline)   # pnpm does not do this for linked packages

# 3. point your Web profile at the fork and mount this bridge (see the diff first)
node scripts/install-profile.mjs --fork ../dsh-bridged-qqbot --project . --dry-run
node scripts/install-profile.mjs --fork ../dsh-bridged-qqbot --project .

# 4. stop dsh, then install inside the profile
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web && pnpm install

# 5. start dsh again. You should see the bridge announce itself:
#    [qqbot-bridge] apply() entered (plugin v0.1.0)
#    [qqbot-bridge] allowOpenIds: 0 configured -- FAIL CLOSED, every QQ peer is refused
#    [qqbot-bridge] provided the "qqbotBridge" service
#    [qqbot-bridge] STARTED: transport=dsh-qqbot-bridge/qq | snapshot=...
```

Then allowlist yourself:

```bash
# send any private message to the bot on QQ (it will be refused, on purpose), then:
node scripts/show-openids.mjs          # prints the OpenID that was recorded
# put it into ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml -> allowOpenIds: ["YOUR_OPENID"]
```

Editing `cordis.patch.yml` is picked up by DSH's config hot reload — **no restart needed**.

## Using it from QQ

| Command | Effect |
|---|---|
| `/管家` `/设计师` `/程序员` `/聊天` | switch which Bot you are talking to (persisted per OpenID) |
| `/团队` | list the team |
| `/当前` | show who you are talking to |
| anything else | delivered to the current Bot; its answer comes back to QQ |

## Configuration

All of it lives in **your** profile patch, never in this repository:

```yaml
- id: qqbot-bridge
  config:
    allowOpenIds: []        # EMPTY MEANS NOBODY. Add only your own OpenID.
    defaultBot: 管家         # who receives a message from a peer with no switch yet
    allowGroups: false      # v1 is private chats only
    replyTimeoutMs: 600000  # how long to wait for a Bot turn before telling the user
    queueMax: 4             # per-peer queued messages
    textChunkLimit: 4500    # max characters per QQ message
    debug: false
    # statePath / da

plugins.description: DSH plugin: pick separate models and reasoning efforts for the main session, subagents, and plan mode.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-model-dispatch

English | [简体中文](README_CN.md)

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.0--rc.2-blueviolet.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![Platform: Web](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Web-orange.svg)]()
[![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-69%20passing-brightgreen.svg)](tests)

**Give the main model, your subagents, and plan mode their own model and reasoning effort — from the chat bar, in one menu.**

![The model menu above the composer: model rows, the reasoning-effort slider, and the two composer chips](docs/images/menu-light.png)

DeepSeek Harness ships a model picker for the **main** model. This plugin keeps that control and adds the two routes it does not cover — the model that **delegated subagents** run on, and the model **plan mode** thinks with — then puts all three in one menu that behaves like a native control.

| Route | Set it from | Applies to |
|---|---|---|
| **Main model** | chat-bar main chip · settings row 1 | the current session, through the native DSH switching API |
| **Subagent model** | chat-bar subagent chip · settings row 2 | subagents started *later* in this session |
| **Planning model** | settings row 3 | plan mode only; the pre-plan main model is restored afterwards |

---

## Table of contents

- [Features](#features)
- [Install](#install)
- [Usage](#usage)
  - [Chat bar](#chat-bar)
  - [Settings](#settings)
  - [Plan mode](#plan-mode)
  - [Subagents](#subagents)
- [Routing rules](#routing-rules)
- [Persistence](#persistence)
- [Compatibility](#compatibility)
- [Development](#development)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)
- [Known limitations](#known-limitations)
- [Credits](#credits)
- [License](#license)

## Features

- **Two composer chips, wearing the host's own material.** The input bar carries a main chip (the host's model glyph) and a subagent chip (a branch glyph); the icon alone tells them apart, while the tooltip and accessible name keep the full `Main · model · effort` label. Both are borderless 28px chips that only show a surface on hover, exactly like the neighbouring native controls. While the subagent route inherits, its chip reads **Follows main** instead of repeating the main model name.

  ![The two composer chips](docs/images/composer-light.png)

- **One menu for every route.** Search across models and providers, provider groups, favorites, recents, and reasoning effort — the same menu is used by the chat bar and the settings rows. It is built from the host menu's material (translucent blurred card, elevation shadow, 4px padding, 34px rows, 13px type, l2 hairlines), so it reads as a first-party control rather than a plugin overlay.

- **Reasoning effort as a discrete slider.** One stop per level, plus a leading **provider default** stop so "don't specify an effort" is a visible state instead of hidden behaviour. The scale is drawn under the rail (so it never seams the filled run), the current level is named in the header row, and the control is draggable and keyboard-operable.

  ![The reasoning-effort slider](docs/images/effort-light.png)

- **Live apply — no confirm row.** A model pick, a slider move, or a restore writes through immediately. A slider drag coalesces into a single write when it settles, writes are serialized, and a failed write rolls the row back and shows the real error. The menu stays open, so picking a model can be followed straight by an effort change; `Esc` or a click outside only closes the menu and never undoes a live choice.

- **Plan-mode auto switching.** Entering plan mode switches to the planning model; approving the plan or `/plan off` restores the pre-plan main model *and* effort before the first execution request. The review panel shows which model will be restored.

- **Per-session subagent overrides.** A chat-bar subagent pick is stored as a durable override for that session and never touches the settings default; one click restores the settings default.

- **Every catalog model is delegatable.** Subagent routing reads the host's live model catalog, so an explicit child selection and `list_subagent_models` keep working in existing sessions even when rc.2 captured an older allowlist. Models added later are available on the next delegation; removed routes and unsupported efforts are rejected up front.

- **Route validation before saving.** Overrides and child creation validate the exact provider/model/effort through the host's `resolveCallConfig`; an invalid combination fails immediately with the real reason instead of failing inside a run.

## Install

Requires **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2** (other 0.2.x versions need a compatibility check — see [Compatibility](#compatibility)).

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add git@github.com:kolawong/dsh-plugin-model-dispatch.git
```

Replace `web` with the profile you actually use (`desktop`, …). Then **fully quit and reopen DSH**: the host half needs a recomposition, and refreshing the page only reloads the client half.

`lib/` is not tracked in git: git installs build the host and client bundles through the package's `prepare` script, and npm publishes build through `prepack`. For a local checkout, run `pnpm install && pnpm build` once before linking.

<details>
<summary>Manual install (link a local checkout)</summary>

```jsonc
// <DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/package.json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-plugin-model-dispatch": "link:/path/to/dsh-plugin-model-dispatch" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["…", "dsh-plugin-model-dispatch"] } }
}
```

In the checkout, run `pnpm install && pnpm build` first, then create the matching `node_modules` link (the profile directory is the resolution anchor), then restart DSH.
</details>

## Usage

### Chat bar

Two chips sit at the right of the composer, next to the permission and preset controls:

| Chip | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Main** (model glyph) | Switches the current session's model through the native API. The chip shows the effective route and its effort in the tooltip. |
| **Subagent** (branch glyph) | Picks the model for subagents started later in this session, stored as a session override. Reads **Follows main** while nothing is overridden. |

Opening either chip gives the same menu: search, provider groups, favorites (★, hover-revealed, remembered per browser), recents, the effort slider, and — for the subagent route — a **restore to settings default** row.

![The same menu in dark mode](docs/images/menu-dark.png)

### Settings

**Web settings → Model & Agents** holds four rows, each with a one-line scope hint:

| Row | Meaning |
|---|---|
| New-session default model | Written to the native `agent-default-model` entry. Changing the model inside a chat does **not** change it. |
| Subagent default model | Used by subagents of any session that has no override. |
| Planning model | Used while plan mode is active. |
| Subagent delegation activity | A three-stop slider (conservative / balanced / aggressive) steering how eagerly the model splits work into subagents through the system prompt; balanced adds no extra guidance. Parallelism and nesting depth live under the host's own **Settings → Plugins → subagent** page. |

### Plan mode

1. Entering plan mode saves the session's current `provider` / `model` / `reasoningEffort` atomically and switches to the planning model.
2. Approving the plan (or `/plan off`) restores that saved route **before the first execution request is assembled**.
3. If a restore fails it is retryable and never strands the session on the planning model; the approval panel names the model that will come back.

### Subagents

- A delegation started with explicit model options keeps them — the plugin only fills in a route where the native call left it open.
- The subagent chip and the settings default apply to **newly started** subagents; running ones keep their model.
- Subagent sessions themselves do not participate in plan switching or subagent overrides.

## Routing rules

| Decision | Precedence (highest first) |
|---|---|
| Subagent model | session override → settings default → native

plugins.description: 这是一个适用于 Deepseek Harness 的插件，向用户提供 GUI 下自定义且区分模型的发送 Prompt 注入功能。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-prompt-inject

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（下称 dsh）的一个插件：在设置页里，按**注入点**和**模型**配置要注入的提示词。

装好之后，设置里多出一项「dsh-prompt-inject」。里面是八个注入点，每个注入点下可以写若干条规则，规则可以自己排序、单独开关、指定对哪些模型生效。改完自动保存，下一轮对话就用新值。

- 目标适配最新 dsh rc 版本
- 注入的位置分两类：夹在用户输入前后的**前置词 / 后置词**，和 system 里的**六个位置**。
- 规则正文里可以写 `{{model}}` 这类模板字段，发送时换成这次请求的真实值。
- 配置文件存在本地，一切改动只影响你自己。

## 安装

用 dsh 自带的插件命令，从 GitHub 装进你要用的 profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:XuezuoYS/dsh-prompt-inject
```

`--profile` 填你平时启动的那个 profile：命令行跑 Web UI 就是 `web`，桌面版是 `desktop`。第一次用某个 profile 时，这条命令会先把它初始化出来。新装的组合包默认就是启用的，不用再开。

命令里的 `github:所有者/仓库` 是 pnpm 的简写形式，转发给 profile 目录里的 pnpm 执行。想把版本钉死、不让后面的推送悄悄改变实际跑的代码，就带上 commit：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:XuezuoYS/dsh-prompt-inject#<sha>
```

本插件是纯 JS 的手写包，没有 `prepare`、`install` 之类的构建脚本，所以官方文档里 git 安装那道「授权构建」的坎在这里不存在（pnpm 10 只会拦带构建脚本的包）。

装完如果 dsh 正在跑，命令会告诉你是立刻生效还是要重启；重启一次 dsh 总是安全的。想确认装上了，可以只看配置层而不启动：

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config   # 应该能看到一行 "# == dsh-prompt-inject"
```

卸载会同时移除依赖和它贡献的配置层：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-prompt-inject
```

卸载不动你的规则文件，重装回来配置还在。

## 设置页里怎么用

打开 设置 → dsh-prompt-inject，页面分两组：**用户消息**（前置词 / 后置词）和 **system 段**。system 组里各项按它们在 system 里出现的先后排列。

每个注入点是一个可折叠的小节，有规则的默认展开，点一下能收起。小节里点「+ 新增规则」写一条；同一个注入点的多条规则按列表从上到下的顺序拼接，中间空一行；不同注入点互不影响。

一条规则卡片上有这些东西：

| 元素 | 干什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 开关 | 关掉就不参与拼接，规则仍留在列表里 |
| 模型作用域 | 一枚胶囊，写着 `全部` / `已应用 N 个模型` / `无应用`，点它开弹层多选 |
| 文本 | 多行输入框，就是要注入的内容 |
| ↑ / ↓ | 调整这一注入点内的顺序，首尾自动禁用 |
| ⧉ | 复制一份，插在它后面 |
| ✕ | 删除，删完 Toast 里给一次「撤销」，撤销会放回原来的位置 |

编辑后 500ms 自动提交，顶部一直显示保存状态：`保存中 / 已保存 / 保存失败`。没有单独的保存按钮，也不需要。写失败或版本对不上时会回滚到服务端的最新值并提示你，不会静默覆盖。

## 注入点

| 设置页里叫 | 键 | 怎么进 system | 落在哪 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 用户前置词 | `user.prefix` | 插入一条独立 user 消息 | 当前用户输入之前，每轮只注入一次 |
| 用户后置词 | `user.suffix` | 同上 | 当前用户输入之后，每轮只注入一次 |
| system 头部 | `system.personaHead` | 替换官方那一段 | 官方 persona 头（order 0），官方用来说明当前调用的模型名 |
| 工具说明之前 | `system.beforeTools` | 新加一段 | order 950 |
| 工具说明之后 | `system.afterTools` | 新加一段 | order 3050 |
| 结构化输出之前 | `system.middle` | 新加一段 | order 9800 |
| system 尾部 | `system.personaTail` | 替换官方那一段 | 官方 persona 尾（order 10200），0.2.1 起默认为空串 |
| system 最末尾 | `system.last` | 新加一段 | order 10300，排在官方 persona 尾之后 |

system 那六项的两种做法分得很清楚：

- **替换**（头部 / 尾部）：官方本来就有这两段，插件只把它们的内容换掉。没配规则的那一侧原样不动，还是官方默认（0.2.1 起官方尾默认是空串）。官方段不会因为替换而消失，也不会出现重复的两段。
- **新加一段**（工具说明之前 / 之后、结构化输出之前、system 最末尾）：官方没有对应段落，插件在指定段位加一段。没配规则时这段解析成空串，官方渲染时会直接丢掉，等于不存在，不会覆盖任何官方内容。

细节和官方段位参照表见 [docs/injectPoint.md](docs/injectPoint.md)。

## 用户前置词 / 后置词注入之后不会清除

这是设计决定，也是这个插件唯一需要你提前知道的代价，所以设置页在这两个小节顶部就写着这句话。

- 注入的前后缀是**独立的 user 消息**，和你打的原文一样落进会话历史，之后每一轮模型都还能读到。
- 注入之后就再也不动它：不压缩、不清除、不还原，一轮一轮累积下去。
- 上一轮的后置词会夹在上一轮原文和这一轮输入之间，模型很可能把它当成「用户又补充了一句」。所以这两个位置只写不会引起误解的话，比如统一的输出要求；别写带时间、带轮次、带指代的内容。
- 你发的那条消息本身不会被改动，聊天记录仍然是真的。
- 到 provider 那边，连续的 user 消息会被 DeepSeek adapter 合并成一条 `{前置词}原文{后置词}`；pi-ai 那类不合并，就是三条。
- 一轮只注入一次：工具循环的续跑请求不会再加一遍，本轮那份继续保持。

想让某句话只在 system 里生效、不留在用户历史里，就配到 system 那几个注入点去。

## 模板字段

规则正文里可以写这几个字段，发送时会换成这次请求的真实值：

| 字段 | 换成什么 |
| --- | --- |
| `{{model}}` | 这次请求实际用的模型 id，比如 `deepseek-flash` |
| `{{provider}}` | 这个模型属于哪个 provider，比如 `deepseek-account` |
| `{{cwd}}` | 当前会话工作目录的绝对路径 |

`model` / `provider` 就是官方在用的两个提示词变量（官方 persona 头用的就是 `{{model}}`）。`cwd` 从 0.2.1 起官方不再注册，插件自己从会话头兜底取，效果一样。设置页每个展开的小节顶部都有一行字段徽章，点一下就把 `{{字段}}` 插到最近编辑那条规则的光标处；一条规则都没有时，点徽章会直接新建一条。

渲染时机：

- **用户前置词 / 后置词**：注入那一刻就渲染成成品再落进历史。当时是什么就是什么，之后不会再变（注入是永久保留的）。
- **system 各项**：每次组装 system 时渲染，渲染完这一段标成不再插值，官方的插值器碰不到我们注入的花括号。

认不出来、这次拼错、或者取不到值的字段，`{{名字}}` 会**原样保留**，不报错、也不会让这次请求失败。名字不合法的（中文、大写）一律当普通文本。想真的写出 `{{model}}` 这几个字而不是让它被换掉，写成 `{{ model }}` 或者换个大小写就行。

## 模型作用域

- 模型键是 `<provider>/<model>`，比如 `deepseek-account/deepseek-flash`。
- 弹层里「全部」和各模型同列，按 provider 分组，带搜索。
- 点「全部」= 对所有模型生效，**含以后新增的**，而且不会清空其它勾选；取消「全部」之后，之前勾的模型继续生效。
- 既没勾「全部」也没选模型，这条规则当前不生效，卡片上是 `无应用`（虚线圈出）外加一句轻提示。
- 存过的模型键在当前目录里找不到了，会标成 `已失效` 并保持勾选，等你自己去取消；在你取消之前，它按**不匹配**处理，也就是不注入。
- 目录跟着 dsh 实时走：在 dsh 里加删改模型、改密钥，设置页马上就能看到，不用重启 dsh、也不用刷新页面。某个 provider 的目录没拉全时，列表顶部会说一句，那些没列出来的模型就会显示成「已失效」——这不是规则坏了。
- 「这一步算哪个模型」只有一套判据：优先官方模型选择投影（就是你在下拉里点的那个），拿不到再退到这次会话最近一次请求的路由，再退到 agent 建立时的选项。system 头部 / 尾部更准一层，直接用这次组装定下来的 provider 和模型。

## 配置存在哪里

`~/.dsh/dsh-prompt-inject/rules.json`（Windows 上一般是 `C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\dsh-prompt-inject\rules.json`，.dsh 文件夹路径由宿主决定）。

写入走原子替换，带跨进程文件锁，权限 `0600`。文件坏掉或者结构版本不认识时，它会带着时间戳改名成 `rules.json.<时间戳>.bad` 留着（现场可查），然后用空配置继续跑，不会静默把你的规则清空。这个文件由插件自己读写，建议只在设置页里改。

结构长这样，一条规则就是一个对象，八个注入点每个都只是一串规则，没有例外：

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "revision": 12,
  "slots": {
    "user.prefix": {
      "rules": [
        {
          "id": "r1",
          "enabled": true,
          "text": "总是用中文回答",
          "models": { "all": true, "list": ["deepseek-account/deepseek-flash"] }
        }
      ]
    },
    "system.beforeTools": { "rules": [] }
  }
}
```

`revision` 每次写入加一，用来挡掉两个窗口同时写的情况。

## 已知限制

- 用户前置词 / 后置词永久留在会话历史里，见上面那一节。
- 设置页不显示「当前模型」。多会话并行时那个值不可信，切换也未必及时反映，拿来提示只会误导。规则按 `provider/model` 匹配这件事，看卡片上的作用域结论和弹层就够了。
- 没有「这条规则最终拼成什么」的预览区。目前暂不做。
- 排序只有 ↑ / ↓，没有拖拽。
- 模型目录的实时更新只覆盖 dsh 自己推送的变化。直接编辑 dsh 的配置文件、或者远端 provider 自己上下架模型，这边不会自动知道 —— 刷新页面就能拿到新目录。
- 有几道硬上限：一个注入点最多 200 条规则，单条正文最多 20000 字，一条规则最多勾 500 个模型键。超了保存会失败，并逐条告诉你哪一项有问题，已有的配置不会因此丢掉。
- 设置页文案目前以中文为主，注入点键名和模型键保持英文原样。
- 目标版本写死在 `engines.dsh`（现在是 `0.2.1-rc.2`）。dsh 从 0.2.1 起会硬检查这条要求：不满足就把整个 bundle **静默跳过**（只在启动诊断的 `skippedBundles` 里留一条原因，不报错），所以升级 dsh 之后插件「不见了」，第一件事就是改这个值。dsh 还在 developer preview，破坏兼容的改动是常态。

## 开发

一个 npm 包，两半：

- **host**：cordis 插件 `lib/index.js`，管配置文件、注入逻辑、HTTP 端点。
- **client**：`lib/client.js`，手写浏览器包，不走构建链，由 `package.json` 的 `dsh.client` 声明。

设计文档在 `docs/`，都挺短：

| 文件 | 讲什么 |
| --- | --- |
| [docs/injectPoint.md](docs/injectPoint.md) | 注入点、官方段位、两种语义的由来与约束 |
| [docs/injectFormat.md](docs/injectFormat.md) | 前后缀的注入格式、模板字段与渲染时机 |
| [docs/injectScopeAndSetting.md](docs/injectScopeAndSetting.md) | 规则模型、怎么算「这次是哪个模型」、配置文件位置 |
| [docs/settingGUI.md](docs/settingGUI.md) | 设置界面、数据通道（三个 `/api` 端点）、目录刷新的事件表 |

动手前值得知道的几件事：

- 注入点表有两份：`lib/injectPoints.js` 是权威的那份，`lib/client.js` 里内联了一份一模一样的（客户端半不能 import）。改表要两边一起改，`.agents/checks/client-shape.mjs` 会检查两边是否一致。
- `@deepseek-ai/*` 一律声明成 `peerDependencies`，不能装成本地依赖 —— 那样会变成两份模块实例，`instanceof` 和模块私有的 WeakSet 都会失效。
- 客户端半只在浏览器里 `require('@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives')`。从 0.2.1 起它不再是磁盘上的独立包，而是 web 前端模块表里的 baseline 模块（`require` 照样解析得到），所以 `dsh.client.inject` 里不列它；`peerDependencies` 里那份只是标版本。新版 `dsh.client` 另有 `external`（声明非 baseline 的动态包）和 `immediately`，我们都没用到。
- 端点开在官方 `/api` 下面，鉴权由官方那层处理，插件自己不写；所以只支持 `GET` / `HEAD` / `POST`。
- 校验脚本分两组：`npm test` 跑纯 node 那组（clone 下来就能验，不依赖任何官方包）；`npm run test:host` 跑要官方包那组，没临时解包会直接退出码 2 并打印怎么搭（`npm run test:all` 两类一起）。细节见 [.agents/checks/README.md](.agents/checks/README.md)。
- host 侧代码改了要重启 dsh；只改客户端那一半刷新页面就行。
- 项目协作规范见 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把输入框模型选择器改成按来源渠道分块 + 下钻选模型，保留搜索与推理强度
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-block-picker

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件 —— **按模型来源分块**的输入框模型选择器。

把官方那个「所有模型拉成一条长列表」的选择器，换成**先按来源渠道分块、再下钻进块内选模型**的两级结构；搜索、推理强度（Reasoning Effort）、模型可用性等原有能力**完全保留**。

---

## 效果

点击输入框右下角的模型位，弹出的不再是长长的平铺列表，而是**按来源分块的卡片网格**：

![分块面板与搜索、推理强度、速度与输出详略](docs/screenshot-panel.png)

- **① 全局搜索** —— 直接在顶部输入 `v3` / `sonnet` / `r1`，跨全部来源聚合匹配；回车选中首项。
- **② 按来源分块** —— 每个渠道一张卡片，标出「N 个模型」与「进入 →」；卡片可拖动排序。
- **③「当前」标记** —— 正在使用的来源高亮描边 + 右上角蓝标。
- **④ 推理强度彩色滑条** —— 可拖动的 Low → Max 渐变滑条，点击刻度文字可直达。
- **⑤ 速度 / 输出详略** —— 当前模型支持时才出现，不支持则整行隐藏。

深色模式使用同一套主题 token，强调色为 `--dsw-alias-link`（`#7aaaff`），不再出现白底白字：

![深色模式下的分块面板](docs/screenshot-dark.png)

搜索框左侧的 ⚙ 打开**显示设置**，可按提供方整体开关，也可展开逐个开关模型：

![显示设置面板](docs/screenshot-settings.png)

触发按钮本身与同排的截图 / 麦克风图标保持同一设计语言（主题描边与文字）：

![输入框模型位与同排图标](docs/screenshot-composer.png)

---

## 功能

- **按来源分块**：DeepSeek 账号、DeepSeek API，以及 CodeBuddy / Qoder / TRAE 等第三方渠道，各自成为一张卡片；卡片上显示来源名、模型数量，当前所用来源带「当前」标记。
- **两级下钻**：点卡片 → 进入该渠道内只含它自己模型的列表；顶部 `← 所有来源` 或 `Esc` 返回。
- **全局搜索**：直接输入 `v3` / `sonnet` / `r1` 等关键词即可跨所有来源聚合匹配，回车选中首项；清空即回到分块视图。
- **推理强度（彩色滑条）**：当前模型支持 reasoning 时，浮层底部出现一条**可拖动的渐变色滑条**（Low → Max 分档，带发光 thumb），点击刻度文字也能直接跳档；右侧显示当前档位，`恢复模型默认` 一键回到提供方推荐值。
- **速度 / 输出详略自适应**：订阅类提供方（如 ChatGPT 订阅）的模型若支持 `speedMode` / `outputVerbosity`，浮层底部会**额外出现对应的分段控件**；不支持的模型或提供方这两项**自动隐藏**，不会出现死开关。
- **显示设置面板**：搜索框左侧的 ⚙ 按钮打开设置，可**按提供方整体开关**、也可**展开逐个开关单个模型**是否出现在选择器里；顶部显示已隐藏数量，底部可一键恢复全部。
- **提供方拖拽排序**：卡片可直接拖动调整先后顺序（拖动时卡片半透明、目标位显示描边），松手即保存。
- **偏好持久化**：顺序、隐藏来源、隐藏模型全部写入 `localStorage`（key `dsh-model-block-picker.prefs.v1`），刷新与重启后保持；不存在的来源会在下次自动清理。
- **主题自适应**：浅色、深色均用 DSH 主题 token，深色下强调色使用 `--dsw-alias-link`（`#7aaaff`）而非会反转成近白的 `--dsw-alias-brand-primary`。

## 安装

### 从本机目录安装（开发 / 自用）

在 DSH 会话里对 Agent 说：

> 帮我安装位于 `<本仓库路径>` 的插件

Agent 会执行 `plugin_manager(action: 'install_bundle', target: '<绝对路径>')`。

安装后**彻底退出 DSH 桌面端再重新打开**（客户端 bundle 有启动基线缓存，仅刷新页面不一定加载新代码）。

卸载：`plugin_manager(action: 'remove_bundle', target: 'dsh-model-block-picker')`，回退到官方原生选择器。

## 它是怎么工作的

### 1. 覆盖官方选择器（Slot 影射）

输入框模型位是 DSH 公开的一个**命名插槽**：`conversation.input.model`（`kind: "single"`，会话作用域）。

- 官方实现注册在优先级 `-10`；
- 动态安装的插件注册同名插槽时，系统分配**更低的数值即更高优先级**获胜；
- 本插件显式注册 `priority: -20`，因此作为 winner 覆盖原生组件，卸载即自动回退。

> 注意：`single` 槽位要求同优先级唯一，所以必须用负数优先级，否则会抛
> `single slot already has a registration`。

### 2. 复用官方数据服务（不重复造轮子）

不自己请求后端。通过 `ctx.modelDirectories`：

```js
const directory = models.directoryFor(sessionId);
directory.store   // 快照：{ groups: [{ id, name, models: [...] }], current: { provider, model, reasoningEffort } }
directory.load()  // 拉取目录
directory.select({ provider, model, reasoningEffort })  // 提交选择
```

与 `/model` 命令弹窗**共用同一份会话级目录**，任一入口的切换另一入口立即可见。

### 3. 深色外观的白，来自主题而不是硬编码

早期版本手写 `#1c1f23` 之类的兜底色，在深色下不会反转，导致字和箭头变深灰。现在全部改用真实 token：

| 用途 | token | 深色取值 |
|---|---|---|
| 主文本 | `--dsw-alias-label-primary` | `#f9fafb`（off-white，非纯白） |
| 边框 | `--dsw-alias-border-l1` | `#ffffff0f` |
| 背景 | `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1/2`、`--dsw-alias-bg-overlay` | — |
| 品牌色 | `--dsw-alias-brand-primary` | — |

深色下额外用 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` 把触发按钮设为 `.5px` 描边 + 该 token，与右侧截图插件
（`color: var(--dsw-alias-label-primary)` + `fill:none stroke=currentColor stroke-width=1`）
保持同一笔画重量。

> **踩坑记录**：写 CSS 时**别凭印象编变量名**。DSH 里**不存在**
> `--dsw-alias-text-regular`、`--dsw-alias-border-subtle`、`--dsw-alias-surface-overlay`、
> `--dsw-alias-primary` 这些名字——它们会静默回落到你写的兜底值，浅色看着没事、深色就崩。
> 可用 `cordis_inspect_query(platform: 'client', provider: 'Theme', method: 'listTokens')` 查真实 token。

## 文件结构

```
dsh-model-block-picker/
├── package.json          # 清单：dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client 声明
├── cordis.patch.yml      # Loader patch：把本包插进 profile 名单
├── index.js              # 宿主半边（挂 /diag 诊断路由）
├── client.js             # 浏览器半边：React 组件 + 样式 + 插槽注册
├── .github/workflows/
│   └── publish.yml       # 推 main 即发布 npm + 打 tag + 建 Release
├── scripts/
│   └── release-notes.mjs # 从 CHANGELOG 抽取当前版本的 Release 正文
├── CHANGELOG.md
├── LICENSE
└── README.md
```

## 诊断

排障时会用到：

- 宿主侧日志前缀 `[dsh-model-block-picker]`（DSH 日志里搜这个）。
- 浏览器端各生命周期节点会打到 `/plugins/dsh-model-block-picker/diag`：
  `module-evaluated` → `apply-called` → `slot-inject-triggered` → `registered-success`。
  若停在 `register-error`，说明槽位/优先级冲突；停在 `apply-error` 多半是 `inject` 未声明就访问了服务。

> **另一个坑**：客户端沙箱对服务访问有白名单。顶层 `inject` 声明了 `['slots','modelDirectories']`，
> 就**不能**再直接读 `ctx.sessions`，否则抛 `service "sessions" is not declared` 并当场崩溃。

## 已知限制

- 只替换输入框（composer）的模型位；`/model` 命令弹窗仍是官方样式（两者共用同一份数据，切换互通）。
- 已寻址的 subagent 会话不提供模型选择（沿用官方约定）。
- 来源分组顺序：默认 DeepSeek 账号 → DeepSeek 官方 → 其余按名称排；**可直接在面板里拖动卡片自定义顺序**，保存于 `localStorage`。
- 速度 / 输出详略依赖提供方暴露能力：目前只有实现了 `speedMode` / `outputVerbosity` 偏好的提供方（如 `dsh-codex-subscription` 的 `openai-codex`）会被识别；其他提供方这两项不显示。
- 偏好保存在浏览器 `localStorage`，因此**按浏览器 profile 隔离**，不随 DSH 账号同步。

## 发布流程

发版只有一步：**push 到 `main`**。

```bash
# 1. 改代码
# 2. 改 package.json 的 version
# 3. 在 CHANGELOG.md 加一个 ## [x.y.z] 段落
git push                     # ← 只有这一步会触发发布
```

`publish.yml` 随后依次完成：校验版本号 → 确认 npm 上还没有这个版本 → `npm publish`（带 provenance）→ 打 `vX.Y.Z` tag → 用 CHANGELOG 对应段落建 GitHub Release。

### 只有第一次需要手动配置

npm 那边要认这个仓库，得先建一次「信任关系」（之后永久有效）。

**前置条件：npm 账号必须已开启 2FA。** 未开启时 registry 直接拒绝可信发布器的读写（`403 Please enable 2fa for your account`），而且这个报错只在你尝试配置时出现，不会提前提示。2FA 用安全密钥（passkey / Windows Hello）或验证器 App 都行，等级选 `auth-and-writes`。

**方式一：命令行**

```bash
npm trust github dsh-model-block-picker \
  --file publish.yml \
  --repo liu19666/dsh-model-block-picker \
  --allow-publish
```

这是账号级写操作，会要求一次性口令：终端会打印一个 `https://www.npmjs.com/auth/cli/<id>` 链接（npm 11.19 起把链接里的 id 打码成了 `***`，看不到就改用下面的网页方式），在浏览器里用你的 2FA 完成验证即可。

**方式二：网页**

1. 打开 <https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-model-block-picker/settings>，找到 **Trusted Publisher**。
2. 选 **GitHub Actions**，填三项（区分大小写，仓库和文件名都不能带路径）：

   | 字段 | 值 |
   | --- | --- |
   | Organization or user | `liu19666` |
   | Repository | `dsh-model-block-picker` |
   | Workflow filename | `publish.yml` |

3. **Allowed actions 里勾上直接发布。** 2026-09-03 起新建的可信发布器默认只允许 `npm stage publish`（把包丢进待审队列，需要人手动 2FA 批准）。本仓库要的是无人值守直接发布，必须额外勾选 `npm publish`。漏了这一步，工作流会以 `403` 失败，而 npm 保存配置时**不会**校验这些字段，错误只会在发布那一刻才出现。
4. Environment name 留空——工作流没有声明 `environment`，填了反而对不上。

### 它不会踩的几个坑

- **不写死版本号。** 版本号的唯一来源是 `package.json`；`CHANGELOG` 段落只决定 Release 正文，漏写不会导致失败（会退回 GitHub 自动生成的 notes）。
- **幂等。** 每个 job 都先检查自己的产物是否已存在：版本已在 npm 上就跳过发布，tag 已存在就跳过 Release。所以重跑失败的任务、或者忘了改版本号又推一次，都不会重复发布，也不会有「版本号被占了但 tag 没打」这种半成品状态。
- **不需要任何 secret。** 认证走 GitHub OIDC：npm 验证的是「这个仓库、这个分支、这个工作流文件」签出的短期令牌，没有 `NPM_TOKEN` 可泄露，也无法从别人机器上重放。
- **发布前不做任何不可逆的事。** npm 版本号一旦发布就永久占用，所以版本格式、npm 是否已有该版本这些检查全在 `preflight` job 里跑完，`publish` 才会启动。
- **预发布版本不会顶掉 `latest`。** `1.2.0-beta.1` 会以 `beta` 这个 dist-tag 发布，Release 也标成 prerelease —— 否则 `npm install dsh-model-block-picker` 会给陌生人装上一个 beta。
- **`.npmrc` 里不留凭据。** `actions/setup-node` 一旦带 `registry-url`，就会往 `.npmrc` 写 `//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${NODE_AUTH_TOKEN}`；可信发布场景下这个变量是故意不设的，展开成空串后 npm 会误以为「凭据已配置」，直接跳过 OIDC 交换并报 `ENEEDAUTH`（[npm/documentation#1960](https://github.com/npm/documentation/issues/1960)）。本工作流因此**不传** `registry-url`（npm 本来就默认官方源），并在发布前断言 `.npmrc` 里没有 `_authToken`，让失败指向真正的原因。

### 只想发一次 npm、不想建 Release

手动跑一次 `workflow_dispatch` 也行；或者反过来，用 `gh release create` 手工发版——工作流只认 `package.json` 的版本号，不关心是谁推的。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugins: academic literature search tools (OpenAlex/arXiv/Crossref/Semantic Scholar/PubMed + Unpaywall), and a Web sidebar layout fix.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugins

Four plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`).

| Plugin | Category | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [dsh-scholar](packages/dsh-scholar) | tools | Four model-facing tools for literature work — `paper_search`, `paper_get`, `paper_citations`, `book_search` — over OpenAlex, arXiv, Crossref, Semantic Scholar and PubMed, with open-access PDF resolution through Unpaywall |
| [dsh-sidebar-tidy](packages/dsh-sidebar-tidy) | ui | Keeps the Web sidebar workspace and session list clickable when footer plugins grow tall, by capping and scrolling the plugin-action area |
| [dsh-hiddify](packages/dsh-hiddify) | tools | Drives a local Hiddify installation without its GUI: seven tools to start and stop the core, hot-switch split-tunnel modes, rotate exit nodes, and search or fetch through the proxy |
| [dsh-karing](packages/dsh-karing) | tools | The same for a local Karing installation: seven tools, with mode switching done by repointing the system proxy at one of Karing's three mixed inbounds, so it takes under a second and never restarts the core |

Each is a Cordis plugin that declares a `dsh.bundle` manifest, so it installs with
`dsh plugin add`.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin add github:Cjrrrrrrrr/dsh-plugins#path:/packages/dsh-scholar
dsh plugin add github:Cjrrrrrrrr/dsh-plugins#path:/packages/dsh-sidebar-tidy
dsh plugin add github:Cjrrrrrrrr/dsh-plugins#path:/packages/dsh-hiddify
dsh plugin add github:Cjrrrrrrrr/dsh-plugins#path:/packages/dsh-karing
```

Each package also works on its own — see its README for configuration and
limitations.

## Requirements

DSH 0.1.0-rc.1 or newer, and Node 20+.

The plugins import `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`
dynamically and degrade gracefully when they are absent, which is why both are
declared as *optional* peers — installing these plugins never pulls official
packages into your profile.

`dsh-hiddify` and `dsh-karing` are **Windows only** and expect Hiddify or Karing
to be installed already. Neither plugin ships or replaces those programs' own
binaries: they drive the copy you installed, and both need a path to it
configured after installation.

## Repository layout

```
packages/dsh-scholar/
  lib/sources.js        data layer — one pure function per source, no host dependency
  lib/index.js          host half — registers the four tools
  cordis.patch.yml      the bundle row
packages/dsh-sidebar-tidy/
  lib/client.js         browser half — the injected CSS
  lib/index.js          host half — an empty placeholder
  cordis.patch.yml      the bundle row
packages/dsh-hiddify/
  lib/core.js           HiddifyCli control layer
  lib/net.js            system-proxy switch + three-way connectivity probe
  lib/proxy.js          zero-dependency CONNECT-tunnel HTTP client
  lib/search.js         multi-engine search + HTML-to-text
  lib/index.js          host half — registers the seven tools
  cordis.patch.yml      the bundle row
packages/dsh-karing/
  lib/core.js           Karing control layer
  lib/net.js            system-proxy switch + three-way connectivity probe
  lib/proxy.js          zero-dependency CONNECT-tunnel HTTP client
  lib/search.js         multi-engine search + HTML-to-text
  lib/index.js          host half — registers the seven tools
  tools/embed-kernel.mjs  copies your own karingService.exe into the plugin for port isolation
  cordis.patch.yml      the bundle row
```

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).
