plugins.description: 用于dsh上使用的操控Alist的插件
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-alist

让 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）通过对话浏览、检索、上传与管理 [AList](https://github.com/AlistGo/alist) v3 的插件。

一句话：把「AList 上有什么、放到哪、谁能看」这件事变成一句话就能办完的事，写操作一律弹原生审批，密码与 Token 只写不读。

> **当前状态**：代码已完成，自检全绿（`npm run verify` → check + 20/20 单测）；
> 目标实例 `http://172.16.2.186:5244` 连通，版本 **v3.64.0**（与插件端点基线一致，已通过 `/api/public/settings` 核实）；
> 插件已 `link:` 装入本机 `web` profile，等重启 DSH 后做端到端验证。
> 首次使用建议先用只读工具试：`alist_me` → `alist_fs_list` → `alist_fs_search`。

## 为什么用它

- 列目录、取文件信息、只列子目录、关键词搜索、看压缩包内部结构、取直链——都在对话里完成。
- 建目录、重命名（单个/批量/正则）、移动、复制、删除、上传、离线下载、解压——写操作触发强制审批。
- 管理端能力：存储挂载/启停/删除、驱动与配置字段查询、用户、角色、元数据、站点设置、搜索索引、会话、分享、标签。
- 凭据保存在本地 DSH 凭证库，**永不回显**给浏览器和模型；敏感字段在返回前递归脱敏。
- AList 返回的一切都当作**不可信数据**，绝不作为指令执行。

## 环境基线

| 组件 | 基线 |
| --- | --- |
| AList | **v3.64.0**（端点以 `server/router.go` 为准，向下兼容到 3.2x 的大部分端点） |
| Node.js | ≥ 20.11 |
| DeepSeek Harness | 0.1.2-rc.1 |

## 安装

装好后 agent 自动获得 75 个 `alist_*` 工具（73 个走端点表 + 2 个上传工具）。

### 本地安装（推荐先用这个）

命令行里没有 `dsh`？正常——CLI 内置在 DSH Desktop 安装目录里，而且默认 `DSH_HOME` 指向 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`，跟桌面端实际用的 `harness` 目录不是一回事，直接敲会失败或改错 profile。

仓库里带了脚本把这些都处理好：

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install-local.ps1            # 安装（link: 方式，改代码即时生效）
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install-local.ps1 -Uninstall # 卸载
```

等价的手工步骤（想自己敲的话）：

```powershell
$env:DSH_HOME = "$env:APPDATA\dsh-desktop\harness"
$env:PATH    += ";$env:APPDATA\dsh-desktop\harness\.desktop-bin"   # 内置 pnpm / node shim
# 打包后磁盘上只有 app.asar，CLI 与 node 必须走 app.asar.unpacked；
# asar 内部路径只有 Electron 能读，PowerShell / 系统 node 访问不到。
$node = "C:\Program Files\DSH Desktop\resources\app.asar.unpacked\node_modules\node\bin\node.exe"
$dsh  = "C:\Program Files\DSH Desktop\resources\app.asar.unpacked\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js"
& $node $dsh plugin --profile web list                             # 先确认 CLI 通
& $node $dsh plugin --profile web add link:C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\dsh-alist
```

装完**重启 DSH Desktop**（或重启 profile），插件才加载。

### 从 GitHub 安装

```powershell
& $node $dsh plugin --profile web add github:R-roker315/dsh-Alist-#v0.1.0
```

> 把 `<your-github-user>` 换成你的 GitHub 用户名。
> `plugin add` 底层转发给 `pnpm add`，`link:<dir>`、`github:<user>/<repo>#<tag>` 都支持。
> 免打包调试可直挂 overlay：`dsh --profile web --patch ./cordis.patch.yml`

## 配置

### 在哪里配（重要：新版 DSH 没有插件设置卡片了）

DSH 宿主（0.1.7+）**移除了插件设置卡片机制**（`settings.plugin.item` slot 已不存在，dsh-pve / dsh-grafana 等第三方插件同样受影响）。
配置统一走 **profile 配置文件**：

> DSH Web → 设置 → 内置插件 → 右上角 **「打开配置文件」**
> （即 `harness\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`）

在其中给插件条目加 `config`（`id` 必须与 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 insert id 一致，即 `alist`）：

```yaml
- id: alist
  config:
    baseUrl: http://172.16.2.186:5244
    authMode: password      # password = 账号密码换 JWT；token = 长期 token
    username: admin
    password: "你的密码"     # token 模式改用 token: "..."
    clientId: dsh-alist
    allowInsecureTls: false
    maxUploadBytes: 1073741824
```

保存后 DSH 会自动热重载该插件，无需重启。

> **明文提示**：配置文件里的 `password` / `token` 是明文存储（本机单人环境）；
> 插件侧对输出、审批文案、系统提示一律脱敏，不会回显到对话。
> 想更安全就用 AList 管理后台签发的长期 token 配合 `authMode: token`。

### 字段说明

| 字段 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Base URL | 例如 `http://127.0.0.1:5244`，不能带凭证、查询串或片段 |
| 用户名 | 例如 `admin`（密码模式使用） |
| 鉴权方式 | `账号密码`（登录换 JWT，默认 48 小时，自动续签）或 `长期 Token`（管理员后台签发） |
| Client-Id | 固定值即可保持同一设备会话，默认 `dsh-alist` |
| 跳过 TLS 校验 | 自签名内网证书时勾选 |
| 单文件上传上限（MB） | 默认 1024，超限时插件直接拒绝 |
| 密码 / Token | 存凭证库，**只写不读**，永不显示 |

管理端工具（`alist_admin_*`、`alist_fs_link`）需要**管理员**凭据，普通用户会得到 403；先用 `alist_me` 确认角色。

## 工具

75 个工具：**31 只读 / 44 写（含 2 个上传）**，其中 43 个是管理端（admin）工具。全部写操作强制原生审批，无法绕过。

| 域 | 工具 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 连接与身份 | 3 | `alist_me`、`alist_public_settings`、`alist_public_offline_tools` |
| 文件浏览 | 7 | list / get / dirs / search / archive meta / archive list / link |
| 文件写操作 | 11 | mkdir、rename、batch_rename、regex_rename、move、recursive_move、copy、remove、remove_empty_directory、add_offline_download、archive_decompress |
| 上传 | 2 | `alist_fs_put`（流式，推荐）、`alist_fs_form`（multipart） |
| 任务 | 2 | `alist_task_list`、`alist_task_action`（6 类任务 × 9 种动作） |
| 存储管理 | 8 | list / get / create / update / delete / enable / disable / load_all |
| 驱动 | 3 | list / names / info（建存储前先查字段） |
| 用户 | 7 | list / get / create / update / delete / cancel_2fa / del_cache |
| 角色 | 5 | list / get / create / update / delete |
| 元数据 | 5 | 路径密码、隐藏、readme 规则 |
| 站点设置 | 5 | list / get / save / delete / reset_token |
| 搜索索引 | 5 | progress / build / update / stop / clear |
| 会话与消息 | 4 | 会话列表与踢出、消息读取与发送 |
| 分享 | 5 | create / update / disable / delete / list |
| 标签 | 3 | list / get / 按标签列文件 |

完整逐个工具的参数表见 **[docs/tools.md](docs/tools.md)**（由 `node scripts/gen-tools-doc.js` 生成）。

## 调用约定

- **路径**必须是 AList 绝对路径（`/挂载点/子路径`），插件会直接拒绝相对路径。
- `names` / `urls` 这类数组参数：传 JSON 数组或逗号分隔字符串都行，插件自动转换。
- `storage` / `settings` / `message` / `rename_objects` / `permissions`：传 JSON 字符串，插件解析后按 AList 需要的形态提交（`storage`、`settings`、`message` 直接作为整个请求体）。
- 缺失必填参数会立即报错，不会带着空值打到 AList。
- 写请求**失败不重试**，避免重复执行；GET 请求遇到 401/403 会自动重登一次。

典型用法：

```
先用 alist_me 确认身份 → alist_fs_list 列 "/" → alist_fs_search 找文件
→ 需要直链用 alist_fs_link（需管理员）→ 上传用 alist_fs_put → 用 alist_task_list 轮询任务
```

挂载新存储：`alist_admin_driver_info`（拿字段）→ `alist_admin_storage_create`（传 storage JSON）→ `alist_admin_storage_load_all`。

## 安全

- 每个写工具都触发原生审批弹窗；`remove / delete / reset_token / clear` 类操作带 `⚠️ DESTRUCTIVE` 前缀。
- 审批文案里密码、Token、otp 一律显示 `[REDACTED]`。
- `alist_fs_remove` 是**永久删除**，没有回收站；批量/正则重命名影响面大，改前先列一遍。
- AList 返回的字段（文件名、readme）视为数据，不作为指令。

## 开发

```bash
npm install
npm run verify          # node --check + node:test（20 个用例）
node scripts/gen-tools-doc.js   # 改过 catalog.js 后重新生成 docs/tools.md
```

单测覆盖：URL 规范化、递归脱敏、路径/query/body 拆分、必填校验、绝对路径校验、数组与 JSON 参数转换、
列表字段裁剪、审批文案不泄漏密钥、目录表完整性（工具名唯一 + `alist_` 前缀 + 参数都有描述）。

## 结构

- `index.js` — 认证（密码换 JWT / 长期 Token）、泛型执行引擎、审批网关、上传工具、系统提示
- `catalog.js` — AList 端点目录表（唯一事实来源）+ 纯函数（脱敏、参数解析、输出裁剪），零依赖可单测
- `client.js` — 设置页表单卡片（slot key `alist`）
- `cordis.patch.yml` — bundle patch（insert id `alist` / name `dsh-alist`）
- `scripts/gen-tools-doc.js` — 由目录表生成 `docs/tools.md`
- `scripts/check-exports.mjs` — 静态自检，防止 `internals` 引用未导入的标识符（否则插件加载即崩）
- `scripts/install-local.ps1` — 本地安装/卸载（自动设好 `DSH_HOME`、pnpm shim、内置 Node）
- `test/index.test.js` — `node:test` 单测（20 个用例）
- `docs/tools.md` — 工具清单（生成物）

## 发布到 GitHub

> git 操作一律由仓库所有者手动执行（不要交给 agent）。

```bash
git init
git add .
git commit -m "feat: dsh-alist v0.1.0"
git branch -M main
git remote add origin https://github.com/R-roker315/dsh-Alist-.git
git push -u origin main
git tag v0.1.0 && git push origin v0.1.0
```

发 tag 后即可用 `dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:R-roker315/dsh-Alist-#v0.1.0` 安装。

# dsh-hard-delete

> **仓库**：<https://github.com/qwe4888789/dsh-hard-delete>
> **许可**：AGPL-3.0-only（+ 商业授权，见第九节） ｜ **版本**：v0.1.0 ｜ **类型**：cordis 插件（host + client 双半，零运行时依赖）

在 DSH 的侧边栏会话「…」菜单里加一行 **删除** —— 点一下就把这个会话**彻底删掉**：

- **不可恢复**：直接物理删除，不进回收站、没有回滚。
- **不设门槛**：不看「疑似还在活动」，不要求二次输入，只弹一次确认框（因为不可逆）。
- **当前会话也能删**：确认框会明确提示「这正是你当前打开的会话，删完请切换或刷新」。
- **删完整**：会话目录之外，还清掉指向它的 projcache 条目与 `workspace.json` 引用，
  避免留下悬空元数据。

> 与同机另一个插件 **`dsh-session-recycle`** 的分工：
> 那个是设置页里的「软删 → 回收站 → 恢复 / 回滚」，保守、可救回；
> 这个是菜单里的一键硬删。两者互不干扰（本插件不碰 `_recycle-bin/`）。

---

## 一、形态与注册

本插件**同时**声明 `dsh.bundle` 与 `dsh.client`，因此走 **bundle 层**注册：

```json
"dsh": {
  "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" },
  "client": { "inject": [], "platform": "web" }
}
```

> `dsh.client.inject` 刻意留空：本插件浏览器半只 `require("react")`（平台种子词）。
> 为什么不去 require 官方 UI 组件库，见第六节第 7 条。

> ⚠️ 只有 `dsh.client` 而**没有** `dsh.bundle` 的插件不能进 `dsh.profile.bundles` ——
> 宿主会以 `declares no dsh.bundle` 拒绝并**启动即崩**。本插件两个都声明了，所以不受此限。

装到某个 profile：

```bash
# 方式 A（推荐）：让 DSH 自己装 —— 桌面端「插件 → 添加插件」里粘贴本仓地址，
#   或命令行（profile 名按你的实际环境改）：
dsh plugin --profile web add qwe4888789/dsh-hard-delete

# 方式 B：声明式手工安装
#   在 <DSH_HOME>/profiles/<name>/package.json 里
#     dependencies:        { "dsh-hard-delete": "link:<本仓路径>" }
#     dsh.profile.bundles: 追加 "dsh-hard-delete"
cd <DSH_HOME>/profiles/<name> && pnpm install
# 重启 DSH
```

> 桌面版（DeepSeek Harness 桌面端）的 `desktop` profile 由 Electron 应用独占，
> 别用 `dsh plugin --profile desktop …`（CLI 会直接拒绝）；桌面端请走「插件 → 添加插件」。

---

## 二、两个槽位

| 槽位 | 挂什么 | 为什么 |
|---|---|---|
| `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` | 菜单里的「删除」行（id `hard-delete`，order **500**，排在 archive 的 400 之后） | owner 注入 `{ sessionId, displayTitle }` 与 `useMenuOpenState` 钩子 |
| `shell.overlay` | 确认框 + 结果提示 | **必须挂在常驻浮层上**：确认框若挂在菜单项里，菜单一关它就跟着卸载了 |

菜单项只做一件事：把「待确认请求」写进模块级小 store，然后关掉菜单。
浮层里的对话框读同一个 store，所以在菜单卸载后依然活着。

界面**自绘**（官方 `MenuItemButton` / `Modal` / `Button` / `Toast` 拿不到，见第六节第 7 条），
但完全照官方 `Menu.module.css` 的规格来：`min-height:34px` / `padding:6px 8px` /
`gap:6px` / `border-radius: var(--dsw-radius-md)` / hover 用
`--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover`，危险行用 `--dsw-alias-state-error-primary` +
`--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover-danger`。DOM 也与官方同构：
`div > [role=separator] + button[role=menuitem]` —— 菜单的键盘遍历与焦点回收都是读 DOM 的，
自绘按钮同样能参与。每个 `var()` 都写了兜底值，主题变量缺失时不会变成透明。

---

## 三、host 半的路由

前缀可配（默认 `/api/dsh-hard-delete`），全部 **loopback-only + same-origin 校验**。

| 方法 | 路径 | 请求体 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/config` | — | 公开配置（`apiPrefix` / 文案覆盖 / 开关 / `configErrors`），**不含绝对路径** |
| POST | `/inspect` | `{sessionId}` | 一个会话的概况：标题 / 工作目录 / 大小 / 文件数 / 有无线索日志 |
| POST | `/delete` | `{sessionId, confirm:true}` | **彻底删除**（不可逆） |

错误统一 `{ error, code }`。值得注意的 code：`session-not-found`(404)、
`confirm-required`(400)、`invalid-sessionId`(400)、`path-escape`(400)、
`loopback-only`(403)、`body-too-large`(413)。

返回列表里**不含任何绝对路径**——界面只显示标题 / 工作目录 / 大小 / 文件数。

---

## 四、删一个会话要动几处

```
<DSH_HOME>/
├─ sessions/<projectKey>/<sessionId>/
│  └─ session[.v<N>].jsonl[.zstd]        ← ① 整个目录物理删除（多版本日志一起）
├─ storages/
│  ├─ session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json  ← ② 新版：每会话一个文件
│  ├─ session_projcache.json                ← ③ 旧版：tables.sessions[<id>]
│  └─ workspace.json                        ← ④ archivedSessionIds / pinnedSessionIds
│                                              / tables.workspaces[*].sessionIds
└─ （浏览器那一边）
   └─ ctx.emit('api-session/removed', id)   ← ⑤ 让侧边栏那一行立刻消失
```

安全性质：

- **路径纵深防御**：`sessionId` 必须是单层路径段（挡 `.` / `..` / 分隔符 / NUL），
  定位后再用 `relative()` 确认最终目录没跑出 `sessions/`。
- **只认精确路径**：只在 `sessions/<任意项目目录>/<精确的 sessionId>` 下动手，
  绝不复刻宿主的目录名编码规则（也就不会被规则变化带偏）。
- **不覆盖、不猜**：定位不到就是 404，什么都不做。
- **元数据清理失败不冒充删除失败**：降级成 `warnings` 如实回传，界面照实提示。
- **原子写 JSON**：先写 `.tmp-<pid>-<ts>` 再 rename，网络盘上失败也不留半个文件。
- **只读探测**：`/inspect` 全程不写盘。

---

## 五、七个实测踩出来的坑（本节是这份代码最有价值的部分）

1. **多帧 zstd：Node 的同步接口只解第一帧。** DSH 的会话日志是**多帧拼接**的。
   `zstdDecompressSync(整个文件)` 实测在 107 KB 的文件上只吐 187 字节（就第一帧），
   `zlib.createZstdDecompress()` 流也一样停在第一帧。必须按 magic `28 B5 2F FD`
   切帧、逐帧解。第一版没做这件事，标题/工作目录大面积读不出来。

2. **头部解码要「帧数 + 字节」双限。** 帧大小不固定（实测 1.5 KB ~ 35 KB 都有），
   只限帧数会漏后文，只限字节会白解一堆帧。两个都设，取先到的那个；
   并且 magic 也可能出现在压缩数据内部，解不开就跳过，靠 JSON 解析兜住误判。

3. **projcache 有两种布局，都得清。** 实测 `<home>/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`
   与 `<home>/storages/session_projcache.json` 的 `tables.sessions[<id>]` 同时存在。
   只清一种就会留下悬空条目。

4. **存在「空壳」会话目录。** 真实 `~/.dsh` 里有目录建了但没写成日志的会话
   （实测 15 个会话目录里有 1 个）。如果「必须扫到日志才算会话」，
   这类目录就永远删不掉。改成：**目录名精确等于 sessionId 就认**，
   日志有无只作为 `hasLog` 事实回传。

5. **侧边栏那一行不会自己消失 —— 但有一条现成的事件。**
   客户端 `ctx.sessions`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` 的 client 半）
   通过 `ctx.remote.$on('api-session/added' | 'api-session/removed', …)` 维护会话列表；
   宿主侧 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes` 把这批宿主 Cordis 事件原样转发给浏览器。
   所以删完文件只要 `ctx.emit('api-session/removed', sessionId)`，那一行立刻消失，
   不必等下一次 list 刷新，也不必自己去动客户端的列表状态。

6. **删除当前会话受 Windows 文件语义影响。** 宿主对日志文件是**持有句柄持续追加写**的。
   Node/libuv 打开文件时带 `FILE_SHARE_DELETE`，所以删除通常能成功（名字立刻消失），
   但宿主后台仍可能在写那个已经 unlink 的文件。因此确认框里明确写了
   「若它正在运行，建议删完重启一次 DSH」。

7. **`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 在浏览器里 require 不到。**
   浏览器端模块表里只有两类东西：平台种子词（react 一族）和**声明了 `dsh.client`
   的 Loader 条目**。primitives 两个都不是 —— 它没有 `dsh.client`，在插件树里也没有
   对应条目（实测 201 条 Loader 条目里没有它）；官方客户端插件是在**构建期**把它内联
   进自己 bundle 的。所以第三方插件要么自己上构建，要么自己画。本插件选择自己画，
   但严格照官方 `Menu.module.css` 的规格与主题变量来（见第二节）。
   推论：`dsh.client.inject` 里写一个不存在的包名不会报错（只是解析不到），
   真正会炸的是运行时的 `require` —— 所以本插件只 `require("react")`。

---

## 六、配置

`<DSH_HOME>/hard-delete.config.json`（可选；env 优先）。载入一次常驻，改完**重启 DSH** 生效。

```json
{
  "apiPrefix": "/api/dsh-hard-delete",
  "cleanMetadata": true,
  "emitRemovedEvent": true,
  "maxFiles": 20000,
  "headerFrames": 32,
  "headerScanBytes": 262144,
  "text": {}
}
```

env 覆盖：`DSH_HOME`、`HARD_DELETE_CONFIG`、`HARD_DELETE_API_PREFIX`。

`text` 段可按 key 覆盖界面文案（前端内置 zh 字典兜底；默认下发空表 = 不覆盖）。
`cleanMetadata:false` = 只删会话目录，留元数据；`emitRemovedEvent:false` = 不发那一行消失事件。

---

## 七、测试

```bash
node _test/test-host.mjs           # 39 项夹具断言，全在临时目录里跑，不碰真实会话
node _test/test-client.mjs         # 11 项客户端离线断言（最小 hooks 运行时跑一遍渲染）
node _test/smoke-real-readonly.mjs # 对真实 ~/.dsh 只读冒烟（不做任何写操作）
node _test/verify-e2e-copy.mjs     # 把真实 home 复制一份，走完整 HTTP 栈删一个真会话
```

夹具单测覆盖：多项目定位、版本号文件名、多帧 zstd 头部解码、两种 projcache 布局、
空壳目录、路径穿越、dryRun、workspace.json 引用清理、删除后 404、
loopback / Host / 跨站 / 跨源 / 405 / 非法 JSON / 413 / `confirm` 校验 /
`api-session/removed` 的发出与关闭开关。

客户端离线单测覆盖：factory 形态、**只 require `react`**、两个槽位的 id/order/locale、
文案 key 全部有兜底、菜单项 DOM 与官方同构且点击后关菜单并写入请求、
确认框三条警告齐全且默认焦点在「取消」、缺 slots API 时明确报错、
sessions 服务取不到时降级不炸。

`verify-e2e-copy.mjs` 是最后一道闸：真实会话目录里的多版本日志、真实 projcache
与 workspace.json，走完整链路删掉一个真会话后逐项核对，**真实库全程只读**。

---

## 八、明确不做的事（以及为什么）

- **不做回收站 / 回滚**：本插件就是「删掉」这一个动作。要可恢复请用 `dsh-session-recycle`。
- **不做活动守卫**：用户要的是「自由删除」，加守卫就回到了软删插件的语义。
  取而代之的是确认框里把风险讲清楚（不可恢复 / 当前会话 / 可能仍在写盘）。
- **不改主包的会话列表状态**：只发一个宿主事件，列表由客户端自己维护。
- **不碰宿主服务**：只 `inject: ['webServer']`，不 import 会话/工作区服务。
- **不返回绝对路径**：前端显示不了也不需要。

---

## 九、许可

**AGPL-3.0-only**（GNU Affero General Public License v3.0），全文见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。

本项目管理在 **AGPL-3.0** 下开放：个人、学习、开源项目可自由使用与修改。
若需在 **闭源** 或 **商业场景** 中使用（不愿承接 AGPL 的传染条款），请联系获取**商业授权** ——
本仓暂无公开的联系邮箱，**请通过本仓 Issue 联系**。

本仓自 v0.1.0 起即为 AGPL-3.0，尚无许可变更历史。

本仓代码为**独立实现**：实现时观察了宿主公开的运行时约定（HTTP 路由注册方式 `ctx.webServer.register`、
客户端打包形态 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load`、槽位注册 `ctx.slots.inject/register`、
磁盘布局与日志文件名、转发事件 allowlist）与官方 `Menu.module.css` 的公开样式规格；
**未复制任何第三方插件代码**。命名上刻意避开 npm 上已被占用的 `dsh-session-delete` / `dsh-session-recycle`。

---

## 十、发布与收录

- 发布流程、版本号策略与推送步骤见 [docs/RELEASING.md](docs/RELEASING.md)；
  推送脚本 [scripts/push-publish.mjs](scripts/push-publish.mjs)（token 只从环境变量读，不落盘、不进 git 配置）。
- **远端只有 GitHub**：插件市场按 GitHub 仓库索引，Gitee 镜像对本仓没有收益，故不做。
- **插件市场收录**：[dshbase](https://dshbase.com/) 与 [DSH 插件市场](https://github.com/bradeGithub/DSH-Plugins-Marketplace)
  按 GitHub 仓库的 **`dsh-plugin` topic 自动索引**（每 2 小时扫一次）。本仓的 topic：
  `dsh-plugin` · `dsh` · `deepseek-harness` · `cordis-plugin`。
- 市场按 `package.json` 的 `version` 判断更新；**发版必须 bump version**（见 CHANGELOG）。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tavily-cxykyw

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md) A [Tavily](https://tavily.com)-backed `WebSearchProvider` for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web capability seam (`ctx.web`). It routes the built-in `web_search` tool to Tavily's dedicated search API instead of the shipped DeepSeek model-based search channel, so **a search costs no model tokens** and the result set comes from a real search engine index rather than an auxiliary model request. Verified against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. > Package name note: `dsh-web-search-tavily` on npm belongs to another author. This plugin is published as **`dsh-tavily-cxykyw`**; the GitHub repository is still `cxykyw/dsh-web-search-tavily`. ## What it does - registers a search provider with the stable id **`tavily`** on `ctx.web`; - maps Tavily's response to DSH's normalized `WebSearchResult` — `results[].url/title/content` become `sources[].url/title/snippet`, and Tavily's optional `answer` becomes the result `content`; - resolves the API key on **every** search, in this order: literal `apiKey` → credentials service (`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`) → launch environment / `process.env`; - `available()` is a cheap local check (key + base URL present) with no network calls — a missing key surfaces as `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING` at search time; - then truncates to `request.maxResults` through the seam, exactly like any other provider. ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tavily-cxykyw ``` If your DSH profile is a pnpm workspace root (the default `~/.dsh/profiles/web` is), the add must target the workspace root: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tavily-cxykyw -w ``` The bundled `cordis.patch.yml` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so adding the package also registers it as a profile bundle: the provider row is inserted **and** `web.searchProvider` is set to `tavily` for you. Restart `dsh web` afterwards — bundle changes are not hot-reloaded. From a checkout instead of npm: ```sh git clone https://github.com/cxykyw/dsh-web-search-tavily.git dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-web-search-tavily -w ``` ## Configure the API key Get a key at [app.tavily.com](https://app.tavily.com) (there is a free tier). Then pick **one** of: **1. Credentials file (recommended — outside every repository):** ```yaml # ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml TAVILY_API_KEY: tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx ``` **2. Environment variable** of the process that launches DSH: ```sh TAVILY_API_KEY=tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx dsh web ``` **3. Literal key in your own profile patch** (works, but keeps the secret in a plain file — prefer 1 or 2): ```yaml # ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml - id: web-search-tavily config: apiKey: tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx ``` > **Never commit an API key.** This repository, its `cordis.patch.yml`, and its published npm tarball contain **no** credentials and no default key: the plugin only ever reads them from your machine at search time. `.gitignore` also excludes `.env*`, `.npmrc`, and `*.local.yml`. ## Options Configurable on the inserted `web-search-tavily` row: | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `apiKey` | — | Literal Tavily API key. Prefer `apiKeyEnv` + credentials/env. | | `apiKeyEnv` | `TAVILY_API_KEY` | Credential reference / environment variable name to resolve the key from. | | `baseURL` | `https://api.tavily.com` | Tavily API base URL (point it at a proxy if you need one). | | `searchDepth` | `basic` | `basic` (fast, 1 credit) or `advanced` (deeper crawl, more credits). | | `maxResults` | `8` | Results requested per search, 1–20. A per-call `maxResults` still wins. | Example, overriding just the depth and result count: ```yaml # ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml - id: web-search-tavily config: searchDepth: advanced maxResults: 5 ``` ## Switching providers The bundle patch already pins the seam: ```yaml - id: web config: searchProvider: tavily fetchProvider: http ``` To fall back to the official DeepSeek search, set `searchProvider: deepseek-official` (or remove the line only if `deepseek-official` is the single usable provider — with two usable providers and no pin, the seam fails closed with `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`). > Upgrading from a hand-inserted copy in your own profile patch? Delete that `insert` block and keep only the `- id: web-search-tavily` config override above, otherwise the row id is inserted twice. ## Notes and limitations - No Web settings page: DSH `0.2` cannot mount this plugin's settings section, so the provider is configured through the profile patch only. - `fetch` (page retrieval) is untouched — it stays on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http`. - Tavily search results carry no publication date, so `sources[].publishedAt` is not set. ## Uninstall ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-tavily-cxykyw -w ``` ## License MIT © cxykyw

plugins.description: Sign in to ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot and other subscription model routes inside the DeepSeek Harness — the sign-in button the Harness never shipped.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-subscription-signin

[![tests](https://github.com/amosogra/dsh-subscription-signin/actions/workflows/tests.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/amosogra/dsh-subscription-signin/actions/workflows/tests.yml)

**The sign-in button the DeepSeek Harness never shipped.**

Use the AI subscriptions you already pay for — ChatGPT Plus/Pro, Claude Pro/Max,
GitHub Copilot, and more — as model routes inside the
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Adds a
**Subscriptions** settings page plus a compact extension on every provider card
in **Settings → Models**.

```text
Settings → Subscriptions → ChatGPT (Codex) → [ Sign in with ChatGPT (Codex) ]
                                    ↓
                    github.com/login/device  ·  code ABCD-1234
                                    ↓
                    ✓ Signed in — draws on your plan
```

No password is ever collected or stored by this plugin. The vendor runs the
sign-in on its own page; the Harness credential store writes the token.

## Repository layout

The **installable package is the `dsh-subscription-signin/` directory.** The
tests, license and documentation sit beside it and are not part of the package:

```text
dsh-subscription-signin/   ← the package; this is what you install
  host.js                  ← the Host half (tool + HTTP route)
  client.js                ← the Client half (settings page + provider card)
  cordis.patch.yml         ← the accounts, as configuration
  locale/en.json           ← package metadata strings
  package.json
smoketest/                 ← five dependency-free suites (run from the root)
docs/FINDINGS.md           ← what was measured vs inferred
```

---

## Why this exists

The Harness already ships everything needed to *use* a subscription as a model
route. Its LLM adapter registers OAuth flows for eight providers — the transport
works, the token exchange works, the credential store works.

What it has no surface for is **starting** one. Nothing in the GUI or CLI ever
calls the authorization seam's `begin()`. This plugin is that missing surface.

It implements **no OAuth**. It does not touch PKCE, state, device codes, or token
parsing — all of that lives in `@earendil-works/pi-ai`, shipped by DeepSeek. This
plugin asks the Harness to begin a flow, shows you the URL and code, and reports
the result.

## Supported providers

Configured out of the box, driven through the Harness's own authorization seam:

| Provider | Credential | Login style |
|---|---|---|
| ChatGPT (Codex) | `llm-pi-ai/openai-codex` | device code |
| Claude (Pro/Max) | `llm-pi-ai/anthropic` | OAuth |
| GitHub Copilot | `llm-pi-ai/github-copilot` | device code |
| xAI | `llm-pi-ai/xai` | device code |
| Meta | `llm-pi-ai/meta` | device code |
| OpenRouter | `llm-pi-ai/openrouter` | OAuth + paste fallback |
| Radius | `llm-pi-ai/radius` | browser callback |
| Kimi For Coding | `llm-pi-ai/kimi-coding` | device code |

**Honest status.** Sign-in is verified end to end for **ChatGPT (Codex)** and
**Claude (Pro/Max)**; Claude's route was observed authenticating successfully and
then being rate-limited by the account (HTTP 429 with Anthropic's own
`request_id` — a quota answer, not a credential failure). Copilot's flow is
verified and completes. xAI, Meta, OpenRouter, Radius and Kimi hold credentials
that have been written successfully, but **no request has been served on those
routes in the session where this was verified**, so treat them as untested rather
than broken. `docs/FINDINGS.md` records what is measured versus inferred.

## Install

**Requirements.** DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` or later. Developed and verified
against `0.2.0-rc.2`, the release this plugin's two seams were checked on
(`ctx.authorization` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-authorization`, and the client
`slots` service). Every Harness service it consumes is reached with a defensive
`ctx.get(...)` plus an undefined check, so a missing one degrades to a reported
message instead of a crash — but a Harness that has moved a seam will still need
a matching plugin release.

The plugin is installed into a Harness **profile** as a bundle. Point the plugin
manager at this directory:

```text
install_bundle: link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-subscription-signin
```

Or, if you publish/consume it as a package, install by name and add it to your
profile's bundle list:

```jsonc
// $DSH_PROFILE_DIR/package.json
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-subscription-signin"] } }
```

Then **restart DSH once.** This matters and is explained under
[Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting) — the client half is composed into the
browser's boot graph at startup, so a freshly installed bundle has no page until
the process restarts.

## Use

From the GUI: **Settings → Subscriptions**, pick an account, press *Sign in*.

For an agent, or a headless harness, the same implementation is exposed as a tool
with actions `status`, `start`, `poll`, `cancel`, `signout`, `submitCode` and
`diagnostics`. Read `status` first; `start` returns the URL and, for device
grants, the code you enter on the vendor's page.

## Safety

This section is the reason to trust the plugin, so it is specific rather than
reassuring.

**It never sees a secret.** No password, token, API key or refresh token is read,
written, logged, or forwarded. The token is produced and stored by the Harness
credential seam (`ctx.authorization` / `ctx.credentials`), not by this code.
Audit it yourself — it is two files:

- **`host.js`** — zero imports. No filesystem access, no network requests, no
  child processes. It asks the credential store *whether* a record exists, and
  can delete one on explicit `signout` with `confirm: true`; it never reads a
  token value. The one `process.env` write is the documented per-account `env`
  field (used so a provider that selects its endpoint from the environment can be
  configured per account), and it is restored when the attempt settles.
- **`client.js`** — one dependency, `react`, supplied by the page. Its only
  `fetch` calls go to the plugin's own `/plugins/subscription-signin` route on
  your local Harness. Nothing is rendered from a credential.

**The one network-bearing route is trust-gated.** The panel reaches the Host half
over an HTTP route that inherits the Harness's own checks
(`connection.requestRejection`: Host/Origin validation and browser
authentication). On top of that, every mutating call must be a JSON `POST`, which
forces a CORS preflight and blocks form-based CSRF; bodies are capped at 64 KiB;
responses are `no-store` + `nosniff`.

**Not sanctioned by the vendors — read this.** For ChatGPT-plan usage, the
Harness targets the ChatGPT/Codex backend
(`chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex`), which OpenAI's developer documentation tells
third-party apps not to target for plan usage. **This plugin surfaces behaviour
the Harness already ships; it does not introduce it and cannot change it.** The
sanctioned path for third-party apps is *Sign in with ChatGPT*, which the Harness
does not implement. Using a subscription outside a vendor's intended client may
conflict with that vendor's terms, and vendors may rate-limit or block such
traffic. You are choosing to do that with your own account. Do not use this to
resell access, and do not use it to reach credentials that are not yours.

**No credentials are in this repository.** If you ever find one here, that is a
bug — please open an issue. The repository was scanned for tokens, private keys,
home paths and email addresses before its first commit. `docs/FINDINGS.md` does
cite exact package versions and source symbols from the Harness, which is
deliberate: a claim about a specific build is only useful if it names the build.

**Found a vulnerability?** Report it privately via
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) rather than a public issue. That file also lists what
is and is not in scope — worth reading first, because the unofficial-backend
caveat above is a documented trade-off rather than a defect, and the two are easy
to confuse.

## Configuration

Accounts are configured, not hardcoded. They live in this package's own
[`cordis.patch.yml`](dsh-subscripti

# Artifact Center · 产物中心

Find the file a DSH conversation produced, together with its workspace and conversation history.

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) · [Requirements](docs/requirements.zh.md) · [Acceptance record](docs/acceptance.zh.md) · [MIT](LICENSE)

## Features

- A global sidebar panel that works without an active conversation.
- Historical backfill from complete session events, including file writes, edits and explicitly presented deliverables.
- Live workspace snapshots at turn end to detect shell and subprocess outputs. Large output bursts are summarized rather than flooding the list.
- Workspace/tag/date filters, favorites, notes, bounded text-content search and a virtualized list. Check or uncheck extensions directly under “Readable formats” to control visibility; the choice is saved in this browser.
- Native image, PDF, Markdown, Mermaid, text/code, CSV/TSV, sandboxed HTML and media previews. Office files and binaries use the system's applications; no format conversion takes place.
- Conversation links, path/link copying, file-handler selection, provenance history and CSV/Markdown export.
- Missing-file checks and confirmed moves to the system trash. Retrieve a file using your file manager, then check files to restore its index status.
- A read-only `artifact_search` Agent tool and Chinese/English UI.

History records provenance and metadata; it **does not preserve old file contents**. Snapshot results are labeled as inferred because filesystem changes cannot prove which concurrent task caused them. Historical shell outputs that have no recorded path cannot be reconstructed from current files alone. Starting with 0.1.2, a separate provenance table preserves recorded outputs and annotations when the derived list cache is rebuilt. Persisted turn checkpoints survive restarts; completed turns are recovered without including files modified after their recorded end time. Removing the entire storage domain also removes provenance and annotations. `enableBetterSidebar` is reserved; delegation to that optional plugin is not implemented. The built-in Markdown and Mermaid renderers work independently.

## Install

From npm (published baseline: 0.1.0):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-artifact-center
```

Or install the repository while directory review is pending:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:YQing0123/dsh-artifact-center
```

Restart the Host and refresh the browser. The Electron-managed `desktop` profile must be installed through its plugin manager; do not manage it with CLI commands. Market availability depends on acceptance of the [directory entry](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin).

## Configuration

The plugin ID is `artifact-center`. Override settings in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- update:
    artifact-center:
      config:
        backfillOnStart: true
        snapshotOnTurnEnd: true
        burstThreshold: 500
        maxIndexedFiles: 50000
        previewMaxBytes: 20971520
        textMaxBytes: 1048576
        validationIntervalMs: 300000
        readableExtensions:
          - md
          - txt
          - json
          - yaml
          - yml
          - csv
          - js
          - ts
          - png
          - jpg
          - pdf
        autoTags:
          - name: Deliverable
            kind: glob
            value: outputs/**
          - name: Spreadsheet
            kind: ext
            value: xlsx
```

Automatic tag rules accept `glob`, `ext` and `session` (conversation-title substring). `readableExtensions` is a whitelist of extensions without the leading dot; the Artifact Center navigation shows the active list under “Readable formats”. An empty list uses all built-in supported formats. Files outside this whitelist are not indexed or content-read. Default ignored directories: `.git`, `node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `.next`, `__pycache__`, `.venv`, `target`, `.cache`, `.dsh`. `ignorePatterns` replaces the default list when explicitly supplied. State is held through the Host's `storageDomain` API under `artifact_center`.

HTTP routes under `/artifact-center/*` require the Host's browser authentication and same-origin request guard. Only indexed files inside their registered workspace can be read or opened; outside symlinks are rejected. HTML previews cannot execute scripts or access the network. Text search reads at most `textMaxBytes` per candidate; it is not a semantic or binary-document search engine.

## Agent tool

`artifact_search(query, workspace?, type?, tag?, since?, limit?)` returns matching metadata and paths. `workspace` accepts an ID or title; types include `doc`, `sheet`, `slide`, `image`, `web`, `data`, `code`, `media`, `archive` and `other`. `since` is an ISO timestamp and `limit` is at most 100. Missing and trashed files remain labeled in results.

## Development

Host and UI are plain JavaScript. Only the lazy Mermaid renderer is independently bundled; no Harness build preset or internal UI package is imported.

With the isolated development Host and authenticated `artifact-p0` browser running, `npm run test:ui` checks fixture-only previews, tag errors and a 10,000-record virtual list. API writes are intercepted and never reach real storage or system actions. `npm run test:locale` checks the English UI and restores the original language preference.

Search refreshes the current registered workspace boundaries before reading content. Removed workspaces and paths outside a workspace's changed root are excluded without deleting their recorded provenance. After committing the release source, pack into `.cache` and run `npm run release:check` to compare the archive with both the working files and Git HEAD and generate a local integrity receipt. This command does not publish or authenticate.

```sh
npm ci --legacy-peer-deps
npm run build:vendor
npm run check
npm test
npm pack
```

Renderer bundles and license notices are committed and shipped, so installation does not run a compiler. Test probes are excluded from the npm package and load only through a separate development overlay. Read [development notes](docs/dev-notes.zh.md) and [implementation corrections](docs/implementation.zh.md) before changing the integration.

The reference acceptance Host is DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`. Desktop `0.2.0` compatibility is declared in the optional native-opener peer range, but desktop installation must also pass that Host's plugin manager and browser acceptance. Older sessions rejected by the Host's migration are reported individually; their raw logs are never modified by this plugin.

## License

MIT. Browser renderers and their dependencies retain their own licenses; see [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) and `vendor/`.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that publishes the running Harness as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for other agent harnesses.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH MCP Server

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that publishes a **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** server from the
running Harness host, so other agent harnesses — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, another DSH, any MCP
client — can call DSH: start sessions, drive turns, wait for them, read transcripts, and cancel work.

The plugin is a Host-only bundle with **zero dependencies** (no DSH import, no third-party module),
so it installs into a profile and survives Harness upgrades that keep the service contracts.
Every request is attributed to the calling agent and every session is recorded against its creator,
so several harnesses can share one endpoint and still ask "which sessions are mine?".

The same tool table is also registered into the local Harness, so a DSH agent calls these tools
directly — switchable on this bundle's row in the Web **Plugins** page, and clamped to the calling
session's own authority (see [DSH-local tools](#dsh-local-tools)).

```
other harness ──MCP (Streamable HTTP or stdio)──> DSH MCP Server ──> DSH services
                                                                     sessionController / sessionQuery / tools
```

## What it exposes

| MCP tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `dsh_run_prompt` | Start a **new** DSH session and run one prompt; returns the assistant's final text and the new `sessionId`. Supports `cwd`, `agentPreset`, `permissionPreset`, `model` (`provider/model`), `wait: false`, `timeoutMs`. |
| `dsh_continue_session` | Send a prompt to an **existing** session (resuming it if it is cold). Keeps the session's context and workspace; `permissionPreset` re-pins the session's sandbox mode and approval policy before the prompt, and `model` (`provider/model`) overrides the session's model. Without `model` the session keeps the model it already runs. |
| `dsh_list_commands` | The slash commands a session's agent can currently run: the global command layer plus whatever that agent's preset composes, so availability differs per agent preset. |
| `dsh_run_command` | Run one slash command in a session and return its settled `{ kind, text, commandId }`. `line` takes a complete command line (`"/compact"`, `"/permission danger-full-access"`); `command` (+ optional `args`) takes a bare name. The command executes immediately without a model turn. |
| `dsh_list_sessions` | A page of the session index: `sessionId`, title, running state, archival state, activity time, and the recorded owning agent (`view: "full"` adds cwd and liveness). Narrow server-side with `query` (title/cwd/owner/id), `mine: true` (or the `restrictToOwner` setting), `owner: "<id>"`, and `running`; page with `cursor`/`nextCursor`. Archived sessions are hidden unless `includeArchived: true`, mirroring the Web UI. |
| `dsh_read_session` | A window of one session's transcript (user-authored and assistant messages only), plus the last durable `permissionPreset`. `mode: "tail"` (default, last 10) / `"head"` / `"outline"` (one compact row per message with a preview and length, no full text); `roles`, `afterSeq` + `window.nextAfterSeq` to page, `maxChars` (default 2000) to cap a single answer. Reports `totalMessages`, `matchedMessages` and `returned`, so the caller always knows what it has not read. `limit: 0` still means everything. Works while the session is archived. |
| `dsh_answer_request` | Answer a parked decision, only when the deployment sets `answerUserRequests: true`: `decision: "allow"|"deny"` for an approval (a one-shot grant, or a denial) or `answers: [{ id, selected }]` for a question. Ids come from `dsh_list_requests`, which marks what this endpoint parked with `answerable: true`. The GUI stays in the race — whoever decides first wins — and an unanswered request still fails closed at `requestAnswerTimeoutMs`. An internal DSH caller may only settle an **approval** while it already holds `danger-full-access`; questions are always answerable (see [DSH-local tools](#dsh-local-tools)). |
| `dsh_wait_session` | Block until the turn a session is already running ends, then return the assistant text it produced — for `wait: false` starts, GUI-driven sessions, or another caller's work. Never prompts, steers, or cancels: reaching `timeoutMs` returns `status: "timedOut"` with the turn still running, so call it again; `status: "idle"` returns immediately when nothing is running. |
| `dsh_list_requests` | The user decisions a session — or the newest visible sessions, running first — is waiting on: approval requests (`approval/asked` with no matching `approval/decided`, the one-shot permission decision behind a sandbox escalation) and unanswered `ask_user_question` calls, with tool, reason, call id and seq. These audit events are invisible to the model, so this is how a caller learns *why* a delegated turn stopped progressing. Reporting only: the decision is granted in the Harness GUI. |
| `dsh_search_sessions` | Find sessions by content server-side and get bounded snippets instead of transcripts: title/cwd/owner/id (`scope: "title"`) or the messages themselves (`"messages"`, `"both"` by default). Looks at the newest `scan` sessions the caller can see (default 20), reports `where`/`seq`/`snippet` per match, and then `dsh_read_session` reads just that session. |
| `dsh_whoami` | How this endpoint identifies the calling agent — `x-dsh-mcp-client` header, else `initialize` `clientInfo`, else `User-Agent` — plus the sessions that agent created. Attribution, not authentication: callers share the endpoint token. |
| `dsh_cancel_session` | Cancel the active turn of a session without dropping its pending inbox. |
| `dsh_archive_session` | Archive one session durably: hidden from every grouping surface, and it cannot run a model step until restored. A session with running work is refused unless `stopActivity: true` (which archives first, then stops that work). Archiving drops the pin. |
| `dsh_unarchive_session` | Drop a session from the archive set; it is listed again and returns to its recorded workspace position. |
| `dsh_list_permission_presets` | The deployment's permission presets (each bundles a sandbox mode with an approval policy) plus the default for new sessions, for the `permissionPreset` argument above. |
| `dsh_list_tools` | The tools DSH exposes to its own agents, for choosing what a delegated prompt can do; `query` narrows by name or description and `limit` caps the list. |
| `dsh_open_session` | Ask the running Web GUI to open one session and select it in the sidebar — for pointing the person at a session this endpoint started. Queued for the page that is open and consumed once; the session itself is untouched. |
| `dsh_status` | Endpoint, profile, version, session/live-agent counts, default model, active turns, the default permission preset, the delivery policy, and the local tool surface (`dshTools`). |

Archival needs the Host's `workspaceRegistry` service (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace`). Without it the
two archive tools report that the service is unavailable and listings simply omit the `archived`
field instead of guessing.

Permission presets need the Host's `permissionPresets` service
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-permission-presets`). `permissionPreset` is applied through that service's own
`set()` — the same write path as the GUI `/permission` command — once the session is live and before
its prompt is admitted, so the turn's own tool calls already see the chosen sandbox mode and approval
policy. The outcome echoes the applied preset; `dsh_read_session` folds the session's last durable
`permission/preset` event back into its payload, and `dsh_status` carries `defaultPermissionPreset`
plus the catalog. Without the service the permission fields are omitted and
`dsh_list_permission_presets` reports that the service is unavailable. A session created without a
`permissionPreset` keeps the deployment default, exactly as a GUI-created session does.

Commands need the Host's `commands` service and are addressed by **agent**, not by session: the
registry merges a global layer with the layers of the preset that agent is mounted under, so
`dsh_list_commands` must be asked per session

plugins.description: Local code memory for DeepSeek Harness: automatic source context, semantic search, and dependency graphs.
plugins.readme_text:
# Code Memory for DeepSeek Harness

**Give your coding agent the relevant source before its first step.** Code Memory (CM) is a local code index and context plugin for JavaScript and TypeScript projects. It combines symbol lookup, dependency graphs, and semantic search to reduce repeated source discovery.

**Unofficial community project.** Independently developed; not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

**English** · [Русский](README.ru.md) · [Download v0.9.1](https://github.com/kobubu/Rag-Coding/releases/tag/v0.9.1) · [Windows installation](docs/INSTALL-WINDOWS.md)

## What it does

- Supplies compact source context before the first model call in DeepSeek Harness.
- Looks up named files and symbols directly; uses local MiniLM embeddings and LanceDB when discovery is needed.
- Expands relevant dependencies using the TypeScript compiler's symbol and call graph.
- Checks source versions and avoids repeating unchanged whole files already supplied to Harness.
- Exposes an MCP server for Codex and Claude Code and an optional `UserPromptSubmit` hook for automatic context.
- Includes CM Atlas, a local map of modules, symbols, and their relationships.

The index, embeddings, and graph stay on your computer. Selected code is still sent to your model provider when you use a cloud model. CM does not include model credits or a model-provider subscription.

![CM Atlas displaying modules and structural relationships in this public repository](docs/assets/cm-atlas.png)

Actual CM Atlas screenshot of this repository's public `src` directory: 39 modules, 2,409 symbols, and 8,321 relationships. The current Atlas interface is in Russian; the installation guide below is in English.

## Measured results, with limits

The published Harness pilot used GPT-6 Luna on **six task types in one repository**, Geo Dash. Three evaluation series each ran 36 sessions: no CM, the earlier CM, and the newer CM, with two repeats per task and arm.

| Newer CM versus no CM | Published result |
|---|---:|
| Total model tokens | 45–66% fewer across the three series |
| Estimated model price | 30–47% lower |
| Total Harness session time | 18–37% lower |
| Independently checked solutions, pooled across series | 36/36 with newer CM; 35/36 without CM |

These are **small, single-project pilot results**, not guaranteed savings. The ranges are observed series results, not confidence intervals. Costs are estimates; session time does not include first-time installation or indexing. All attempts, including failures, are retained. Earlier approaches and native-client experiments have different outcomes; do not transfer these percentages to every client or workload.

[Method, raw results, and reproduction](docs/EFFICIENCY-AB.md) · [Codex and Claude Code experiments](docs/NATIVE-CLIENTS.md) · [What did not work](docs/HISTORY.md)

## Install into an existing Harness

Requires DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2** and Node.js 24 or 22.19+ within 22.x:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:kobubu/Rag-Coding#v0.9.1
```

The tag contains the compiled plugin, CLI entry points, and Atlas. CM needs no installation build or Vite/React runtime modules. Then [prepare the project index and local model](docs/DEEPSEEK-PLUGIN.md#github-installation). A ready release tarball is also available:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/kobubu/Rag-Coding/releases/download/v0.9.1/dsh-plugin-code-memory-0.9.1.tgz
```

Git tags before 0.9.1 require their release tarball or an explicit source build. The new runtime works with scripts disabled; native dependencies follow the host package manager's policy.

If CM was installed with the Windows bootstrap, update it using the new ZIP and the same `-InstallRoot`. Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 can prefer a CM copy beside its own installation over a profile-installed copy; adding another Git dependency to that older installation does not replace its launcher or embedded copy. The bootstrap creates a new release directory and switches managed project launchers.

## Install on Windows

Download **CM-0.9.1-Windows.zip** and **SHA256SUMS.txt** from the [v0.9.1 release](https://github.com/kobubu/Rag-Coding/releases/tag/v0.9.1), verify the checksum, and extract the ZIP. From the extracted folder, run:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install_cm.ps1 -ProjectRoot 'C:\path\to\your-project' -Clients harness
```

The installer uses a compatible Node.js or downloads a private runtime, installs CM and Harness **0.2.0-rc.2**, downloads the embedding model, and prepares your index. Administrator rights and a source checkout are not required. Internet access is required for the initial dependencies and model downloads. Open the generated `start-harness.ps1` path printed by setup, then configure your model provider in Harness.

Use `-SourceScope src` to index a subdirectory. Use `-Clients harness,codex,claude` to add project MCP connections for all three clients; Codex and Claude Code must be installed separately. Their automatic-context hook is currently a **separate manual setup**, not an installer default.

[Install, launch, verify, and remove](docs/INSTALL-WINDOWS.md) · [Native-client hook setup](docs/NATIVE-CLIENTS.md)

## Build from source

Use Node.js **24 LTS**, or Node.js **22.19.0+ within the 22.x line**.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/kobubu/Rag-Coding.git
cd Rag-Coding
npm ci
npm run verify
npm run cm:index
npm run cm:vectors
npm run cm:search -- --query "how are embeddings reused between snapshots"
npm run plugin:smoke
```

`plugin:smoke` dispatches tools through the real Harness runtime without a model call. In PowerShell, use `npm.cmd` for commands that forward flags. For restricted cloud builds, `ONNXRUNTIME_NODE_INSTALL=skip npm ci` skips the native runtime download; running local embeddings still requires a working ONNX runtime.

The Windows bootstrap is the packaged installation path. A macOS/Linux installer, automatic release updates, and a subscription service are not included.

For source changes, `npm run compile` rebuilds the runtime. Commit matching `dist/src/` and `dist/viewer/`; `npm run package:check` and CI reject missing/stale artifacts. The command is named `compile` because npm treats a script named `build` as a reason to rebuild Git dependencies.

## Documentation

The following engineering documents are currently in Russian; the README and Windows release guide are in English.

| Document | Contents |
|---|---|
| [How CM works](docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md) | Routing, graph expansion, context budgets, and source freshness |
| [Harness integration](docs/DEEPSEEK-PLUGIN.md) | Bundle installation, configuration, and tools |
| [MCP setup](docs/MCP-SETUP.md) | Shared local retrieval for coding clients |
| [CM Atlas](docs/LOCAL-ATLAS.md) | Local project visualization |
| [Release notes](docs/releases/v0.9.1.md) | What is included in the public package |
| [Release procedure](docs/RELEASING.md) | Rebuilding the installer and checking artifacts |

CM is written in TypeScript/Node.js. Project code is indexed without being executed. Supported inputs are JavaScript/TypeScript source files; current corpus limits are 500 files and 8 MiB of source. See [contribution rules](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Try it on another repository

[Show Your Plugins discussion](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/10196) · [Community catalog submission](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/7989)

Independent A/B results are welcome: use the same task, model, reasoning settings, checks, and starting commit with CM on and off. Include indexing/setup time separately, all failed attempts, total tokens, elapsed time, and whether the patch actually passes independent checks. Report regressions as well as wins in [Issues](https://github.com/kobubu/Rag-Coding/issues).

plugins.description: DSH plugin: enable/disable skills by group (skill toggles manager)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-toggles

DeepSeek Harness 技能开关插件：**黑名单语义 + 分组**——所有技能默认可用，只有被"启用中的分组"显式禁用的才被过滤（生效黑名单 = 启用分组黑名单的并集）。全新安装、状态文件缺失或损坏都等于"全部启用"，永不出现"装上即全消失"。

![技能面板](assets/screenshots/panel.png)

## 安装

- **插件市场**：在 dshmarket 中搜索 `dsh-skill-toggles`，一键安装；
- **npm**：
  ```
  dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-skill-toggles
  ```
- **本地源码**：
  ```
  dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:<本仓库绝对路径>
  ```

安装后重启 DSH（浏览器半重新加载页面即可）。卸载：`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-skill-toggles`（`postuninstall` 自动删除状态目录 `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-skill-toggles/`）。

## 使用

![分组管理](assets/screenshots/groups.png)

1. **打开面板**：聊天输入框工具条的「技能」按钮 → 左侧悬浮面板。
2. **分组**：内置默认分组（初始全开、可编辑、不可删除）；可新建/重命名/删除自定义分组，每组有自己的黑名单与启用开关——切换启用状态即整组生效/失效。
3. **技能列表**：每行开关作用于当前选中分组；支持搜索、按**来源分节**（插件包 / 用户 / 项目 / 自定义 / 其他，可折叠）与每节"全部禁用/全部启用"。技能被其它启用分组禁用时显示"被「××」禁用"徽标。
4. **Agent 工具**：`skill_toggles_list / disable / enable / enable_all / disable_all / source_set / group_create / group_delete / group_set_active`（均带可选 `group` 参数，缺省为默认分组）。
5. **改动生效时机**：

   | 路径 | 生效时机 |
   |---|---|
   | 输入框 `/` 技能菜单 | 下一次打开菜单（亚秒级） |
   | 模型 `<available_skills>` 目录 | 下一条消息（宿主"持久投影"机制，任何插件都如此） |
   | `skill` 工具 | 立即拒绝被禁用的技能 |

只管 skills，不做 MCP 开关。

## 已知限制

- Agent 未激活的冷会话由 preset 常驻 scope 供数，其 `/` 菜单可能仍显示已禁用技能，直到会话被激活（模型目录与 `skill` 工具不受影响）。
- 与旧插件 `dsh-skills-mcp-group-manager` **互斥**（两个影子 provider 叠加语义不可控），启动时检测到会打警告。
- 重装/升级**已安装** bundle 后，宿主半需要重启进程才换代码（Node 模块缓存）；浏览器半无此问题。

## 实现要点（维护者）

- 状态（v2）：`<DSH_HOME>/dsh-skill-toggles/state.json`，形如 `{ version:2, groups:[{id,name,disabled[]}], activeGroups[] }`；原子写；损坏回退为"全部启用"；v1 扁平文档加载时自动迁移进默认分组。
- 过滤机制：per-agent 影子 skill provider（`skill-toggles-filter`，注册在 agent 层）。`list()` 只发射"生效黑名单 ∧ 真实存在"的条目，invocation 改写为 `{modelInvocable:false, userInvocable:false}`，`rank:0` 在同层内直接胜出（文件系统根 rank 100..500）；启用的技能不重发，保留原 provider 的 `path` 预览与正文加载。
- 变更后 `control.invalidate()` 清空 skill registry 的 collect 缓存，再对每个活动会话 `emit('agent-preset/selected')` 使浏览器半目录缓存失效。
- 宿主半 `apply()` 保持同步（Cordis 对 prototype-bearing 函数的处理决定，异步 apply 会导致进程崩溃）。

## 开发

```
node test/state.test.mjs   # 纯逻辑 + 存储往返测试
```

```
dsh-skill-toggles/
├── lib/index.js        宿主半（影子 provider、RPC、9 个工具、事件广播）
├── lib/client.js       浏览器半（输入框按钮 + 分组管理悬浮面板）
├── lib/state.js        纯状态逻辑（分组黑名单语义 + v1 迁移，单测覆盖）
├── lib/store.js        原子写状态存储
├── scripts/cleanup.mjs postuninstall 清理
├── cordis.patch.yml    安装到 profile 的配置补丁片段
└── test/state.test.mjs
```

plugins.description: Deep-Sea Jellyfish theme for the Deepseek Harness Web UI: a bioluminescent abyss palette plus an illustration as the shell backdrop.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-jellyfish-theme

给 Deepseek Harness Web UI 用的**深海水母主题**插件：用一张水母插画作为整个界面的背景，并把配色改成生物荧光的深海色调（深海靛蓝底 + 青蓝强调色 + 藕紫辅助色）。浅色 / 深色两套调色板都做了适配。

> DSH bundle（`dsh.bundle.patch`）+ 动态客户端插件。主机侧只有一行空实现，全部效果在浏览器侧完成。

![主题插画](assets/backdrop.jpg)

## 它做了什么

1. **重配色**：通过客户端 `ctx.theme.overrideTokens('jellyfish', …)` 覆盖 40 多个 `--dsw-alias-*` 别名 token（背景、卡片、菜单、边框、文字、品牌色、气泡、代码块等），亮/暗两套值都给全，所以切换外观模式不会出现"半套配色"。
2. **铺插画**：注入样式表把插画作为 `html` 与 `body` 的固定背景（`cover`，纵向锚点在 32% 处，避免 `cover` 在宽窗口下裁到原图下方那条暗色桌面），并把宿主外框、对话面板的不透明底色让开，使画面能从侧栏与面板之间透出来。
3. **保可读**：在插画之上叠一层纵向渐变作为"可读性遮罩"（上下重、中间轻），中间阅读栏再叠一层高不透明度的霜层，卡片 / 菜单 / 弹层仍保持接近不透明——正文对比度按计算仍在 7:1 以上。

## 安装

### 方式 A：本地目录（推荐）

```bash
# profile 目录下
pnpm add link:/path/to/dsh-jellyfish-theme
```

然后在 profile 的 `package.json` 里把它加进 bundle 列表：

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "@local/jellyfish-theme"]
    }
  }
}
```

如果你用 DSH 的插件管理器，直接"从目录安装"指向本仓库目录即可（等价于上面的步骤）。

### 方式 B：git 依赖

```bash
pnpm add github:ailixiya24865-alt/dsh-jellyfish-theme
```

`client.js` 已经构建好并提交进仓库，因此不需要额外构建步骤。

### 安装 / 更新后必须做的一步 ⚠️

**改完代码或更新版本后，仅重新安装是不够的。** 如果 bundle 的选中状态没有变化，宿主会判定"无变化"（`changed:false`）而**不重新应用**，浏览器会继续运行旧的 `client.js`。必须让它真正重新应用：

1. 在插件页把本 bundle **关掉再打开**（或重启 Web 服务）；
2. 然后**硬刷新**页面（`Ctrl+Shift+R`）。

判断是否跑在新代码上：插件描述末尾带构建号，例如 `(v1.0.9)`。

## 重新构建

`client.js` 是由 `client.tpl.js` 生成的（把插画转成 base64 内联进 `background-image`）：

```bash
node tools/build-client.mjs
```

脚本会：把 `assets/backdrop.jpg` 内联进模板、写入构建号、把 `package.json` 版本号 +1、并把版本号同步进两个 locale 描述。**请编辑 `client.tpl.js`，不要直接改 `client.js`。**

## 目录结构

| 路径 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | bundle 清单：`dsh.bundle.patch`、`dsh.client`、导出与 `files` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 向 loader 插入 `jellyfish-theme` 插件行 |
| `index.js` | 主机侧实现（当前为空，效果全在客户端） |
| `client.tpl.js` | **可编辑的客户端源码**（token 表、样式表、`apply`） |
| `client.js` | 构建产物，客户端加载器实际执行的文件 |
| `tools/build-client.mjs` | 构建脚本 |
| `locale/{en,zh}.json` | 插件页显示的标题与描述 |
| `assets/backdrop.jpg` | 背景插画（1680×885） |
| `icon.jpg` | 插件图标（由插画裁切） |
| `icon.svg` | 图标设计草稿（未在 `exports`/`files` 中，仅作素材保留） |

## 调参

想把画面调得更明显或更含蓄，改 `client.tpl.js` 里这几个变量（浅色与深色各一组），然后重新构建 + 重新应用：

| 变量 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `--jellyfish-veil` / `-soft` / `-strong` | 遮罩在画面中部 / 上方 42% / 顶部与底部的压暗强度 |
| `--jellyfish-surface-strong` / `-soft` | 中间阅读栏霜层在上下端 / 中段的浓度，越小插画越清晰、文字对比度越低 |
| `--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill` | 侧栏底色透明度（token 表里） |
| `--dsw-alias-bg-base` | 全局底色的透明度（token 表里） |

## 实现要点（改代码前值得读）

选择器不依赖 CSS Module 的哈希类名，而是锚在插槽属性上。运行时的真实结构是：

```
#root > div[data-slot="root"]            ← 插槽包装层，display: contents
  └ div.<frame>                          ← 外框（不是 #root 的第一个子元素！）
      ├ div.<sidebarCol>   > div[data-slot="sidebar"]
      ├ div.<centerCol>    > div[data-slot="main"]
      │                      > div[data-slot="main.conversation"] > div.<conversationRoot>
      ├ div.<rightbarCol>
      ├ div[data-shell-bottom]
      └ div[data-shell-overlay]
```

三条关键规则：

- 外框默认会以 `--dsw-alias-bg-base` 铺满整个窗口（Windows 下还有更高优先级的 `[data-windows-titlebar] .frame`），必须显式清掉它的底色，插画才可能透出来；
- 中间列的霜层用 `div:where(:nth-child(2), :has(> [data-slot="main"]))` 双路匹配：`:where()` 是宽容语法，即使 `:has()` 不可用，位置分支仍然命中；
- 插画同时挂在 `html` 与 `body` 上：根元素的背景画在整个文档的画布层，任何后代都盖不住它；`body` 那份是防止某些样式表把根元素背景覆盖掉。

## 许可

- **代码**（`*.js`、`*.mjs`、`*.json`、`*.yml`、`*.md`）：MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。
- **插画**（`assets/backdrop.jpg`、`icon.jpg`，以及内联进 `client.js` 的那份 base64）：**不在 MIT 许可范围内**。它是本仓库作者提供的素材，仅随本插件一起分发；如果你不是权利人，请不要再次分发。想以纯代码方式使用本插件，可删除插画并把 `client.tpl.js` 中的背景层换成自己的素材。

---

## English summary

A Deep-Sea Jellyfish theme for the Deepseek Harness Web UI: bioluminescent abyss
palette (light and dark) plus an illustration as the shell backdrop, with a
gradient readability veil and a frosted reading column.

- Host half is empty; everything happens in `client.js` (client plugin).
- Edit `client.tpl.js`, then run `node tools/build-client.mjs`.
- **After installing or rebuilding, the bundle must be re-applied** (toggle it off
  and on in the plugin list, or restart the web service) and the page
  hard-refreshed; otherwise the browser keeps running the previous `client.js`.
- Code is MIT. The bundled illustration is **not** covered by the MIT license.

plugins.description: DSH 插件界面增强：卡片显示子项状态，设置页显示提供者包名，方便 AI 定位插件并节省 token。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-subitem-status

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的**插件页**（侧栏「插件」，不是设置页）加上子项状态显示：
每张插件卡片上直接标出这个包里有哪些组件没启用、哪些异常，**不用点进详情页才发现**。

## 解决什么问题

插件页的卡片只反映 **bundle 级**的开关。包开着，但里面某个组件其实没跑起来——
卡片上完全看不出来，必须点进详情页看「包含的组件」那一行才发现。

这个插件把那行状态（`● 运行中` / `● 已关闭` / `● 未运行` / `● 异常`）**原样搬到卡片上**：

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  ▣  some-plugin-kit                          │
│     一组示例插件                              │
│     主组件   ● 运行中   附属组件  ● 已关闭     │  ← 新增
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- 文案与状态点**直接取自官方字典命名空间**，与详情页一字不差；官方改措辞这里跟着变。
- 一个包里**多个组件就逐条列出**，不会只显示第一个。
- 每个组件显示一条状态（包括正常运行），没有组件时不占位。

## 设置页包名提示

设置中的配置页面导航及「插件」内部选项卡，标题下方显示淡色的提供者 npm 包名。
长包名省略显示，鼠标悬停可查看完整名字。

- 从 Slot 注册来源和实际加载的模块清单核对包名，不用中文标题推测。
- 6.0.1 中大量来源被压缩为 `mf`；对此使用已逐条核对注册源码的 ID→包名兜底表，
  且仍要求包名出现在当前模块清单中。表内覆盖 21 个设置页面、5 个内部选项卡。
  未收录的新页面显示「包名未声明」；其他插件覆盖同一 ID 时，此兜底信息可能不再准确。
- 来源未声明或无法确定时，显示「包名未声明」，不输出本机路径。
- 这是排障用的诊断信息，不是提供者身份的安全认证。
- 不读取配置值、聊天记录、账户凭据，不向外部服务发送数据。

### 把准确包名告诉 AI，减少 token 消耗

用途不只是方便查看：让 AI 修改或排查插件时，可以直接告诉它 **npm 包名**，
避免 AI 从中文显示名称开始逐个搜索、读源码猜来源，减少定位过程中的 token 消耗。

1. 打开设置，找到需要修改的插件配置选项卡，查看标题下面的包名小字。
2. 需要复制完整名称时，在浏览器中右键小字选择 **「检查」**，或按 **F12** 打开开发者工具，
   用元素选择器选中这行小字。在 Elements（元素）面板读取或复制该元素的文本；
   `title` 属性也包含完整包名，长名称不会因为界面省略显示而丢失。
3. 把完整包名与具体需求一起告诉 AI，例如：

   > 请检查 `dsh-feature-toggles`，设置里「余额」页面显示异常。先定位这个包，再排查问题。

不需要调试工具时，也可以直接看小字或悬停查看完整名称。若显示「包名未声明」，
不要把它当作真实包名提供给 AI；应进一步核实来源。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin add github:lingmingxi/dsh-plugin-subitem-status --profile <你的 profile>
```

或用 tarball / 本地路径：

```bash
npm pack
dsh plugin add ./dsh-plugin-subitem-status-1.1.0.tgz --profile <你的 profile>
```

装完**重启 DSH**（客户端插件生效需要重启，除非 profile 启用了 client-hmr）。

## 设计要点

**纯客户端 DOM 增强，不覆盖 DSH 内核。**

插件页的卡片是内核 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-plugin-manager` 里硬编码的 `PackageCard`，
**没有任何卡片级 slot 可用**（可用的只有 `plugins.item` 新增卡片、以及详情页的
`plugins.detail.badge/.actions/.section`）。所以「在父级卡片上显示子项状态」只能走
DOM 增强：观察已渲染的卡片，往里补一行。

- 数据源与官方插件页**同源**：`remote.pluginManager.listBundles()` + `listPlugins()`。
- 卡片定位只用稳定属性 `[data-plugin-package]` / `[data-plugin-panel]`；
  **类名是 CSS-module 哈希，绝不硬编码**。
- 被 React 重渲染抹掉时，由 `MutationObserver` 自动重放（自身写入的回调会跳过，避免死循环）。
- 卸载时清干净：样式、承载行、observer、订阅、定时器。

### 关于 `inject: []`（重要）

本插件的客户端 factory 声明 `inject: []`，所有服务一律用 `ctx.get()` 惰性读取。

这不是偷懒，是**必须的**。cordis 的 `ctx` 是注入代理：读一个没写进 `inject` 的属性会直接抛
`cannot get property "..." without inject`。而 DSH Web 的启动门禁要求**每个 entry 的 fiber 都 active**，
任何一个不合格就整页打不开（`web boot: N entry did not activate`）。

两种写法的实测结果：

| inject 声明 | 服务齐全 | 命名空间缺失 | remote 缺失 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `['remote','locale']` 且直接读 `ctx.remote.pluginManager` | **failed** | failed | failed |
| `['remote','locale','remote.pluginManager']` | active | **pending（照样卡死）** | pending |
| **`[]` + 全部走 `ctx.get()`** | **active** | **active** | **active** |

把命名空间写进 `inject` 看似正确，但该服务尚未挂载时 fiber 会变 `pending`，**同样卡死启动**。
只有 `ctx.get()` 在所有环境下都安全（官方插件页自己也用 `this.ctx.get("productAnalytics")?.`）。

## 测试

```bash
npm test
```

五个套件：

| 文件 | 覆盖内容 |
|---|---|
| `tests/smoke.mjs` | 纯逻辑：状态合成 vs 官方映射、多组件、文案兜底、注册形态 |
| `tests/dom.mjs` | DOM 粘合：单/多组件渲染、挂载位置、重渲染重放、实时更新、卸载清理 |
| `tests/boot-gate.mjs` | **启动门禁**：用真实 cordis 在 5 种服务组合下断言 fiber 必须 active |
| `tests/lifecycle.mjs` | 同步异常、迟到响应、卸载后的回调隔离 |
| `tests/settings.mjs` | 包名来源、未知/路径过滤、设置导航与内部 tab 对齐、重放与清理 |

`boot-gate.mjs` 需要 `@deepseek-ai/cordis`。可用 `DSH_CORDIS_PATH` 指向你自己的
`cordis/lib/index.js`（支持绝对路径和 `file:` URL）；找不到或加载失败则测试失败，避免假绿灯。
`tests/lifecycle.mjs` 另外验证同步异常及卸载后迟到响应不会继续运行。

> 为什么需要 boot-gate：这类 bug 用**普通对象桩测不出来**——桩里的 `ctx.remote` 是普通对象，
> 读 `.pluginManager` 不会报错，而真实 ctx 是注入代理。本插件第一版就是这么炸的，
> 所以补了这个用真实 cordis 的回归测试。

## 兼容性

- 平台：Web（`dsh.client.platform: "web"`）
- 无第三方运行时依赖，不 `require` 任何 Harness Client 包
- 只使用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token，跟随明暗主题

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: Raises a Windows desktop notification card when DSH asks you a question, and returns to the asking Session when the card is clicked.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-message-reminder

A plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness). When DSH asks you a question with `ask_user_question` while you are looking at something else, it raises a real acrylic notification card in the bottom-right corner of your Windows desktop. Clicking the card restores and raises the DSH window and navigates back to the Session that asked.

- Draws a borderless, always-on-top **acrylic** window (`SetWindowCompositionAttribute` + `DWMWA_WINDOW_CORNER_PREFERENCE`, painted with `TextRenderer.DrawText`), because the renderer `Notification` API, `NotifyIcon` balloons and WinRT toasts all failed to show a banner in this Electron shell.
- **Never steals focus**, and the Session itself is untouched: the plugin only observes the `user-questions/request` waterfall (`{ prepend: true }`) and passes the answer back to the original listener.
- Stays quiet while the question card is already in front of you — the page reports "which Session is in the main view, is it visible, does it have focus" to the host.
- Host half uses Node built-ins only (`node:child_process`, `node:fs`, `node:path`) and registers a `webServer` route, so there are no runtime npm dependencies.
- Diagnostics: `GET /message-reminder/status`.

## Screenshot

![Notification card raised in the bottom-right corner of the Windows desktop](assets/screenshot-card.png)

A real card raised by `ask_user_question` while you are looking at something else: the title comes from the plugin config, the body is the question summary, and clicking anywhere on the card restores the DSH window and returns to the asking Session.

## Requirements

- DSH (DeepSeek Harness) with the Web client.
- Node.js >= 22.
- Windows 10 1803+ for the acrylic card. On macOS/Linux, or when PowerShell is unavailable, the host falls back to an in-page `Notification`.

## Install

Install it from the DSH plugin market (`dshmarket`) once the plugin is listed there, or add it to a profile by hand. Installing from a local checkout is the path that always works:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add link:/path/to/dsh-message-reminder
```

Once the package is published to npm, the registry form works too:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-message-reminder
```

The package declares its own bundle patch (`dsh.bundle.patch`), so it inserts its row into the profile when the profile loads. `dsh plugin add` is a `pnpm add` inside the profile, so make sure the package name also appears in that profile's bundle list:

```jsonc
// $DSH_HOME/profiles/<your-profile>/package.json
{
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["...", "dsh-message-reminder"] } }
}
```

## Configuration

Override by row id in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (a `config` block replaces the whole default block, so repeat every field you want to keep):

```yaml
- id: message-reminder
  config:
    title: DSH 消息提醒                    # card title
    skipWhenViewingSession: true           # no card while the asking Session is on screen (default)
    skipWhenFocused: false                 # also skip the renderer notification while the page is focused
    windowProcessName: DeepSeek Harness    # process whose window is raised when the card is clicked
    sound: true                            # true | false | asterisk / exclamation / question / hand / beep
    notifyMode: auto                       # auto | balloon | renderer
```

`notifyMode: balloon` is the historical name of the helper-process card channel; `renderer` forces the page's own notification and is the easiest way to test without spawning a child process. The sound plays when the card is actually shown, so it never "beeps without a card".

## Files

```
index.js               host half: watches questions, spawns the card, serves the SSE channel
client.js              browser half: subscribes to the channel, navigates on click
notify.ps1             the card helper script (one short-lived process per question, ASCII-only)
cordis.patch.yml       inserts the host row into the current profile
locale/{zh,en}.json    the name and description shown for the plugin
icon.svg
```

## Known limitations

- The card only exists on Windows; every other platform uses the renderer notification.
- The blur needs `SetWindowCompositionAttribute` acrylic (Windows 10 1803+). If the system rejects the call the card degrades to a solid background and everything else still works.
- Some AMSI providers occasionally crash while PowerShell compiles the script; the host retries immediately (up to 5 times, ~0.1 s per failure) before falling back to the renderer notification.
- The card body is truncated at 160 characters; an over-long title is ellipsized.
- The first card is slightly slower than the rest (~1 s) because the helper compiles a small Win32 helper at startup.

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE)

---

## 消息提醒 (Message Reminder)

DSH 调用 `ask_user_question` 询问用户时，在屏幕右下角弹出一张通知卡片；点击卡片会把 DSH 窗口恢复并置顶，同时自动回到发起询问的那个会话。

### 效果

![Windows 桌面右下角弹出的通知卡片](assets/screenshot-card.png)

标题取自插件配置（默认「DSH 消息提醒」），正文是问题摘要（超过 160 字符截断）；点击卡片任意位置即可回到发起询问的会话，点右上角 ✕ 只关掉卡片。

### 行为

| 时机 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH 调用 `ask_user_question`，且页面**不在**该会话（或窗口已最小化） | 在工作区右下角（内缩 18px）弹出毛玻璃卡片并播放提示音，标题默认 `DSH 消息提醒`，正文为问题摘要（多个问题时附带「共 N 个问题」），底部提示「点击卡片返回对话」 |
| DSH 调用 `ask_user_question`，但页面正显示该会话**且窗口是当前活动窗口** | **不弹卡片、不响**：问题卡片已经在用户眼前的输入区里 |
| 点击卡片 | 把窗口恢复并置顶，然后把页面导航回发起询问的会话并展开待回答的问题卡片 |
| 点击右上角 ✕ | 忽略这条通知：卡片关闭，不置顶、不跳转；询问仍在原地等待回答 |
| 弹出 / 关闭 | 从屏幕右边缘**滑入**（约 260ms，ease-out-back，过冲约 20px 后回弹到位）；点击或 ✕ 后向左滑出关闭（约 150ms） |
| 问题被回答 / 被取消 | 卡片随辅助进程一起消失 |

会话本身与询问流程完全不受影响：插件只是观察 `user-questions/request`，并把决定继续交给原来的应答者。卡片不会抢焦点，鼠标悬停时描边变亮、✕ 出现底衬。

滑动只改窗口位置（15ms 一帧的 `Timer` 插值），**刻意不用透明度淡入**：淡入需要分层窗口，会和 DWM 合成的 acrylic 毛玻璃打架。实测轨迹（1920 屏幕）：

```
380ms left=1920  完全在屏幕右边缘外
400ms left=1822  滑入
480ms left=1459  过冲峰值（静止位 1482）
540ms left=1482  精确停在静止位并保持
```

「忽略」只是让辅助进程以退出码 `0` 结束（点击是 `42`），Host 会把这次结束归类为「已被忽略的气泡」，因此既不重试也不回退到渲染进程通知；下一次询问照常弹出。

#### 置顶是阶梯式的

Windows 的前台锁会让 `SetForegroundWindow` 无声失败，所以点击后按顺序尝试并**每步回验** `GetForegroundWindow`：

1. 若最小化则 `ShowWindow(SW_RESTORE)`，若被隐藏则 `SW_SHOW`，再 `BringWindowToTop`；
2. `AttachThreadInput` 挂到当前前台线程后 `SetForegroundWindow`（前台锁只会让给拥有前台窗口的线程），完成后解除挂接；
3. 仍被拒绝则轻敲一次 Alt 再试，然后换用 shell 自己的 `SwitchToThisWindow`；
4. 仍被拒绝且窗口本来不是置顶时，用一次「短暂 `HWND_TOPMOST` → `HWND_NOTOPMOST`」把 z 序顶上来（不会把用户从未固定的窗口留在置顶状态）；
5. 全都失败时 `FlashWindowEx` 闪任务栏按钮，至少让用户注意到。

实测三种情形都能把窗口带到最前：最小化、被另一个已聚焦窗口盖住、正常后台。

「是否已经在看这个会话」只有页面自己知道，所以 `client.js` 会把「当前 mainView 的会话 + 页面是否可见 + 页面是否聚焦」上报给 Host（`retainedBy.mainView`），Host 在询问到来时据此决定是否弹卡片。

判定「用户看不到」用的是两个信号的**与**：`visibilityState === 'visible'`（没被最小化/切到别的标签）**且** `document.hasFocus()`（是当前活动窗口）。Chromium 不提供遮挡信号——被别的程序完全盖住的窗口 `visibilityState` 仍然是 `visible`——所以聚焦状态是把「就在用户眼前」和「压在别的程序后面」区分开的那个信号。于是这几种情况都会提醒：

- 窗口被最小化；
- 窗口被其他程序盖住 / 用户切到别的程序；
- 窗口在另一个虚拟桌面；
- 看的是别的会话。

只有「窗口在前台、且正显示发起询问的会话」才不打扰。整条规则在 `isViewingAsk()` 里，配置项是 `skipWhenViewingSession`（设 `false` 则完全不抑制）。

### 结构

```
dsh-message-reminder/
├── index.js          Host 半边：监听询问、拉起卡片进程、提供 SSE 通道
├── client.js         浏览器半边：订阅通道、点击后导航
├── notify.ps1        卡片辅助脚本（每次询问一个短命进程，ASCII-only，每次按需读取）
├── cordis.patch.yml  把 Host 行插入当前 profile
├── locale/{zh,en}.json  插件卡片上显示的名称与说明
└── icon.svg
```

#### 为什么这样分工

- **Host 负责探测询问。** `user-questions/request` 是一条 waterfall；插件行在所有 bundle 行之后加载，若不声明 `prepend: true`，浏览器里回答问题的那个监听者会先返回结果，插件就永远看不到这次询问。因此 Host 以 `{ prepend: true }` 注册为最外层监听者，记录询问后用 `next()` 把回答权交回去。
- **Host 负责弹窗。** 渲染进程的 `Notification` API 需要与 AUMID 绑定的开始菜单快捷方式，这个 Electron 外壳没有。实测三种系统通知机制（渲染进程 `Notification`、`NotifyIcon` 气泡、WinRT toast）都被 Windows 送达通知中心却**从不显示横幅**，因此改为绘制一个置顶窗口：窗口不受该限制。卡片本身是**真毛玻璃**——`SetWindowCompositionAttribute(ACCENT_ENABLE_ACRYLICBLURBEHIND)` 提供真实的背景模糊（须先设置 `DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE` 才会得到深色色调），`DWMWA_WINDOW_CORNER_PREFERENCE` 负责圆角；文字用 `TextRenderer.DrawText` 直接画在窗口自己的 Paint 里，因为任何子控件都会用自己的背景盖掉模糊。
- **Client 负责导航。** Host 通过 `/message-reminder/events`（SSE，沿用 `dsh-client-hmr` 的通道写法）把 `ask` / `click` / `resolved` 推给页面，页面用 `ctx.uiWorkspace.openSession(sessionId)` 回到会话。渲染进程无法自行恢复/置顶窗口，这一步由辅助脚本完成。

点击上报有两条独立通道：辅助脚本退出码 `42` 是 Host 信任的结论，stdout 的 `click` 只是抢先通知。找不到可用 PowerShell、或卡片连续 5 次没能启动时，Host 会改用 `channel: 'client'` 让页面自己发 `

plugins.description: Marathon-inspired Acid Rain theme and native startup animation for DeepSeek Harness TUI
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tui-marathon

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A Marathon-inspired appearance plugin for DeepSeek Harness TUI. Version 0.4.3 provides an Acid Rain theme and a responsive full-screen opening through the stock TUI's public interfaces. Conversations, models, tools and storage remain with Harness / dsh-TUI.

**Inspired by the repo [ALPDM00/dsh-theme-mls-desktop](https://github.com/ALPDM00/dsh-theme-mls-desktop)**

![Startup animation captured from the installed dsh-tui](evidence/startup.gif)

Version 0.4.3: actual 120×36 terminal output, replayed as a 24 fps GIF (about 10.3 seconds). The logo stays visible through the blue hold and maze transition until the red sweep covers it. The native interface returns after the opening.

The repository is named `dsh-tui-marathon`; the installable Cordis package is `dsh-theme-mls-tui`.

## Install, then run dsh-tui

This assumes `dsh`, `dsh-tui` and pnpm are already installed and your existing `dsh-tui` starts successfully. Supported host: dsh-TUI 0.14.x; verified version: 0.14.0.

Install the theme once:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add https://github.com/Huangmr0719/dsh-tui-marathon/releases/download/v0.4.3/dsh-theme-mls-tui-0.4.3.tgz
```

Keep using your usual command afterward:

```sh
dsh-tui
```

The plugin joins the launcher's default `dsh-tui` profile, selects Acid Rain and plays the opening automatically. No source checkout, host build or project-directory launch is needed. If you set `DSH_HOME`, use the same value during installation and startup. Restart `dsh-tui` after configuration changes or updates.

First-time host users can complete its normal credential setup after the opening. The theme does not change model, credential or session configuration.

Alternatively, download [the v0.4.3 archive](https://github.com/Huangmr0719/dsh-tui-marathon/releases/download/v0.4.3/dsh-theme-mls-tui-0.4.3.tgz) and replace the URL above with its local file path.

To remove the theme and keep using `dsh-tui`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui remove dsh-theme-mls-tui
```

## Appearance and compatibility

- Automatic animation runs only at startup. Successful turns, cancellations and history replay never open an animation.
- Acid Rain yellow `#D7FF00`, dark surfaces and neutral body text. The opening retains electric blue, maze graphics and the red panel exit.
- Actual terminal text, block glyphs, borders and solid color cells replace the old full-frame sampled renderer.
- Six green scan frames use heavy box-drawing strokes and closer spacing; the scan stage lasts 0.8 seconds longer than 0.4.2.
- Both whale axes share one physical scale. Borders, maze and panels fill the viewport independently, including host page margins.
- The host frame clock drives motion without the former 50ms quantization. Measured moving-frame output is approximately 58 fps; terminal and machine load affect results.
- Resizing works during playback and pause. Validation covers 48–180 columns, 20–54 rows and several physical cell proportions.

The stock pixel whale has hardcoded blue pixels. The plugin hides it through public `setWhale(false)`, keeps the themed native title and restores the previous preference on unload. Set `nativeWhale: true` to retain that sprite.

Stock `tuiScenes` replaces the conversation. Panel masks animate within the plugin scene; the original conversation returns on close. Progressive reveal of native content needs an additional host interface. See [COMPATIBILITY.md](COMPATIBILITY.md).

## Controls and configuration

`Alt+M` replays the opening. During animation, `Esc`, `Enter`, `q` or click exits; space pauses/resumes. Configure Option as Alt/Meta on macOS when needed.

| Cordis option | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `autoTheme` | `true` | Select and save MLS once on activation |
| `autoBoot` | `true` | Play the startup opening |
| `motion` | `full` | `reduced`: brief static display; `off`: theme only |
| `graphics` | `cells` | `auto`: use a supported host image only for the central logo; outer geometry stays native |
| `cellAspect` | `0` | Read host cell measurements; fall back to height / width = 2 |
| `nativeWhale` | `false` | Keep the unthemeable stock blue whale |

No terminal brand is required. If the host supplies no pixel metrics, arbitrary font proportions cannot be inferred exactly. Optional `cellAspect` calibration uses cell height / width, such as `1.8` or `2.2`. Native cell rendering needs no image protocol.

## Development

These steps are for source changes; theme installation does not require them. Source development uses Node `^22.19 || >=24` and pnpm `11.21.0`. Keep a stock `dsh-TUI/` checkout next to this repository for dev links and integration tests. The revision below is the verified host baseline:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI.git
git -C dsh-TUI checkout 1d832df3f97e828b1aaea8376657d6b6ecf30b86
pnpm --dir dsh-TUI install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm --dir dsh-TUI build
git clone https://github.com/Huangmr0719/dsh-tui-marathon.git
cd dsh-tui-marathon
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
npm run build
npm test
npm run verify
```

For interactive development, `npm run setup:local` installs the official Harness CLI into ignored `.runtime/`; then run `npm start`. That launcher uses isolated development configuration and sessions. Normal use follows the `dsh-tui` workflow above. Configure API credentials through your shell environment as required by Harness. Do not commit credentials or sessions. Model-free tests need no API key.

Environment variables for the development launcher:

```sh
MLS_GRAPHICS=auto npm start
MLS_CELL_ASPECT=2.2 npm start
MLS_NATIVE_WHALE=1 npm start
MLS_MOTION=reduced npm start
npm start -- --inline
```

Optional development commands:

```sh
npm run measure:motion
npm run pack:local
```

MIT licensed; retain artwork attribution. See [QUALITY.md](QUALITY.md) for validation and [THIRD_PARTY.md](THIRD_PARTY.md) for asset provenance and regeneration.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Vedar (vedarai.ru) Kamchatka travel MCP server. 堪察加旅游 MCP 服务器，一条命令接入 dsh
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vedar — Vedar (Kamchatka travel) MCP server for DeepSeek Harness

[中文](README.zh.md)

**Vedar** (vedarai.ru, Russian name Ведар) is the travel platform of the Kamchatka peninsula, Russia. Its public MCP server gives AI agents live tours and availability from local operators, the safety status of places and routes (volcanoes, earthquakes, weather warnings), weather, stays, gear rental, transfers and trip plans. No auth, rate-limited by IP.

This plugin does one thing: it registers one instance of the official bridge `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` in your DeepSeek Harness profile, pointed at `https://vedarai.ru/api/mcp`. After install the model calls the tools as `mcp__vedar__<tool>`.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:tourhabk-ui/dsh-vedar
```

`dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm, so pnpm must be on PATH (`npm i -g pnpm`); without it the command stops with "pnpm was not found".

Restart `dsh web`. The tools appear before the first turn.

No plugin? Put the same row into `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` (identical to `cordis.patch.yml` in this repository):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mcp-vedar
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: vedar
        transport: streamable-http
        url: https://vedarai.ru/api/mcp
```

Or add it by URL in a settings panel (`dsh-mcp-center`, `dsh-mcp-panel`, `dsh-mcp-connector`): type Streamable HTTP, URL `https://vedarai.ru/api/mcp`, auth none.

## Tools (20)

Read: `get_tours`, `get_tour_details`, `get_tour_availability`, `get_place_info`, `get_volcano_status`, `safety_status`, `get_guardian_context`, `get_weather`, `search_accommodations`, `search_gear`, `search_transfers`, `make_trip_plan`, `edit_trip_plan`, `get_request_status`, `search`, `fetch`.

Write, four requests confirmed by a human, no online payment: `create_lead`, `create_booking_request`, `create_stay_request`, `request_charter`.

Platform data is in Russian; tool arguments work best in Russian or English. Emergency number in Kamchatka: 112.

## Status

DeepSeek Harness is in developer preview and config fields may change. The row in this plugin follows the README of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 0.2.0-rc.2 (checked 2026-10-13). Verified end to end on 2026-10-14 with dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 and pnpm 10.28.0 (headless profile, GitHub Actions runner): the plugin installed with the command above, and DeepSeek answered a Chinese question about brown bears in August by calling 17 Vedar tools, all completed.
