plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-memory-lite

给 DSH 的**本地优先跨会话记忆**：每轮自动沉淀，空闲时自动整理，需要时按需注入。

数据全部存在**本地 SQLite 文件**里 —— 不联网、不上传、不依赖任何外部记忆服务。

---

## 它解决什么

DSH 的会话本身是有记忆边界的：换一个会话、或者一次压缩（compact）之后，
之前聊过的结论就找不回来了。你得反复重新交代"我们用两层架构""那个坑别再踩"。

这个插件在后台做三件事：

| 层 | 做什么 | 什么时候 | 成本 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **日志层** | 每轮结束把对话原样追加到本地 | 自动，每轮 | **零模型调用** |
| **长期条目层** | 把日志里的结论蒸馏成"记忆条目" | **你点「立即整理」时**（也可开启空闲自动） | 每次一次模型调用 |
| **注入层** | 把你这句话相关的记忆作为**独立消息**追加到对话尾部 | 自动，每轮 | 零成本 |

**日志层永远不进提示词** —— 只有蒸馏后的条目才会被注入。
否则上下文预算和前缀缓存都会被日志淹没。

**日志层存的不是"逐字原样"**：落盘前会剔掉宿主注入的系统样板（`<system-reminder>` 里的
用户全局 `AGENTS.md` 等），也会去掉与前文重复的部分（实测 10 轮对话曾因此写出 804 KB，
相邻两条有 6/9 对是"后一条完整包含前一条"）。没有内容的轮次干脆不记。

---

## 安装

命令行：

```
dsh plugin --profile <你的profile名> add github:eighteentang/dsh-plugin-memory-lite#v1.3.0
```

或者**在界面里装**（不用命令行）：侧边栏 **「插件」→「添加插件」**，把地址贴进去。
那个输入框接受包名、**Git 地址**、压缩包、本地绝对路径四类写法：

| 贴什么 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `https://github.com/eighteentang/dsh-plugin-memory-lite#v1.3.0` | ✅ 装指定版本（**推荐**） |
| `https://github.com/eighteentang/dsh-plugin-memory-lite` | ✅ 跟随主分支 |
| `github:eighteentang/dsh-plugin-memory-lite#v1.3.0` | ✅ 同上两种写法都行 |

> ⚠ **别贴 Releases 页的地址。** `…/releases/tag/v1.3.0` 会被**直接拒绝**
> （提示 `a URL must point at a git repository or a tarball`）—— 它只认**仓库根地址**
> 或压缩包链接；版本要写成 `#v1.3.0` 拼在根地址后面。同理 `…/tree/main` 这类网页地址也不行。
>
> 这几条不是猜的：宿主侧的解析函数 `parseInstallSpec` 曾被抽出来逐例跑过
> （那是开发者本机的诊断脚本，**不随仓库发布** —— 见下方「关于本仓库不含开发工具」）。

装完后**重启客户端**，设置页会出现 **「记忆控制」**。

> **`#v1.3.0` 是版本钉子** —— 钉住版本避免"装到一半上游改了"。
> 去掉 `#…` 就是跟随主分支（自动拿到新改动，也自动拿到新 bug）。
> 全部版本见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)；升级就是**先卸载再装新版**
> （DSH 的插件目前不支持自动更新）。

> 开发期用 `link:` 装（`link:D:/path/to/memory-lite`）也是支持的，
> 但**必须保留 `peerDependencies`**，否则插件的包解析会失败。

---

## 怎么用

### 平时不用管

- 每轮对话结束，它自动把这一轮记下来（不花模型额度）
- 每句用户消息到达时，它按关键词找相关记忆，注入到对话尾部
- **整理成条目默认要你手动点**（避免"没打招呼就花额度"）。
  想让它自己长出来，把 `autoDistill` 设成 `true` —— 那样空闲 30 分钟后会自动整理
  （每天最多 4 次，见下面配置）。

### 想手动做点什么

设置页 →「记忆控制」分成上下两块：

- **上面两个文本框：人设设定 / 工作规范与行为准则**
  **想写什么就写什么 —— 没有任何格式要求**（不用标题、不用 markdown）。
  两块内容存在插件自己的两个文件里：

  ```
  $DSH_HOME/memory-lite/persona/persona.md   ← 人设设定
  $DSH_HOME/memory-lite/persona/rules.md     ← 工作规范与行为准则
  ```

  它们被注入成 **system prompt 的一段**（位置紧跟框架自己的人设段）—— 所以是
  **每一轮都生效**，不像记忆库那样靠召回（规范类的东西"这轮没命中"就等于静默失效）。
  保存后下一轮立刻生效，不用重启；写前自动备份到同目录的 `backup/`。
  > 代价：它们**随插件走** —— 插件停用/卸载，人设与准则就不生效了。
- **下面是长期记忆列表**：搜索、按状态筛选、改状态（在用 / 已完成 / 已停用）、点「立即整理」。
  列表是**一行一条、行行等高**（`层级 · 项目 · 标题 · 敏感 · 用过N次 · 状态`），
  **不展示正文** —— 标题/项目太长会省略号截断，**鼠标悬停看全文**。
  「用过几次」显示成 `3×`（悬停会说明"被自动注入过 3 次"，`–` 表示还没用过）。

**想手动记一条记忆**：直接在对话里说（`memory_note`），比在界面上敲更快、还能带上上下文。

- **对 DSH 说**（这些是模型可见的工具）：
  - 「记住：这个项目用两层记忆架构」→ `memory_note`
  - 「搜一下我之前说过关于注入的东西」→ `memory_search`
  - 「把那条标记成已完成」→ `memory_update`
  - 「忘了那条吧」→ `memory_forget`（**删除需要你点头**，走审批）

### 用户级记忆（跨工作区）

有些事跟**哪个项目**无关：你是谁、做什么工作、说什么语言、跨项目的工作约定。
这类东西写进某个工作区，就只有那个项目能召回 —— 所以要显式写进**用户级库**：

```
$DSH_HOME/memory-lite/global/memory.db   ← 用户级（跨工作区）
<工作区>/.dsh-memory/memory.db           ← 该工作区自己的（默认）
```

- **怎么写**：对话里说「**记住（跨工作区）：我在深圳，做产品运营**」→ 我用 `memory_note` 带
  `scope="user"` 写进用户级库。**默认是当前工作区**，我不会靠 `project` 字段猜。
- **怎么起作用**：每轮召回时「当前工作区 + 用户级」一起搜、合并排序，
  同分时工作区优先；同一条记忆只出现一次（按内容判重，不是按 id）。
- **不会拖累提示词**：合并后仍受 `injectMaxItems` 那一个名额上限管，
  用户级记忆写多少条都不会让每轮注入变长。
- **不进常驻索引段**：索引段只有 4096 B，容量留给工作区条目
  （所以用户级条目是靠「按需召回」生效，不是像人设那样每轮都在）。
- **面板**：设置页 →「记忆控制」的库下拉里会多一项「**用户级（跨工作区）**」，
  可以像别的库一样看、搜、改状态。

> 还要更"永远在场"的？那是**人设/工作规范**两个文本框的活（它们每轮都注入）。
> 分工：**每轮都必须遵守的规则** → 那两个框；**换个项目还需要的事实** → 用户级库；
> **跟这个项目有关的事** → 工作区库。

### 三种状态

| 状态 | 含义 | 之后会怎样 |
|---|---|---|
| **在用** | 内容有效，可能被召回 | 正常参与注入与检索 |
| **已完成** | 这件事做完了（todo 完成、话题达成目标） | **内容仍然有效**，仍可被搜到与召回 |
| **已停用** | 这条不再正确或不再需要（过时、被取代、写错了） | 不再被注入，但仍可搜到、**可随时恢复** |

---

## 数据在哪

```
<工作区>/.dsh-memory/memory.db        ← 记忆库（每个工作区一个）
<工作区>/.dsh-memory/archive/         ← 日志溢出后的归档（jsonl）
$DSH_HOME/memory-lite/global/         ← 用户级库（跨工作区，见上一节）
$DSH_HOME/memory-lite/persona/        ← 人设 / 工作规范两个文本框的内容
$DSH_HOME/memory-lite/workspaces.json ← 库 → 工作区 的注册表
```

**删除记忆**：三种方式，按彻底程度

1. 设置页把条目改成「已停用」—— 不注入了，但还在库里（**推荐**，可恢复）
2. 用 `memory_forget` 工具删单条 —— 需要审批
3. 直接删 `.dsh-memory/` 目录 —— **全部记忆消失**，不可恢复

---

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里给插件加 `config`：

```yaml
- id: memory-lite
  name: dsh-plugin-memory-lite
  config:
    autoCapture: true             # 每轮自动落日志（不花额度）
    autoRecall: true              # 每轮按关键词注入（不花额度）
    autoDistill: false            # 空闲自动整理 —— 默认关（会花模型额度）
    distillIdleMinutes: 30        # 开启 autoDistill 时：多久没说话才算"空闲"
    distillMinIntervalMinutes: 30 # 开启 autoDistill 时：两次整理之间的最小间隔
    distillMaxPerDay: 4           # 开启 autoDistill 时：每天最多整理几次（成本硬上限）
    injectMaxItems: 3             # 单次最多注入几条
    injectMaxChars: 2000          # 单次注入的字符上限
    crossWorkspaceSearch: true    # 允许跨工作区检索
    distillProvider: ''           # 留空 = 用会话默认模型
    distillModel: ''
```

**关于花额度**：默认 `autoDistill: false` —— 日志照记，但**只有你点「立即整理」时**才会调用模型。
想让它自己长出来就把 `autoDistill` 设成 `true`，那时上面三个 `distill*` 参数才生效
（空闲多久算闲 / 冷却 / 每天上限）。

---

## 设计上的几个刻意选择

这些都是**踩过坑之后**定下来的，改动前请先读 `AGENTS.md`：

- **注入只走长期层**。日志层永不进提示词，否则前缀缓存失效、上下文预算被淹。
- **注入是"只追加"**：作为独立消息追加在本轮已领取消息之后，不改写已有历史。
- **不重复注入**：同一会话里已注入过的条目不再注入；压缩后重置这个记录并**补回常驻记忆**。
- **敏感内容 fail-closed**：`sensitive` 在**写入时**算一次并落列，注入时只读列。
  注入路径上再判断，等于把 fail-closed 变成 fail-open（判断代码出错就注入了）。
- **删除走审批**：`memory_forget` 声明为破坏性工具，转人工确认。
- **超预算的日志留到下次**：不"发都没发出去却记成处理过了"——那会永久丢内容。
- **蒸馏输入先剔系统样板，再取头尾**：日志一条 = 一整轮，里面夹着宿主注入的
  `<system-reminder>`（用户全局 `AGENTS.md` 等）。实测 10 条真实日志里**有 7 条的
  "前 1500 字"逐字相同** —— 不剔样板的话，模型看到的不是"这一轮发生了什么"，
  而是同一段样板。剔完再按 **头 40% + 尾 60%** 取样（结论在尾部）。
- **常驻索引段每条只列 20 字**：这段每轮都在 system prompt 里，中文 1 字 = 3 B。
  实测 33 条时它已占到 4096 B 预算的 83.8%（每行 123 B）→ 只装得下约 33 条，
  再多就会**静默**掉出提示词。截到 20 字后约能装 49 条。**别指望"回填标题"来救容量**
  —— 回填的标题同样会被截断，额外容量是 0。

---

## 已知限制

- **检索是关键词级的**，不是语义向量检索。中文查询按连续串与子串匹配，
  所以**换个说法可能搜不到**（用 `memory_search` 时尽量带上你当时用的词）。
- **每个工作区一个库**，默认只搜当前工作区；跨工作区要显式 `scope="all"`。
- 日志层有容量上限（每会话约 200 条），超出会**先写归档文件再删库内行**（不静默丢）。
- 空闲自动整理依赖宿主进程活着 —— 客户端关着的时候不会整理。

---

## 关于本仓库不含开发工具

本仓库**只有插件本身**（`index.js` / `lib/` / `client/` / `locale/` / 图标 / 补丁 / README / LICENSE）。

校验器（`verify-*.mjs`）、诊断脚本（`diag-*.mjs`）、迁移脚本与发布助手**不在仓库里**，
它们只在开发者本机（原因：那些脚本含开发机的绝对路径与个人数据位置，不该跟着插件发给别人；
这也是本项目的一贯纪律 —— 开发产物不进用户包）。

如果你想自己验证这个插件的行为，用它的**运行时表现**验：
装完之后在设置页看「记忆控制」，或者用 `memory_stats` / `memory_search` 这些工具直接问它。
真机行为才是判据。

---

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: FreeLLMAPI (Auto) provider route for DeepSeek Harness: pick the auto model and a local FreeLLMAPI gateway chooses the best free model, fails over automatically, and streams back as native DSH chunks.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-freellmapi

**Free-tier multi-provider routing for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).**
Eighteen provider entries behind one DSH provider route — five of them enabled by default, and all five of
those with a free tier — plus a per-request complexity classifier, capability/speed ranking, and automatic
429/5xx failover.

```text
install the plugin  →  start DSH  →  pick provider "freellmapi" + model "auto"  →  it answers
```

No external process. No gateway to run. No API key required to get a first answer — the built-in pool
contains keyless providers that the maintainer verified with real, credential-free requests.

> ### Unofficial plugin — please read
>
> This is a community project. It is **not** affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by or supported by
> any of the upstream providers it talks to, nor by DeepSeek. It is not an official DSH plugin.
> Provider names and "DeepSeek Harness" / `@deepseek-ai/*` belong to their respective owners.
> Licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE). **You are responsible for complying with each provider's
> terms of service, and for what you send to a free tier that may log and train on it.**

---

## Table of contents

- [Quick start](#quick-start)
- [What you get](#what-you-get)
- [Zero config: what works with no key at all](#zero-config-what-works-with-no-key-at-all)
- [Adding keys](#adding-keys)
- [How to read the model list](#how-to-read-the-model-list)
- [Pinned models are strict](#pinned-models-are-strict)
- [How it picks a model](#how-it-picks-a-model)
- [Long-running agent sessions: read this before you pick `auto`](#long-running-agent-sessions-read-this-before-you-pick-auto)
- [Failover and health](#failover-and-health)
- [Two modes: `direct` and `gateway`](#two-modes-direct-and-gateway)
- [Configuration](#configuration)
- [How to see what it did](#how-to-see-what-it-did)
- [Just one key? No keys?](#just-one-key-no-keys)
- [Architecture](#architecture)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)
- [Limitations and unverified claims](#limitations-and-unverified-claims)
- [Compatibility](#compatibility)
- [Development](#development)
- [Upstream and credits](#upstream-and-credits)
- [License](#license)

## Quick start

1. **Install** — open the DSH web GUI, go to the **Plugins** manager in the sidebar, install the bundle
   and paste one of these specs:

   ```text
   github:lion231226/dsh-freellmapi          # from GitHub (no npm publish needed)
   github:lion231226/dsh-freellmapi#v0.7.17   # pinned to a tag
   dsh-freellmapi                            # from npm, once published
   ```

   CLI equivalent, and the manual path, are in [Install details](#install-details).

2. **(Optional) paste a few keys** — see [Adding keys](#adding-keys). Skipping this step is a supported
   configuration: the two keyless providers still answer.

3. **Pick the model** — in the DSH model picker choose provider **FreeLLMAPI (Auto)** and model `auto`.

4. **Watch it work** — with `logRouting` on (the default) every request logs one line:

   ```text
   dsh-freellmapi: tier=complex -> openrouter/nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free (capability=5, speed=3, 2 candidates tried)
   ```

That is the whole setup. Everything below is detail.

### Install details

| Method | How |
|---|---|
| **Plugins manager (recommended)** | Sidebar → **Plugins** → install → paste `github:lion231226/dsh-freellmapi` (or the npm name once published), confirm, restart if DSH asks. The manager accepts registry names, absolute paths, git addresses and tarball URLs, and refuses any spec whose manifest declares no `dsh.bundle` — this package declares one. |
| **`dsh plugin` CLI** | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:lion231226/dsh-freellmapi` — the subcommands come from DSH's own runtime error text; ⚠️ not verified end-to-end here, so confirm against your DSH build. |
| **Manual placement** | Copy the package to `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-freellmapi/`, add it to **both** `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json`, then run `dsh plugin --profile <profile> install` and restart. Listing it in `bundles` is what makes DSH load it at all. |

The package ships its own `cordis.patch.yml` (`- insert: [{ id: freellmapi, name: 'dsh-freellmapi' }]`),
so a correctly installed bundle needs no hand-written patch row. **Never add a second row with the same
`id`** in the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`: two entries with one id abort bundle composition with
`duplicate loader entry id "freellmapi"`.

## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Self-contained routing** | The plugin owns the routing intelligence. `direct` mode (the default) needs no gateway, no daemon, no Docker — nothing but DSH itself. |
| **A built-in pool of 18 providers / 45 models** | Groq, Cerebras, OpenRouter, GitHub Models, Mistral, Z.ai (Zhipu), Volcengine Ark, LongCat, LLM7, Kilo, NVIDIA NIM and OVH AI Endpoints, plus the six 0.7.0 additions — ModelScope (魔搭), iFlytek Spark (讯飞星火), SiliconFlow (硅基流动), SambaNova, HuggingFace Router and Routeway — with per-model capability, speed, context window, vision and tool-calling facts. **Only five of the eighteen are enabled out of the box.** |
| **Per-request complexity routing** | Every request is scored and classified `simple` / `medium` / `complex`; the tier decides whether capability or speed dominates the ranking. A one-line "list the files here" and a 12-tool refactoring task do not go to the same model. |
| **Automatic failover** | A rate-limited (429), broken (5xx), timed-out or `model_unavailable` candidate is parked and the next-ranked one is tried — **only before the first chunk has been sent**, so a single answer is never spliced from two models. |
| **Health tracking and cooldowns** | The **first retryable failure already parks** the candidate (2 minutes), and each further consecutive failure escalates one step: 2 m → 10 m → 1 h → 24 h. `Retry-After` from the provider always wins; a rejected credential (401/403) parks that provider for 24 h. The scoring penalty decays with a 60-second half-life, so a single 429 is never a life sentence. |
| **Zero-config start** | Kilo and LLM7 answer without any credential; a fresh install has a non-empty candidate pool before you configure anything. |
| **Honest diagnostics** | One log line per request names the tier, the winner and how many candidates were tried; every failure is an in-band `finish` chunk with a stable code, never an exception. |
| **No silent substitutions** | Picking a concrete model id is a **strict pin**: if it has no credential, does not exist, or is cooling down, you get an explicit error with instructions instead of somebody else's answer. The model list shows only what can actually serve, plus one `setup:<provider>` signpost per unkeyed provider. |
| **`gateway` mode kept intact** | The v0.1.0 behaviour — forwarding to an external [freellmapi](https://github.com/tashfeenahmed/freellmapi) gateway — is still there behind `mode: gateway`, unchanged, for people who want the gateway's own bandit scoring, caching and `fusion`. |

## Zero config: what works with no key at all

The pool marks three providers **keyless** (no `Authorization` header at all). The maintainer verified
them with real requests on 2026-10-13 (`_lead/live-probe-2026-10-13.md`), sending **no** credential:

| Provider | Model | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `kilo` (`https://api.kilo.ai/api/gateway/v1`) | `nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free` | **HTTP 200**, real completion |
| `kilo` | `nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free` | free route, 550B class |
| `ovh` (`https://oai.endpoints.kepler.ai.cloud.ovh.net/v1`) | `gpt-oss-120b` | **HTTP 200** |
| `llm7` (`https://api.llm7.io/v1`) | `DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731` | **HTTP 200** (anonymous) |
| `llm7` | `codestral-latest` | **HTTP 200** (anonymous) |

`kilo` and `llm7` are **enabled by default**, so those two carry the "install and it works" promise.
`ovh` is keyless too but **disabled by default** (2 requests/minute — far too tight to be in the default
candidate set); enable it explicitly if you want it.

Three things you should know before you rely on a keyless pool:

- **Keyle

plugins.description: Adds an Omni-modal settings section to DeepSeek Harness: configure OpenAI-compatible image/video generation endpoints with switchable config profiles, plus generate_image / generate_video / check_video tools.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-omni-modal

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-2ea44f)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

**Give a text-only model the ability to draw pictures and shoot videos — without touching a single line of DeepSeek Harness source.**

`dsh-omni-modal` adds an **Omni-modal settings** section to the DSH settings sidebar, where you can point the harness at any **OpenAI-compatible** image / video endpoint and register three model-visible tools:

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `generate_image` | Synchronous text-to-image. Saves the PNG/JPEG/WebP to disk and (when the attachment service is available) returns an inline preview card. |
| `generate_video` | Asynchronous submit. Returns a task id immediately — the clip is still rendering. |
| `check_video` | Poll that task; on success it downloads the finished video to disk. |

Status: usable, tracks the Harness developer preview — interfaces may change.

![Image tab](docs/screenshot-image-tab.png)

![Video tab](docs/screenshot-video-tab.png)

## Features

- **Live-editable settings page** — a real DSH settings section (not a static skill). Change endpoint, key, model, path or default size and hit **Save**; the three tools pick it up on their next call, no restart.
- **Multiple config profiles** — keep several endpoints side by side, name them, switch the active one at a time. Every tool also accepts an optional `profile` argument to use a non-active profile for a single call.
- **Separate image and video configuration** — the two APIs rarely share a shape. Each profile carries an independent `baseUrl` / `apiKey` / `model` / path / size for each side.
- **Extra request parameters** — a free-form JSON object merged into the request body, for endpoint-specific knobs (`{"quality":"high"}`, `{"mode":"text","aspect_ratio":"16:9"}`, …).
- **Connectivity test** — one click probes `GET <baseUrl>/models` (falling back to the base URL itself) without spending generation quota.
- **Async video by design** — submit, remember the task, poll later. Task records survive restarts.
- **No build step** — plain ESM host half plus a hand-written CJS client bundle. Nothing to compile, no bundler needed.

## Install

Requires Node.js ≥ 18 and DeepSeek Harness.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:yzhclcl/dsh-omni-modal
```

`<profile>` is your DSH profile name (`web`, `desktop`, …). Add `#v0.1.0` to pin a tag.

Then **restart DSH** — the host half registers its routes and tools at boot, and the settings section appears under **Settings → Omni-modal settings**.

### Manual install (no pnpm / offline)

Copy this repository somewhere permanent, then add it to `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`:

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-omni-modal": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-omni-modal"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["dsh-omni-modal"]
    }
  }
}
```

and mirror the same entry into the `importers.` → `dependencies` block of `pnpm-lock.yaml`, then create the link:

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink `
  -Path "$HOME\.dsh\profiles\<profile>\node_modules\dsh-omni-modal" `
  -Target "/absolute/path/to/dsh-omni-modal"
```

> **Never copy the package into `node_modules` instead of linking it.** DSH uses a `Symbol` as the cross-module call key; loading the module twice makes those symbols unequal and every tool call then throws `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')`, with no recovery after a restart.

## Usage

Once installed, just talk to the agent:

- *"Draw a strawberry on a pale blue plate."* → `generate_image`
- *"Make a short video of a paper boat drifting down a stream."* → `generate_video`, then `check_video`

### Settings page

| Section | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| Config profiles | Pick the active profile, rename it, add one (copied from the current) / delete one |
| Image | Base URL, API key, model, request path, default size, extra request params |
| Video | Base URL, API key, model, submit path, query path, default resolution, default duration, extra request params |
| Task records | Submitted video tasks with their status and artifact path |

Notes:

- **Saving takes effect immediately** for the tools — no restart.
- **The base URL must be the address alone.** Documentation examples are easy to copy verbatim as `POST https://api.example.com/v1`; the plugin strips a leading `POST`/`GET`/… automatically, but writing just `https://api.example.com/v1` is safer.
- **The query path accepts two forms**: a relative path (`/videos/generations/{id}`) appended to the base URL, or a **full URL** (`https://api.example.com/agnesapi?video_id={id}&model_name={model}`) used as-is. The full form is necessary when the query endpoint does not live under the base URL.
- Placeholders available in the query path:

  | Placeholder | Replaced with |
  | --- | --- |
  | `{id}` | the task id returned by the submit call |
  | `{model}` | the model name configured in that profile |

- The tools **always use the active profile** unless you pass `profile` explicitly.

### Tools

```
generate_image(prompt, size?, model?, profile?, save_to?)
generate_video(prompt, model?, profile?, size?, seconds?, image_url?)
check_video(task_id, profile?, save_to?)
```

- `generate_image` returns synchronously. The file lands in the plugin data directory's `media/` and, if the attachment service is available, an image attachment is produced so the picture shows up in the conversation. **The model itself cannot see the pixels** — to actually look at the image, call `read_image` on the returned path.
- `generate_video` is asynchronous: it returns a `taskId` right away. Call `check_video(task_id)` later; when the status becomes `succeeded` the artifact is downloaded into `media/` automatically.
- Passing a **non-existent profile is a hard error** that lists the available profiles, rather than silently falling back to another one — otherwise the model would quietly use the wrong endpoint and model while the result still claims the profile it asked for.
- `check_video` failures are **soft failures**: a missing task (404), an unreachable download URL or a failed download return `status: "failed"` / `"succeeded"` plus a `message`, instead of throwing. These are expected business outcomes, and throwing would abort the whole tool-calling round.
- Video URL extraction covers the common response shapes: `video_url` / `videoUrl` / `url`, nested `video.url`, `data.*`, `output.*`, `result.*`, `videos[0].url`, and more.
- Task id extraction prefers `video_id` / `videoId` over `id` / `task_id` — some services (Agnes, for instance) return an internal id that cannot be used for polling.
- **429 (rate limit) / 503 (busy, queue full)** responses come back with a "retry in a moment" hint: they are retryable server states, not configuration errors.

## Example: Agnes AI

Agnes AI's image and video endpoints have different shapes; the video side needs the official parameter set. Using `apihub.agnes-ai.com`:

**Image**

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Base URL | `https://apihub.agnes-ai.com/v1` |
| Model | `agnes-image-2.5-flash` |
| Request path | `/images/generations` |
| Default size | e.g. `1312x736` |

**Video**

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Base URL | `https://apihub.agnes-ai.com/v1` |
| Model | `agnes-video-2.5-flash` |
| Submit path | `/videos` |
| Query path | `https://apihub.agnes-ai.com/agnesapi?video_id={id}&model_name={model}` |
| Default resolution | `720P` (Flash only accepts `720P`; anything else returns 400) |
| Default duration | `5` (a string, range `"4"`–`"12"`) |
| Extra request params | `{"mode":"text","aspect_ratio":"16:9"}` |

- Video submission is `POST /v1/videos` (**not** `/v1/videos/generations`), and `mode` is required (`text` / `keyframe` / `reference`) — put it in the extra params.
- Polling goes through `GET /agnesapi?video_id=…&model_name=…`, which is **outside `/v1`**, hence the full URL in the query path.
- Output dimensions follow `aspect_ratio`: `21:9`→1680x720, `16:9`→1280x704, `4:3`→960x720, `1:1`→720x720, `3:4`→720x960, `9:16`→720x1280.

plugins.description: DSH plugin: accurate + fast image insight (local measurement pipeline + DeepSeek vision).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-image-insight · 图像洞察

DSH 插件：**更准、更快**地识别图片。

一句话：本地用 `sharp` 先把图片"量"一遍（尺寸、清晰度、曝光、主色、边缘密度、候选区域、感知哈希），
再把这份客观测量连同缩放后的图一起交给云端视觉模型，要求它只输出结构化 JSON；
结果按图片指纹缓存，同一张图第二次识别**毫秒返回且不再消耗模型额度**。

- 注册 3 个工具：`image_insight`（主识别）、`image_similarity`（相似图检索）、`image_insight_cache`（缓存维护）
- 一次调用覆盖 5 项能力：内容描述、OCR（带坐标与置信度）、目标定位（相对百分比坐标）、细粒度属性、相似图判定
- 没有视觉模型时不失败：自动降级为完整本地感知结果，并说明原因

---

## 为什么"更准"

1. **客观量交叉印证。** 模型拿到的提示词里附带了本地测得的真实数据：像素尺寸与宽高比、方向是否被纠正、
   拉普拉斯方差对应的清晰度等级、过曝/欠曝裁剪比例、主色列表与彩色占比、边缘密度、UI/文档/照片的类型预判、
   候选区域数量。模型不需要靠"猜"图片是否模糊或偏暗，这些已经有了确定答案。
2. **强制结构化输出。** 系统提示词要求只输出 JSON、不编造看不见的内容、坐标统一为相对整图的 0–100 百分比、
   置信度低于 0.4 的目标不列、看不清的写进 `uncertainty` 字段。插件侧再做一次归一化：
   补全缺失字段、把越界坐标夹回 0–100、按置信度排序、目标上限 40 个、文本块上限 200 个。
3. **视觉模态预检。** 调用前先用 `llm.prepareCall()` 读 `inputModalities`，确认该模型真的声明了 `image` 输入；
   绝不把图片发给纯文本模型（否则会得到一段"我看不到图"的幻觉式回答）。
4. **优先用本机可认证的路由。** 选模型顺序是：显式 `provider`/`model` 参数 → 插件配置 → **宿主默认模型
   （`ctx.agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()`，也就是本机已配置凭据的那条路由）** → 模型目录里第一个声明
   `image` 输入的模型。第四种（`source: "auto-vision-catalog"`）在没登录对应 provider 时会报
   `no API key`，此时插件会在错误里补一句可执行的指引（点名当前会话模型作为候选）。
5. **路由失败可诊断。** 自动选模型时逐个候选尝试，失败时返回**每个候选被拒的原因 + 当前 provider 的模型目录
   （标注哪些支持图片、哪些是纯文本）+ 操作指引**，而不是一句"没有可用模型"。

## 为什么"更快"

1. **`mode: "local"` 完全不出网**——只做本地感知，微秒到毫秒级返回，零模型额度消耗。
2. **指纹缓存。** 缓存键 = `sha256(图片字节) + 请求指纹`。命中则直接返回历史结论，`cloudMs = 0`。
   键里包含"这次要问什么"，所以换 mode / 换提问不会错误复用旧答案。
3. **近似命中。** 每张图入库时记录 dHash/aHash 感知哈希，同图不同尺寸（例如用户截图又重新保存）
   会走近似命中，并**如实标注距离**（`cache.distance`），不会被伪装成精确命中。
4. **本地预缩放再出网。** 出网前按长边 `maxImageEdge`（默认 1536）等比缩放，
   落在官方视觉 token 网格内，避免适配器二次重编码与无谓的上传体积；
   带透明通道的图统一铺白底，避免 alpha 在 JPEG 路径上变成黑块导致识别错误。
5. **批量并行且保序。** 多图按 `maxConcurrency` 限并发处理，结果顺序与输入一致；
   字节完全相同的重复输入会被标记 `duplicateOf` 并跳过重复计算。
6. **相似图检索不读磁盘。** 指纹与摘要直接写进索引条目，检索只比对内存索引，
   不做 O(n) 次文件打开。
7. **按宿主的派发契约构造请求。** 宿主的 `prepareCall()` 会在未显式给档位时把适配器默认思考档
   （`deepseek-flash` 实测为 `high`）写进 resolved config，并在 `prepared.stream()` 派发前用
   `callConfigEquals` 逐字段比对；一旦 options 与 resolved config 不一致就抛
   `prepared LLM call config changed before adapter dispatch`。本插件把比对的字段
   （provider/model/temperature/maxTokens/stop/reasoningEffort）原样从 `prepared.config` 复制进 stream options，
   并默认把档位降到模型声明的**最低档**（`reasoningEffort: "auto"`）——识别属感知任务，不需要长思考链，
   低档位实测显著更快，且这条优化不会破坏上面的派发校验。

---

## 工具

### `image_insight` — 主识别

| 参数 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | 单个本地图片路径（推荐绝对路径）。与 `paths`/`attachmentId` 三选一 |
| `paths` | string[] | 多图批量识别，结果顺序与输入一致 |
| `attachmentId` | string | 会话内已存在的图片附件 ID（例如用户刚上传的图） |
| `mode` | enum | `full`（默认，全部能力）/ `describe` / `ocr` / `objects` / `attributes` / `local`（零出网） |
| `extraInstruction` | string | 额外要求，例如"重点读出水印文字" |
| `question` | string | 针对该图的自由提问，会在结构化识别之外补充回答 |
| `refresh` | boolean | `true` 忽略缓存强制重算 |
| `provider` / `model` | string | 显式指定视觉模型；省略则自动选择 |
| `showImage` | boolean | 结果卡片中附带原图引用块 |
| `cacheTtlDays` | number | 本次结果的缓存有效期（天） |
| `saveIndexLabel` | string | 给这条结果打标签，便于之后按标签辨认 |

`mode` 支持别名：`all`/`auto`→`full`、`detect`/`object`→`objects`、`attr`→`attributes`、`text`→`ocr`、`cache`/`fast`/`off`→`local`。

返回：`{ ok, mode, model:{provider,model,reasoningEffort?,source}, timing:{totalMs,localMs,cloudMs}, cache:{…}, results:[…], similar, stats, notice }`。
`model.source` 取值 `explicit` / `config` / `current-session` / `agent-default` / `auto-vision-catalog` / `none` / `unavailable`，
可直接看出这次用的是"你指定的模型"、"当前会话的模型"、"宿主默认模型（本机可认证）"还是"目录里第一个支持图片的模型"。
`model.reasoningEffort` 是这次实际生效的思考档位（配置为 `auto` 时取模型声明里最低的档，以求快）。

### `image_similarity` — 相似图检索（纯本地）

参数：`path` 或 `attachmentId`、`maxDistance`（0–64，默认 6）、`limit`（默认 5）。
用 dHash 汉明距离在已索引图片中检索，返回 `distance`、`aHashDistance`、`sameFile`、标签与摘要。全程不出网。

### `image_insight_cache` — 缓存维护

参数：`action`（`stats` / `gc` / `clear`）、`ttlDays`（仅 `gc` 使用）。
返回缓存目录、条目数、指纹数、命中统计（精确/近似/未命中）、占用体积、清理结果与调用统计。

---

## 配置

在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config` 里覆盖（`apply(ctx, config)` 会做范围检查与补默认值）：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cacheDir` | `$DSH_HOME/image-insight-cache` | 缓存目录 |
| `cacheTtlDays` | 30 | 条目有效期（天） |
| `cacheMaxEntries` | 2000 | 条目上限，超出按 LRU 淘汰 |
| `maxImageEdge` | 1536 | 出网前长边上限（像素） |
| `maxConcurrency` | 3 | 批量并发上限 |
| `timeoutMs` | 60000 | 单次云端识别超时 |
| `temperature` | 0 | 识别任务默认确定性输出 |
| `maxTokens` | 3000 | 单次云端输出上限 |
| `nearDuplicateDistance` | 6 | 近似命中/相似检索的 dHash 汉明距离阈值 |
| `reasoningEffort` | `auto` | 云端思考档位：`auto` 挑模型声明的最低档（更快）/ `default` 不指定 / 显式档位名如 `low` |
| `provider` / `model` | 空 | 固定视觉模型；留空则自动选择 |

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-image-insight
      name: dsh-image-insight
      config:
        maxImageEdge: 1536
        cacheTtlDays: 30
```

---

## 依赖与降级

- **`sharp` 是可选依赖。** 解析顺序：常规 `require.resolve` → 插件自己目录下的 `node_modules` →
  `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/node_modules` → profiles 通配 → 当前工作目录向上 6 层。找不到时会抛带可执行指引的
  `IMAGE_INSIGHT_DEPENDENCY_MISSING`，但**插件本身仍能加载**，只是本地感知能力不可用。
  Windows 上 `sharp` 的 win32 平台包必须**同时带 `libvips-42.dll` / `libvips-cpp-*.dll`**，缺 DLL 时
  `require('sharp')` 会报 `Could not load the "sharp" module using the win32-x64 runtime`（宿主里连 `@img` 目录都
  可能只被栽了一半）。本仓库的 `node_modules/` 里放了一份自洽的 `sharp@0.35.4 + @img/sharp-win32-x64（含 DLL）`
  作为**本地兜底**（`.gitignore` 已忽略，不随包发布）；发布到市场后由 npm `optionalDependencies` 正常安装。
- **`llm` / `attachments` 缺失时不报错。** 工具会返回完整的本地结果，`model.source = "unavailable"`，
  `notice` 说明"已降级为本地感知"及具体原因，而不是让整次调用失败。
- 需要云端能力但确实没有可用视觉模型时，抛 `IMAGE_INSIGHT_NO_VISION_MODEL`，错误文本包含候选拒绝原因与模型目录。

## DSH 版本适配

| DSH | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| **0.2.1**（当前） | 正常。工具注册、`llm.prepareCall()` 派发校验、`sharp` 本地感知、缓存、相似图检索都在 0.2.1 真宿主上跑过 |
| 0.1.x | 正常（0.1.0 插件版本即针对该宿主） |

0.2.1 上没有引入破坏性宿主改动，适配工作是「把清单与验证补齐」：

- `package.json` 增加 `engines.dsh: ">=0.2.1-rc.1"`、`repository` / `homepage` / `author`，版本升到 `0.2.0`；
- 三个工具的输出 schema 在 0.2.1 的严格校验下重新跑通（`tests/schema-contract.mjs`）；
- 本地感知依赖 `sharp` 的 Windows 二进制完整性重新核对（见上一条）。


## 安装

```powershell
# 在 DSH 会话中：
# plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=D:\test-dsh\dsh-image-insight
```

安装后以返回的 `application` 与 `warnings` 为准：`applied` 才算生效，`restart-required` 表示尚未生效，
替换已安装的同名包必须重启才能加载新的 JS 代。

## 测试

```powershell
$node = 'C:\Users\xuan\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe'
& $node tests\selftest.mjs        # 纯函数 / 本地感知 / 缓存层
& $node tests\integration.mjs     # 走宿主流水线的端到端行为（假宿主）
& $node tests\smoke-load.mjs      # 以宿主方式 import，最小上下文下 apply 不崩
& $node tests\schema-contract.mjs # 三个工具的输出必须过真实宿主那套 schema 校验
```

`tests/host-sim.mjs` 复刻了宿主 `ToolRuntime` 的成功路径：
`execute → 无损 JSON 快照 → schema 严格校验 → deepFreeze → output.render（必须是 ContentBlock[]）→ presentResult`。
契约写错会在测试里直接炸，而不是在界面上静默变成空白卡片。

### 不重启桌面 App 也要验证真实宿主

改完 JS 后桌面 App 里的插件仍是旧模块（宿主不重载），可以用 headless CLI 起一个全新进程验证：

```powershell
$env:DSH_HOME = 'D:\test-dsh\.dsh-headless'          # 隔离 home，避免动到真实配置
& 'C:\Users\xuan\AppData\Local\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' `
  --profile headless `
  --patch D:\test-dsh\fixtures\headless-overlay.yml ` # 把 agent-default-model 指到本机可认证的 deepseek-account
  "调用 image_insight 识别 D:\test-dsh\fixtures\vision-test.png，mode=full，把卡片原样贴出来"
```

隔离 home 的 `image-insight-cache` 与真实 home 相互独立；验证完把 `.dsh-headless` 整个删掉即可
（它包含一份 `.credentials.yaml` 副本，不要长期留在工作区）。

## 已知限制

- 相似图检索只覆盖**本插件索引过的图片**，不是全盘搜索。
- 候选区域数是本地估算的**视觉关注区域数量，不是物体数量**，结果里已明确标注这一点。
- 云端识别质量最终取决于所用视觉模型的能力；插件负责的是减少模型犯错的空间（客观测量 + 结构化约束 + 归一化）。
- 小程序式的自定义卡片（`tool.call.toolview` 客户端渲染）尚未实现：当前使用宿主通用的 generic 卡片，
  并由 `presentationMeta` 提供结构化元数据。

# CaSee 市场情报分析专家 · DSH 插件 *由 CaSee 凯见情报平台驱动 —— 把 500+ 可信信源变成一名可溯源的市场情报分析师*

**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md) *** ## 关于 CaSee —— AI 驱动的竞争情报平台 **CaSee（凯见）** 是 AI 驱动的**竞争情报与市场洞察平台** —— 「谋定而后动，见微知著，决胜千里」。 CaSee 提供**可信信源竞争情报**，帮助创业公司发现市场机会、帮助成熟企业扩大竞争优势。它解决企业竞争情报的核心痛点： - 情报采集碎片化 - 人工分析低效 - 市场洞察滞后 - 情报无法进入业务决策 面向中大型企业的市场、销售、产品与战略团队，CaSee 把市场数据与业务决策连接起来 —— 从**被动竞争监测**升级为**主动市场趋势预判**。 ### 平台能力 | 能力 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | **实时竞争感知** | 针对具体业务线监测竞品、市场与客户；全景式外部环境扫描；分级实时威胁预警 | | **量化竞争威胁分析** | SWOT、PESTEL、BCG 矩阵、VRIO 框架等系统化分析工具，评估行业盈利性、竞争格局与政策风险 | | **主动策略评估** | 自研神经-因果 AI 长链因果推理引擎，预测竞争策略效果 —— 开放世界推理长链因果，封闭世界推理量化执行结果 | | **可信情报采集** | 实时竞品追踪、市场趋势预测、碎片化情报融合、目标导向的定向情报感知 | | **专家竞争分析** | 定制化 CI 分析能力建设、自助式专业报告、行业专家知识库 | > **可信情报保障**：量化 T-Score 可信度评分、多源交叉验证、因果推理偏差检测与合规护栏，防止 AI 幻觉、过期数据与虚假引用。 > **试用 CaSee**： —— 注册并获取 API 密钥。 *** ## 🎯 这是什么 `dsh-plugin-market-intelligence` 是面向 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** 的市场情报分析专家插件（一个 `dsh.bundle` 包）。装入后，它向当前 profile 贡献三件东西，把 CaSee 情报能力直接变成模型可调用的原生能力： | 贡献 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | **6 个模型可调用工具** | `find_trusted_sources`、`search_intelligence`、`analyze_trend`、`aggregate_by_source`、`search_with_cvc`、`semantic_search` | | **专家人格段落** | 注册为 system prompt 的 `market-intelligence:expert` 段（order 5）：分析师角色、三条铁律、T-Score/ABCD 分级、检索方法与双格式输出契约 | | **内置技能** | `market-intelligence` 技能（`ctx.skills` 运行时注册）：核心流程、检索策略、市场工作流、报告模板与 **HTML 报告样式规范** | > **取数通道说明**：插件直连 CaSee **REST** 接口（`/v1/sources/search`、`/v1/searchx`、`/v1/semantic-search`）。它与 `causalai.me:8100` 的 MCP 端点是**两条独立通道**，互不依赖。 *** ## 🤖 为什么用它 把竞争情报做进 agent 通常意味着：自己接 HTTP、做字段映射、去重、统计、缓存、调度、安全审查，再自造一套报告样式 —— 每个信源、每个产品都要重来一遍。 `dsh-plugin-market-intelligence` 把这些变成**一次安装 + 一套契约**： | 维度 | 手工集成 | 用本插件 | | --- | --- | --- | | **首个可用分析** | 数天（后端 + 前端 + 胶水） | 一次 `dsh plugin add` | | **数据可信度** | 自行判断来源真伪 | 每条情报自带 T-Score + ABCD 分级，可溯源 | | **检索能力** | 自建搜索与过滤 | 类 Google 查询语法 + 两阶段可信检索 + CVC 语义检索 | | **报告交付** | 自己写模板与图表 | 内置 CaSee 深色看板规范（appbar/封面/目录/编号章节/ECharts/来源附录） | | **幻觉风险** | 全靠提示词自律 | 工具层 + 人格层双重「零编造」约束 | > **核心价值**：市场情报能力变成**可安装、可配置、可复现**的 Harness 能力，且报告规范与 CaSee 官方报告同款。 *** ## 🚀 快速开始 ### 前置条件 - **Node.js ≥ 22.19**（DSH 运行时要求） - **DeepSeek Harness `dsh` ≥ 0.1.0-rc.6**（`dsh --version` 可查） - **CaSee API 密钥** —— 到 免费注册后获取 ### 第 1 步 —— 安装 ```bash # A. npm（推荐，包名即身份） dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-market-intelligence # B. GitHub 仓库 dsh plugin --profile web add github:xcasee/dsh-plugin-market-intelligence # C. tarball（离线 / 评审分发） dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-plugin-market-intelligence-1.0.0.tgz ``` 重启 `dsh web`。 ### 第 2 步 —— 确认插件层已生效 ```bash dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A6 market-intelligence ``` 应能看到： ``` # == dsh-plugin-market-intelligence - id: market-intelligence name: dsh-plugin-market-intelligence config: apiBaseUrl: http://121.43.113.132:8000 ... ``` ### 第 3 步 —— 配置 API 密钥 密钥**只从环境变量读取，绝不写入配置文件**： ```bash export CASEE_API_KEY=<你的密钥> ``` 然后**新开一个对话**（工具绑定发生在会话创建时）。 ### 第 4 步 —— 直接提问 ``` 追踪比亚迪最近 30 天在新能源汽车领域的竞争动态 分析近 90 天 AI 芯片行业趋势，只看 T-Score 0.8 以上的信源 调研中国人形机器人行星滚柱丝杠的市场规模、格局与进入机会 ``` *** ## ⚙️ 配置 在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`$DSH_HOME/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`）按 `id` 覆盖。**补丁整块替换 `config`，需重述全部要保留的键**： ```yaml - id: market-intelligence config: apiBaseUrl: 'http://121.43.113.132:8000' apiKeyEnv: CASEE_API_KEY defaultDays: 30 defaultMinTscore: 0.6 maxLimit: 200 timeoutMs: 30000 requestIntervalMs: 200 registerSkill: true registerPrompt: true platformUrl: 'https://casee.me' outputLanguage: auto ``` | 键 | 默认 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | `apiBaseUrl` | `http://121.43.113.132:8000` | CaSee REST 基地址（**非** 8100 MCP 端口） | | `apiKeyEnv` | `CASEE_API_KEY` | 读取密钥的环境变量名 | | `defaultDays` | `30` | 默认时间窗口（天） | | `defaultMinTscore` | `0.6` | 默认可信度门槛 | | `maxLimit` | `200` | 单次请求条数上限 | | `timeoutMs` | `30000` | 单请求超时（毫秒） | | `requestIntervalMs` | `200` | 出站请求最小间隔（毫秒），`0` 关闭限速 | | `registerSkill` | `true` | 是否注册内置技能 | | `registerPrompt` | `true` | 是否注册专家人格段落 | | `platformUrl` | `https://casee.me` | 报告 CTA 与取密钥引导链接 | | `outputLanguage` | `auto` | 报告语言：`auto`（跟随用户）/`zh`/`en` | *** ## 💬 使用 ### 六个情报工具 | 工具 | 用途 | 关键参数 | | --- | --- | --- | | `find_trusted_sources` | 按类别/地区/语言/可信度发现可信信源 | `category`、`min_tscore`、`limit` | | `search_intelligence` | 在可信信源子集内做类 Google 语法检索（主力） | `q`、`source_ids`、`days`、`min_tscore` | | `analyze_trend` | 按日/月聚合声量，找峰值与催化点 | `q`、`days` | | `aggregate_by_source` | 按信源统计报道量、平均可信度与样例标题 | `q`、`days` | | `search_with_cvc` | 检索并把命中归集到 CVC 向量模型 | `q`、`cvc_model_id` | | `semantic_search` | CVC 语义检索（BM25 + 向量 + RRF，跨语种） | `cvc_model_id`、`q`、`mode` | ### 查询语法（`q`） | 运算符 | 含义 | 示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `+word` | AND | `+AI +芯片` | | `-word` | NOT | `+电动车 -自行车` | | `a\|b` | 同义 OR | `电动车\|EV\|NEV` | | `"phrase"` | 精确短语 | `"market share"` | | `(...)` | 分组 | `+(特斯拉\|Tesla) +(交付\|销量)` | 中文关键词由平台自动翻译为英文检索，返回 `translated_keywords` 供核对。 ### 输出契约 每次分析**同时**产出两部分，不可二选一： 1. **对话内 Markdown 摘要** —— 一句话结论 + 3–5 条关键发现（每条附 T-Score + 信源名 + 日期 + 可点链接） 2. **完整 HTML 报告文件** —— CaSee 深色看板：appbar → 封面（4 指标卡）→ 吸顶目录 → 00 结论先行 → 编号章节（含 ECharts 图表 / SWOT / 时间线 / 矩阵）→ 来源附录（编号来源 + T-Score 徽章） *** ## 🛡 T-Score 可信度体系 | T-Score | 等级 | 标识 | 使用纪律 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | ≥ 0.8 | A | 🟢 | 可直接作为决策依据 | | 0.6–0.8 | B | 🟡 | 结合上下文使用 | | 0.4–0.6 | C | 🔴 | 信号参考，必须交叉验证 | | < 0.4 | D | ⚪ | 视为传言，不作事实陈述 | **ABCD 信源分级**：A=通讯社/官方；B=主流权威；C=垂直媒体/博客；D=UGC/论坛。 *** ## 🧩 工程结构 ``` dsh-plugin-market-intelligence/ ├── package.json # dsh.bundle 清单 + 依赖 + 脚本 ├── cordis.patch.yml # bundle 补丁层（插入 market-intelligence 行） ├── tsconfig.json ├── src/ │ ├── index.ts # 插件入口：name / inject / Config / apply │ ├── config.ts # Schemastery 配置 schema │ ├── casee-client.ts # CaSee REST 客户端（归一化 + 限速 + 超时 + 错误码） │ ├── errors.ts # 结构化错误 │ ├── types.ts # 规范返回值类型 │ ├── prompt.ts # 专家人格 system-prompt 段落 │ ├── skill.ts # 运行时技能注册 │ └── tools/ # 6 个工具 + 共享 schema/渲染 ├── assets/skills/market-intelligence/ │ ├── SKILL.md # 技能正文 │ └── analysis/ # 核心流程 / 检索策略 / 市场工作流 / 报告模板 / 报告样式规范 ├── tests/ # 仿真测试（mock REST + 全流程 + 报告断言） └── .github/workflows/publish.yml # tag 触发的自动发布 ``` ### 开发命令 ```bash npm install # 构建依赖（@deepseek-ai/* 为 optional peer + devDependency） npm run typecheck # 类型检查 npm run build # 产出 lib/ npm test # 仿真测试：装载冒烟 + mock CaSee REST 全流程 + 报告断言 npm pack # 产出 dsh-plugin-market-intelligence-1.0.0.tgz ``` `npm test` 会启动进程内 mock CaSee REST 服务，用**真实插件代码**跑完整流水线，校验 6 个工具、正/负路径（`AUTH_REQUIRED` / `INVALID_ARGUMENT` / `HTTP_ERROR`）、方法学结论（Niche Go / Watch / No-Go 与否决闸门）与报告产物。产物落在 `tests/output/`。 *** ## 🩺 排错 | 现象 | 原因 | 处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | `AUTH_REQUIRED` | 未配置或密钥无效 | 到 取密钥，`export CASEE_API_KEY=...` 后**新开对话** | | `NETWORK_ERROR` / `TIMEOUT` | 端点不通或过慢 | 核对 `apiBaseUrl` 与出站网络；必要时调大 `timeoutMs` | | `RATE_LIMITED` | 调用过快 | 降低并发（≤100 次/分钟）或调大 `requestIntervalMs` | | `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | `cvc_model_id` 不合规 | 使用 `^cvc_[a-z0-9]{8,32}$`，如 `cvc_battery_anxiety` | | 工具未出现 | 未装插件 / 未重启 | `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 确认层，重启 `dsh web` | *** ## 📦 发布 ```bash npm version patch git tag v1.0.1 && git push origin v1.0.1 # 触发 .github/workflows/publish.yml ``` CI 需要仓库 Secret `NPM_TOKEN`（npm **Automation** token）。仅预演可手动运行 workflow 且不勾选 publish。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: rewrite assistant replies in the persisted session log in place, so later turns read your version. DSH 插件：就地改写会话落盘记录里的助手回复，后续轮次读到的是改写后的版本。也支持伪造伪造回复，刷新就变回去，不影响流程。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-reply-forge-v2

DSH 桌面端插件 v2：**真伪造**——改写的 AI 回复进入会话落盘记录，被大模型
当作真实历史采信，且会话可继续对话。

与 v1（`dsh-reply-forge`，只做本机渲染层伪造）**完全独立**：独立仓库、
独立插件 id、独立安装链路。v1 封版不再演进；v2 不是 v1 的功能升级，
是另一条技术路线。

## 三大目标（验收标准）

1. **dsh 桌面端加载不会崩溃**——bundle 契约、注册 id、patch 插入全部
   合规；与 v1 可分别启用、互不踩踏；
2. **伪造回复会被大模型认同**——改写内容进入会话上下文，下一轮请求
   模型读到的就是伪造历史（含签名降级通道处理）；
3. **还能继续对话**——改写后会话完整性不破坏：可正常打开、可继续
   流式输出、投影/状态机不错位，且可回滚。

## 当前状态（2026-10-15）

**v2.0 与 v2.2 已实现；v2.2.1 修复了两处真机 bug（会话 id 寻址 + 记录缓存过期），
已安装进 desktop profile，等重启 DSH 生效。**
设计与实证见 [PLAN.md](PLAN.md)。

| 阶段 | 内容 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|
| v2.0 | 关闭态落盘改写器（CLI） | ✅ 实现完成，读取侧验收通过 |
| v2.0 | 真机重启后模型侧采信 | ✅ 用户实测通过（编辑内容被大模型认可） |
| v2.1 | 运行态写入（探针先行） | ⬜ 未开工 |
| v2.2 | UI 合一（dsh 插件形态） | ✅ 实现完成，已安装 |
| v2.2 | 真机重启后 UI 生效 | ✅ 用户实测可用（含两条回复的伪造） |
| v2.2.1 | 真机 bug 修复 | ✅ 已修（详见 PLAN §9.8），待重启验证 |

已落地的代码：

**写入内核（纯 ESM、零依赖）**

- `src/session-log.mjs` —— 只读层（多帧 zstd JSONL 解析、正文块收窄），
  从 v1 移植，自带多个真实会话的解析验证史；
- `src/session-write.mjs` —— 写入器核心：**seq+块索引 / 指纹**双寻址、
  `expectText` 陈旧校验、剥签名、多帧重组、原子写、写后自读校验；
- `src/checkout.mjs` —— 会话副本检出的公共逻辑。

**插件形态（v2.2）**

- `.dsh-plugin/index.mjs` —— host half：只声明 `inject: ['webServer']`，
  `apply()` 全程 try/catch，任何异常都不会拖垮宿主启动；
- `.dsh-plugin/server/routes.mjs` —— 两条 HTTP 路由：读块列表 / 执行写入。
  写路由带自定义头校验、参数校验、超长拒绝，业务失败一律 200 + `ok:false`；
- `.dsh-plugin/client/index.mjs` —— client half：在每条助手回复下挂操作条，
  就地编辑器双出口（`仅本机渲染` / `写入会话记录`）。会话 id 取自宿主渲染的
  `data-conversation-session` 属性——dsh 的 URL 里没有会话 id（见 PLAN §9.7）；
  记录比页面旧时自动重读补定位，不让用户对着一句过时的「对不上」干瞪眼（§9.8）；
- `.dsh-plugin/client/record.mjs` —— 磁盘记录访问层 + DOM↔磁盘两级匹配；
- `.dsh-plugin/client/{picker,markdown,classify,store,styles}.mjs` ——
  从 v1 移植的 UI 模块（前缀全部改为 `rf2-`，与 v1 严格隔离）；
- `.dsh-plugin/client.js` —— 构建产物（由 `scripts/build-client.mjs` 内联）。

**脚本**

- `scripts/forge-session.mjs` —— v2.0 写入 CLI（含 `--dry-run` / `--restore` /
  `--seq` / `--block-index` / dsh 运行中拒绝写入）；
- `scripts/install.mjs` / `enable.mjs` / `disable.mjs` / `profile-lib.mjs` ——
  安装 / 启用 / 关闭（**只改静态配置，绝不跑 pnpm**）；
- `scripts/build-client.mjs` —— client half 内联构建器（`--check` 校验新鲜度）；
- `scripts/host-oracle.mjs` —— 宿主预言机：用宿主自己的 dsh 起 slim host，
  直连 RPC 读回改写后的会话，双跑（伪造 vs 原始）有区分度；
- `scripts/provider-oracle.mjs` —— 照抄 App 真实启动配方起完整 desktop
  profile，读 provider 注册表（用于定位 13 渠道故障）；
- `scripts/session-anatomy.mjs` —— 会话解剖 / 上下文预算体检（只读），
  回答「这个会话还能不能继续对话」；
- `scripts/frame-anatomy.mjs` —— 帧结构解剖辅助工具。

测试 **73/73**：`session-log` 11 + `session-write` 15 + `session-anatomy` 7 +
`client` 23 + `routes` 15 + `build` 2。跑法：

```bash
for f in tests/*.test.mjs; do node "$f"; done
```

## 安装 / 启用 / 关闭

三个一键脚本（双击即可，不需要命令行）：

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `安装插件.bat` | 首次安装：建链接、写依赖、登记 lockfile、加入 bundles |
| `启用插件.bat` | 已装但被关掉时，加回 bundles（不需要重新安装） |
| `关闭插件.bat` | 停用：从 bundles 摘掉（保留链接与依赖，可秒开回来） |

三者都**只修改 dsh 启动时读取的静态配置**，不执行 pnpm。安装脚本默认会
顺手把 v1 从 bundles 里摘掉（两个插件同时启用会挂出两条操作条），但保留
v1 的依赖与链接，v1 用它自己的 `启用插件.bat` 就能开回来。想两个都开：
`node scripts/install.mjs --keep-v1`。

**改完必须完全退出并重启 DSH 才生效。**

## 与 v1 的关系

| | v1（dsh-reply-forge） | v2（本仓库） |
|---|---|---|
| 伪造层 | 浏览器渲染层（localStorage 覆盖） | 会话落盘记录（zstd JSONL） |
| 模型可见 | 否 | **是** |
| 落盘文件 | 一个字节都不碰 | 受控改写（带备份/回滚） |
| 适用 | 录屏/演示/截图 | 让模型采信伪造上下文 |

`src/session-log.mjs` 是从 v1 移植的只读层（多帧 zstd JSONL 解析、
assistant/message 文本块收窄），作为 v2 写入器的地基，自带多个真实
会话的解析验证史。

> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

# dsh-plugins

![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg) ![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D18-brightgreen.svg) ![pnpm](https://img.shields.io/badge/pnpm-10.33.2-orange.svg) ![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-blueviolet.svg)

> 仓库地址：<https://github.com/hj01857655/dsh-plugins>

DeepSeek Harness 插件集合（monorepo）。

从 8 个独立仓库合并而来，**完整保留 173 个 commit 的历史**（用 `git filter-repo` 重写路径 + `git merge --allow-unrelated-histories`）。

## 结构

```
dsh-plugins/
├── package.json              # private 根，pnpm workspace
├── pnpm-workspace.yaml       # packages/*
├── PLUGIN-CONTRACT.md        # 插件开发契约（跨插件共享）
├── THEME-CONTRACT.md         # 主题与令牌契约
└── packages/
    ├── dsh-context-memory/   # 每个仍是独立 npm 包
    ├── dsh-cost-track/
    ├── dsh-model-arena/
    ├── dsh-prompt-vcs/
    ├── dsh-spill-hygiene/
    ├── dsh-step-trace/
    ├── dsh-theme-studio/
    ├── dsh-tool-stats/
    └── dsh-verdict/
```

## 插件

| 插件 | npm 版本 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| dsh-context-memory | `0.6.1` | pre-step 捕获显式记忆语句，注入 top-5 相关记忆 + 未决冲突 |
| dsh-verdict | `0.5.1` | 评审/校验流水线（guard、pipeline、promote、schedule、skills） |
| dsh-theme-studio | `0.6.3` | 主题工作室（tokens、apply、io、themes） |
| dsh-cost-track | `0.5.1` | 成本追踪 + 计价 |
| dsh-model-arena | `0.5.1` | 模型竞技场（arena、diff、scoring） |
| dsh-prompt-vcs | `0.5.1` | 提示词版本控制 |
| dsh-step-trace | `0.5.1` | 单步追踪回放 |
| dsh-tool-stats | `0.5.1` | 工具调用统计 |
| dsh-spill-hygiene | `0.1.0` | 回收 dsh 自家 spill 清理看不见（根前缀 + 目录形态双重失配）的子进程 spill 残留；默认只报告，`--apply` 才删 |

## 常用命令

```powershell
# 安装全部依赖（共享一份 node_modules）
pnpm install

# 构建 / 测试 / 类型检查（全部包）
pnpm build
pnpm test
pnpm typecheck

# 只操作某个包
pnpm --filter dsh-verdict build
pnpm --filter dsh-verdict test

# 发某一个包
cd packages\dsh-verdict
npm publish

# 一次性发所有包（版本已各自 bump 后）
pnpm -r publish
```

## 收益

| | 合并前 | 合并后 |
|---|---|---|
| `node_modules` | 375.3 MB（8 份重复） | 52.9 MB（1 份共享） |
| 依赖安装 | `cd` 8 次 `npm install` | 根目录一次 `pnpm install` |
| CI | 8 份相同 `ci.yml` | 1 份 |
| 发全部 | 重复 8 次 | `pnpm -r publish` |

各包的 `name` / `version` / `files` / `dsh` 字段与 `peerDependencies` **完全未变**，npm 用户装到的内容一致。

## 修订契约时

契约条款必须来自对**运行时**的实际核验。当前基准 `0.2.0-rc.2`：

```powershell
$g = "$env:APPDATA\npm\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai"
$d = "C:\Users\12925\AppData\Local\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai"
$g\dsh-plugin-manager\README.zh.md   # 第 9 章的一手来源
```

## 已知测试失败（合并前既有，非合并导致）

- `dsh-context-memory`：3 个失败
- `dsh-verdict`：9 个失败

均已在备份的原仓库上复现同一组失败，见 `git log` 中 `packages/` 下的历史。

plugins.description: Keeps archived sessions out of the DSH conversation list and adds a panel to restore them or delete them permanently - session log, archive and pin records, and projection cache.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-archive-purge

Keeps archived sessions out of the DSH conversation list, and gives them one place to be restored — or **deleted for good**, which DSH itself deliberately has no path for.

> Looking for the npm name `dsh-archive-manager`? That one belongs to a different, unrelated
> plugin. This is `dsh-archive-purge`.

![The archived-session panel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joyboy-yy/dsh-archive-purge/main/docs/panel.png)

*Every screenshot here is rendered from invented sessions — no real titles, paths or sizes.*

## The two gaps it closes

DSH can archive a session, but:

- **Archiving is only a view concern.** The sidebar keeps rendering archived rows whenever *View options → Archived* is set to show them, and it keeps them in archived search results too. There is no switch that means "never show these".
- **Nothing ever deletes a session.** `dsh-client-ui-workspace` documents no session deletion and `dsh-session-persistence` documents no delete seam, so archived sessions accumulate on disk forever.

This plugin closes both: it pins archived sessions out of the list, and it owns the erase path.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-archive-purge
```

Use your own profile name in place of `desktop` (for example `web`). Then switch it on under **Settings → Plugins**, where it appears as `dsh-archive-purge`. Turning it off disables the host routes and the browser panel together and leaves session data untouched.

## What it does

| | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| **Always hidden** | In the sidebar conversation list, an archived session row is never shown — whatever *View options → Archived* is set to. A component registered on `shell.overlay` writes `[data-row-key="session:<id>"]{display:none}` for every id in the registry's `archivedSessionIds`, plus a fallback rule keyed on the accessible description so archived search-result rows are covered as well. |
| **Filter reset** | The browser-persisted `dsh.workspace.view.v5` has its `archivedFilter` reset to the shipped default (`default`, i.e. "hide archived"), so the menu stops claiming "All conversations (show archived)" while showing nothing. |
| **Management panel** | A sidebar icon plus a centre-column panel lists every archived session with its workspace, path, disk footprint, creation time and child-session count; it supports search, multi-select and batch unarchive. |
| **Permanent delete** | Delete sessions one at a time or in bulk, behind a confirmation dialog that names the sessions, their size, and exactly what will be removed. |

The panel takes its colours from the host's `--dsw-alias-*` tokens and ships English and Chinese wording, so it follows whichever theme and locale the app is in rather than a look of its own.

## Permanent delete: the exact boundary

![The confirmation dialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joyboy-yy/dsh-archive-purge/main/docs/confirm.png)

One delete removes four things:

1. **The session log directory** `<DSH_HOME>/sessions/<project>/<encoded-session-id>/` — the session's own directory, every format generation in it, and any session-local artifact;
2. **The projection-cache record** `<DSH_HOME>/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`;
3. **The archive and pin records** (`archivedSessionIds` / `pinnedSessionIds` in the workspace registry);
4. **The row in your browser** — announced through the session controller's own `api-session/removed` remote event (`@mode emit`) so the client drops the row instead of leaving a clickable ghost.

**Deliberately kept:** attachment files. Attachments are content-addressed and may be shared with other sessions, so they are out of scope. The panel says so at the bottom. An archived entry whose log is already gone from disk only has its record cleaned up, and the button reads "Clear record" instead.

## Refusals run before any write

![A batch that skipped one session](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joyboy-yy/dsh-archive-purge/main/docs/refusals.png)

A batch reports each outcome separately: what was deleted and how much it freed, what had no log left to delete, and what was refused — named, with the reason.

- The session is **not in the archive set** → skipped. Deletion is only ever available for archived sessions.
- An **agent for that session still exists in this process** (`ctx.agents.get(id)`) → refused (`live`). An agent may already hold the log's write handle, and deleting the file underneath it would let the writer resurrect the log.
- The `workspace/session-activity` waterfall still reports **work in progress** → refused (`active`).
- The target directory is not **inside the configured sessions root**, or its name is not exactly the encoded session id → refused (`outside-root`).

Being merely *loaded* is deliberately **not** a refusal reason: the browser keeps an in-memory mirror for every rendered session row and never releases it, so refusing on that would make every archived session undeletable after enough browsing. The gate matches DSH's own archive gate (the activity waterfall) plus one cheaper agent check. Skipped and failed sessions are listed individually in the panel, with the reason.

## Ghost rows, and the two layers that remove them

DSH's browser session list is **event-driven**: it only adds and removes entries in response to `api-session/added` / `api-session/removed`. A deleted session also leaves the archive set, so in the sidebar it goes from "hidden" to "should be shown" — and the cached row becomes a visible, clickable row that fails with `session/not-found` when opened.

Two layers remove it:

- **Host side (authoritative).** After a successful delete and *before* the archive set is rewritten, the host emits `ctx.emit('api-session/removed', id)` — the remote event the session controller defines and forwards for exactly this fact. The client receives a `{ kind: 'remove', sessionId }` change and drops the row. Emitting before the registry write avoids a flash where the row is un-hidden and then disappears.
- **Client side (self-healing fallback).** The inventory carries `persistedIds` — the session ids the host's persistence layer actually knows. The panel diffs the browser's cached ids against it, folds the remainder into the same hide rule, and shows the count under the title. The diff is recomputed on every read rather than accumulated, so one failed read cannot permanently hide a live session. Ids deleted within this page session are tracked separately as a union, since that needs no read to take effect.

**If you deleted sessions before both layers existed**, those leftover rows need one page reload to disappear — the client re-fetches the list from the host on load. Deletions made afterwards do not leave them.

## Known leftovers

- **Dangling ids in workspace membership.** `tables.workspaces.<id>.sessionIds` is a persisted member array and the host exposes no "remove a member" operation (`insertSessionBefore` only inserts and orders). A deleted session's id therefore stays in that array. DSH tolerates missing members — it looks up a summary while deriving rows and skips what it cannot find — so this never renders as a row. It is bookkeeping residue, not a UI problem.
- **Agent lifetime.** Archiving only stops, hides and gates a session; it does not destroy the agent. Agents are reclaimed when the agent-loop provider unloads or the process exits. A session archived in the current DSH process is therefore refused by this plugin until you restart DSH. See *Refusals* above.

## Maintenance notes

- To land a delete precisely, the host half **copies verbatim** the `encodeSegment` function from `dsh-session-persistence-jsonl`. If a DSH upgrade changes the session directory layout, that function has to follow it. Until then a delete refuses (because the directory name is not the encoded session id, or holds no session log) rather than removing the wrong thing.
- The client hide rule depends on the sidebar's `data-row-key="session:<id>"` attribute, which `dsh-client-ui-workspace` adds itself. If that ever changes, the `aria-description` fallback rule still applies.
- There is **no build step and no runtime dependency**: both halves are plain ESM shipp

plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - **晋升为容器时不再把 API 留在容器上**：叶子被晋升（显式 `normify_module_promote`、写子模块自动晋升、move 到叶子底下） 时，容器上残留的 `apis` 会被摘除，并回报 `structure/api-dropped-on-promote` 警告（附丢失的 API 键清单）—— 修复前项目会直接卡在 `api/non-leaf`。 - **API 默认全展开**：渲染数据字段 `max_api_rows` 缺省 **0 = 全部展开**，叶子上的 API 一行不折叠；需要收窄时显式写 1..48。 - 三处缺陷各自配了回归断言：`tests/regression-0.5.2.mjs`（34 项，全绿）。 ### v0.5.1 · 渲染器防重叠（线压线 12 → 0） - **修复连线共线重叠**：28 层合计 **12 处 → 0 处**。四处根因： ① 首选路由只判"不穿别人的框"，从不检查是否压到已画的线 → 改为只接受 `violations === 0` 的候选； ② API 锚定端口没有端口分离（同一 API 行被多条边共用） → 行内 ±5.5px 扇形分离； ③ API 端口落在上下边时被放进框内部 → 上下边退回按边均匀分离； ④ `segClear` 整块跳过源/目标框 → 新增"进入自身框内部"检查（内缩 2px）。 - 节点/分组间距 170 → 220，给密集层更多自由通道。 ### v0.5.0 · 取消模块数量上限 - **删除 `MAX_DEPTH = 12`** 硬限制：树可以一直下钻到"单一功能单元"；需要限层时用 `policy.yml` 的 `max-depth` 规则显式声明（`maxDepth` 放宽到 1..64）。 - SKILL：目标深度改为"不设上限"，单批上限 40 → 200，新增"每叶 API 尽量 3–5 条"的粒度指引。
更早的版本（v0.4.x / v0.3 / v0.2 / v0.1） - **v0.4.1**：渲染器 v3 定稿（自由通道走线、viewBox 全几何自适应、API 直连、跨层聚合、缩放与悬停）； `normify_sync` 识别**未跟踪的新文件**（`git ls-files --others`）。 - **v0.4.0**：伴随开发（`state: pla

plugins.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code 风格终端界面，支持 Windows、macOS 与 Linux，兼容透明终端、VS Code 主题和自定义配色。
plugins.readme_text:
> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list.
